title: SOLAR HEAT COLLECTING SYSTEM
abstract: PURPOSE:To make it possible to obtain hot air for heating even when insolation is low to allow operation with quick rise-up, by making arrangement such that the heating medium passages may be switched by the change-over valves provided on the upstream and downstream sides of the solar heat collector and by using one of the heating medium passages as the room-heating hot air passage. CONSTITUTION:Three-way valves 2 are connected to the upstream and downstream sides of the solar heat collector 1, said three-way valves 2 being connected to an air pump 3, hot air passage of an air tank 4, water pump 5 and hot water passage of a hot water reservoir 6. Hot air from the air tank 4 is circulated in the room 15 through valves 17 and a fan 14. When insolation is low in winter, the air pump 3 and fan 14 are operated to heat air to supply hot air into the room 15. When insolation is high, the three-way valves 2 are switched to operate the water pump 5 to effect water heating and the air in the air tank 4 is heated by high- temperature water in the hot water reservoir 6 to obtain hot air. In the summer season, water heating is performed and heated water is sent as heat source from the hot water reservoir 6 to an absorption type refregerator 22 by a pump 24.

title: Prodn. of mist at floor lever - involves evaporator, outlet, gas source, pressure pipe and pressurised gas bottle
abstract: The floor-mist-prodn. machine for discotheques, theatres, etc. incorporates a mist-generation chamber (7) in which a fluid is evaporated. The mist-outlet (8) is next to a gas-source (5, 6, 9, 6a, 9a) which mixes a gas with the mist (N) through a pressure-pipe (2) connected to a pressurised gas bottle (1). The specific gravity of the gas is greater at room temp. than that of air. A jet incorporates a pipe (6) with nozzle-holes in and concentric with the mist-outlet (8). USE/ADVANTAGE - The floor mist machine is simple to use and ejects large quantities of mist.

title: ALKALI-METAL-CARBONATE-CONTAINING NITRATE SALT COMPOSITIONS AND USE THEREOF AS HEAT TRANSFER MEDIUM OR HEAT STORAGE MEDIUM
abstract: The invention relates to a nitrate salt composition, containing as the essential constituents A) an alkali metal nitrate and optionally an alkali metal nitrite in a total amount in the range of 90 to 99.84% by weight, and B) an alkali metal compound selected from the group comprising B1) alkali metal oxide, B2) alkali metal carbonate, B3) alkali metal compound that decomposes in the temperature range of 250°C to 600°C to form alkali metal oxide or alkali metal carbonate, B4) alkali metal hydroxide MetOH, in which Met denotes lithium, sodium, potassium, rubidium, caesium, B5) alkali metal peroxide Met2O2, in which Met denotes lithium, sodium, potassium, rubidium, caesium, and B6) alkali metal superoxide MetO2, in which Met denotes sodium, potassium, rubidium, caesium in a total amount in the range of 0.16 to 10% by weight, the percentages being relative to the nitrate salt composition.

title: Harmful gas treatment equipment for environmental protection engineering
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of harmful gas treatment, in particular to harmful gas treatment equipment for environmental protection engineering. The harmful gas treatment equipment for the environmental protection engineering comprises a gas inlet pipe, a filter bin, a U-shaped connecting plate, activated carbon filter plates and the like, the filter bin is connected to the rear side of the gas inlet pipe, a plurality of activated carbon filter plates which are uniformly distributed along a straight line at intervals are inserted into the filter bin, and the U-shaped connecting plate is clamped at the upper ends of the activated carbon filter plates. The dust falling mechanism is arranged, the water pump runs to convey water into the atomizing spray head, the water is atomized into water mist through the atomizing spray head and sprayed into the air inlet pipe, the water mist makes contact with dust in harmful gas, dust falling of the harmful gas is achieved, and therefore most of the dust is removed, the follow-up burden of the activated carbon filter plate is relieved, and the service life of the dust falling device is prolonged. The problems that the utilization rate of a filter screen and an activated carbon plate is reduced, and the cleaning and replacing frequency of the filter screen and the activated carbon plate is increased are effectively solved.

title: METHOD FOR PRODUCTION OF INGOTS AND CAST ARTICLES OUT OF INTERMETALLIC ALLOYS
abstract: FIELD: technological processes. ^ SUBSTANCE: invention is related to manufacturing of ingots and cast articles out of intermetallic alloys based on titanium and aluminium. Method includes melting of initial charge in crucible and further crystallisation of melt in mold, made of aluminium nitride or lined with aluminium nitride inside, at that melt crystallisation is carried out in atmosphere of inertial gas, for instance argon with dew point of not more than minus 70 C. ^ EFFECT: improved quality of ingots and articles due to reduction of common oxygen content, and lower production costs. ^ 3 cl, 2 tbl, 3 ex

title: Clean and environment-friendly fuel gas combined cooling heating and power heating system
abstract: The utility model discloses a clean and environment-friendly gas combined cooling, heating and power heating system which comprises a gas-steam combined circulation system, a cooling and heating circulation system, a floor heating water pipe, a water distributor and a water collector. A water inlet and a plurality of water outlets are formed in the tank body of the water distributor; a metal filter screen is arranged on one side of the water outlet close to the tank body; a water outlet cleaning device is arranged in the water distributor; the water outlet cleaning device comprises a rotatingrod and a cleaning rod; the rotating rod is rotationally arranged in the tank body of the water segregator; a cleaning rod is fixedly arranged at the position, corresponding to the water outlet, of the rotating rod. Cleaning parts are arranged at the ends, away from the rotating rods, of the cleaning rods. When the cleaning rod rotates to the position of the water outlet, the cleaning part is in contact with the metal filter screen; according to the technical scheme, the problem that after a water distributor in an existing fuel gas combined cooling heating and power system is used for a period of time, due to the fact that impurities in water easily block water outlets, partial pressure on the water outlets is different, and dispersion efficiency is affected is solved.

title: Surface Treating Composition of Metal and Method of Manufacturing the Same
abstract: PURPOSE: A composition for treating the surface of a metal is provided which is corrosion resistant to a galvanized steel sheet, has economic feasibility to a commercialization level, and does not contain chromium for environmental friendliness, and a method for manufacturing the composition is provided. CONSTITUTION: The composition for treating the surface of a metal comprises 95 to 60 wt.% of resin in which aqueous organic resin and inorganic metal sol are coupling bonded in a solid ratio of 80:20 to 30:70; 1 to 10 wt.% of corrosion resistant rust inhibitor; and 0.5 to 10 wt.% of organic metallic complex compound, wherein the aqueous organic resin includes a hydroxy group or a carboxyl group, and is at least one or more resins selected from the group consisting of aqueous acrylic polymer resin, aqueous alkyd resin, water dispersed urethane resin and water dispersed epoxy resin, the inorganic metal sol is at least one or more sols selected from the group consisting of alumina sol, silica sol, titania sol and zirconia sol, the composition further comprises anti-foam agent and surface tension adjusting agent, and solid content of the composition is in the range of 5 to 20 wt.%. The method for manufacturing the composition for treating the surface of a metal comprises the steps of preparing an aqueous organic resin; preparing an organic-inorganic composite resin by coupling bonding the aqueous organic resin and inorganic metal sol in a solid content ratio of 80:20 to 30:70 under the existence of a coupling agent ranging from 0.005 to 5 wt.% based on the total amount of reactants; and mixing 95 to 60 wt.% of the obtained organic-inorganic composite resin, 1 to 10 wt.% of metal corrosion resistant rust inhibitor, and 0.5 to 10 wt.% of an organic metal based compound.

title: Glass door plate with frame hiding structure, and integrated cabinet formed by glass door plate
abstract: The utility model discloses a glass door plate with a frame hiding structure, and an integrated cabinet formed by the glass door plate. The glass door plate mainly comprises a frame (3) made of an aluminum material (1) and a glass panel (2) embedded on the frame (3), wherein the glass panel (2) is connected with the frame (3) to form an integrated structure. The integrated cabinet formed by the glass door plate with the frame hiding structure comprises a tabletop (8) formed by the glass panel (2) embedded on the frame (3), a cabinet body (9) and cabinet doors (10), wherein the tabletop (8) is connected to the upper surface of the cabinet body (9); the cabinet doors (10) are connected to the front end of the side wall of the cabinet body (9), and can rotate around connection shafts; and a cavity capable of accommodating objects is formed inside the cabinet door (9). The glass door plate and the integrated cabinet have simple structures, are waterproof, fireproof, firm, durable and environment-friendly, and are favorable for health.

title: EXPANSION VALVE MECHANISM, AND AIR CONDITIONER INSTALLED WITH THE SAME
abstract:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an inexpensively manufacturable expansion valve mechanism and a refrigeration cycle device equipped with it without complicating a configuration.

SOLUTION: In the expansion valve mechanism 100, a valve element passage 102 passing fluid flowing in from a first fluid inlet 111 or a second fluid inlet 116, and a recessed part 121 provided on a trailing edge of the valve element passage 102 and controlling communication of the valve element passage 102 with a branch passage following movement of a movable valve element 101 are formed in the movable valve element 101.

title: COLD-CURABLE ORGANOPOLYSILOXANE COMPOSITION HAVING PROLONGED SHELF LIFE
abstract: PURPOSE:To provide the composition which is useful as a sealing agent for buildings with high workability by using diorganopolysiloxane having hydroxyls on both molecular chain terminals, aminoxy group-bearing nitrogen-containing organosilicon compound, calcium carbonate and organopoly-siloxane. CONSTITUTION:The objective cold-curable organopolysiloxane composition having prolonged shelf life is obtained by using (A) 100 pts.wt. of diorganopolysiloxane bearing hydroxyls on both molecular chain terminals, (B) 0.1 to 30 pts.wt. of nitrogen-containing organosilicon compound which has 2.0 or more substituted aminoxy groups bonding to silicon atoms on the average where the substituted aminoxy groups are at least one selected from the groups of formula I (R<1>, R<2> are monovalent hydrocarbon) and formula II (R<3> is divalent organic group), (C) 1 to 200 pts.wt. of calcium carbonate and (D) 1 to 50 pts.wt. of at least one selected from cyclic organopolysiloxanes of formula III (n is integer of 3 to 10) and straight-chain organopolysiloxanes of formula IV (n is integer of 0 to 8).

title: HEATING DEVICE
abstract: PURPOSE:To provide a heating device to improve durability and thermal stability of a refrigerant by a method wherein the limit degree of heating at a refrigerant heater outlet is set and a combustion amount is controlled by the degree of superheat at the limit, in a heating device wherein a refrigerant is heated by means of combustion gas and the condensation heat of the refrigerant is used for heating. CONSTITUTION:A heating device comprises a computing comparing part 9 to compare the degree of superheat, determined as a difference between temperature obtained by a temperature detecting means 5 arranged at the outlet of a refrigerant heater 2 and a refrigerant saturated temperature determined from a refrigerant pressure detecting means 6 arranged at the outlet of the refrigerant heater 2, with the limit degree of superheat; and a control device 7 consisting of a pump control part 10 to control a flow rate of a refrigerant circulating pump 4 and a combustion control part 11, whereby local superheat of the refrigerant heater 2 is prevented from occurring and heat stability of a refrigerant is also improved.

title: Calculating or Computing Machine
abstract: 28,737. Fairweather, W., [Shattuck Manufacturing Co.]. Dec. 30. Calculating- apparatus.-In calculating - apparatus, which may be used in combination with, or independently of, a printing-apparatus, the recording and printing wheels 16, 17 are operated by inserting, opposite a number on the face-plate, Fig. 1, a stylus or tool through the slots 11 to engage with the helical groove in the corresponding roller 10. Upon pulling the stylus towards the front of the machine to perform an addition, the spring- pressed shaft 7 is first moved longitudinally to disengage its Geneva or other stop gearing 18, 19, 20, 21 from that of the shafts a recording tower denominations, and is then rotated, while a number is subtracted by inserting the stylus opposite one of the numbers arranged in reverse order at the right of the face-plate, Fig. 1, unlocking the shaft 7 by pressing the end projecting at the back of the machine, and pushing the stylus toward the rear end of the slot 11. The separate items to be lifted or added are respectively indicated and printed by wheels 24, 25 mounted on a sleeve 23, and the totals are indicated and printed by wheels 16, 17 on the shaft 7. To allow of the item wheels 24, 25 turning with the shafts 7 at each operation and then being re-set at zero, the wheel 25 is formed with a projection 26, Fig. 8, which engages a recess 27 in the wheel 17 when the shaft is moved longitudinally by the stylus, the toothed plate 28, which normally locks the sleeve 23, being simultaneously released. The subsequent re-setting of the item wheels to zero is effected by cams 34 on the sleeves operated by projections on a plate 35 while the printing carriage is being moved back to its original position, the locking-plate 28 being temporarily released by an arm moving in a cam-slot in the rack-bar 107. During these operations, the total wheels 16, 17 remain in the position to which they have been turned until the total amount is listed, after which they may be re-set to zero by the engagement of plates operated by the fingerpieces 54 with spiral cams 49 on the shafts 7, the item wheels 25 being temporarily held clear of the total wheels 17 by a plate 56 operated by the finger-piece 58. The printing-carriage 61 carrying the paper ribbon is pivoted upon the shaft 40, and is moved forwards and back over the printing- wheels by a rotary cam-shaft 68 actuated by the rack-bar 107, the cams 87 depressing the platen 80 to make the impression during the forward movement, and tilting it into an inoperative position during the return movement of the carriage. When all the items have been listed, the platen 80 is shifted by means of the lugs 68<1> on the shaft 65 so as to bring it over the total-printing wheels 17, and the totals are printed upon again operating the rack-bar 107. The adjustment of the platen relatively to the ribbon is effected by gearing engaging with a rack formed on the plate 74 which carries the platen, and the ribbon is fed by the rollers 95. Hooks and lugs 104 normally lock the carriage in printing-position while allowing it to be turned back on the pivot 40. The removable bottom 3 of the casing 2 is provided with india-rubber feet, strips, or their equivalent 5 to prevent the machine from slipping upon the table or support.

title: Reinforced composite calcium carbonate special for polyvinyl chloride sections
abstract: The invention discloses reinforced composite calcium carbonate special for polyvinyl chloride sections. The reinforced composite calcium carbonate comprises, by weight, 90-120 parts of calcium carbonate, 5-11 parts of polyvinyl chloride function regulators and 1.5-2 parts of stearic acid, and is prepared by the mixing process. The reinforced composite calcium carbonate special for the polyvinyl chloride sections has the advantages of reasonable conception, standard process, operational simplicity, low cost and no pollution, can be used for increasing strength of polyvinyl chloride sections and enable product cost to be lowered when used for production of the polyvinyl chloride sections, and the like. Besides, the reinforced composite calcium carbonate special for the polyvinyl chloride sections can be produced in batch within a short time, and accordingly can be applied to the field of production of the polyvinyl chloride sections widely.

title: Urban office building glass auxiliary device suitable for weather often accompanied by sand storm
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of doors and windows of office buildings, and discloses a glass auxiliary device suitable for urban office buildings often accompanied by sand storms.The glass auxiliary device comprises a shell, a connecting shaft is movably connected to the interior of the shell, a bearing piece is slidably connected to the bottom of the shell, and a sliding groove is formed in the inner side wall of the shell; a connecting plate is movably connected into the sliding groove, and an auxiliary part is movably connected to the surface of the sliding groove and located on the surface of the connecting plate. The initial force for closing the folding frame is the accumulation amount of sand and dust in the sand storm, the accumulation amount of the sand and dust is related to the air volume of the sand storm, when the sand storm stops, the sand storm is sprayed out by the gas in the extruded gas storage plate, at the moment, the movable plate is pushed to move upwards under the action of self-elasticity, the movable plate moves to generate vibration, and the sand storm is stopped. Dust on the sliding plate can be shaken off through vibration, that is, the folding frame is folded again, and therefore the effect that the air volume is reduced or the window is closed according to the sand storm to prevent sand dust from entering a room is achieved.

title: MATERIAL SHIELDING ULTRAVIOLET RAYS AND INFRARED RAYS AND MATERIAL SHIELDING INFRARED RAYS
abstract: PURPOSE:To attain excellent shielding effect by a single layer formed from one kind of powder with a simple method to facilitate the formation of a layer having large area by incorporating a solvent with an organic resin and zinc oxide powder containing a specific metal such as Si at a specific ratio. CONSTITUTION:Zinc oxide powder containing 0.1-25atom% (based on the total metal) of one or more metals selected from Si, Ti, V, Cr, Mn, Fe, Cu, Ga, Ge, Zr, In, Sn and Hf in total is used as powder for shielding ultraviolet rays and infrared rays or powder for shielding infrared rays. The powder and a soluble or dispersible organic resin are added to a solvent and the obtained shielding film-forming material is formed in the form of a film or a molded article by a simple forming process capable of easily forming a large-area product such as coating or molding. The produced film or molded article is applied to a glass, etc., to obtain a shielding material reflecting ultraviolet rays and infrared rays, especially near infrared rays by a single layer.

title: SHUTTER VALVE SHAFT FOR INTAKE MANIFOLD
abstract:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a shutter valve shaft for an intake manifold with advantages such as easy machinability, high accuracy in each part, light weight and low costs.

SOLUTION: (1) The shaft is made of metal, and a sliding part and a lever part are made of a resin. (2) The lever part is made of metal, and the shaft and the sliding part are made of the resin. (3) The shaft, sliding part and lever part are all made of the resin. The shaft is provided with a reinforcing plate. The resin is a mixture of nylon and glass fibers. A mixing ratio of the nylon and glass fibers is the ratio of seven to three in a weight ratio. A vertical section of the shaft is made in quadrangle.

title: POLYOXYMETHYLENE RESIN COMPOSITION AND MOLDED ARTICLE THEREFROM
abstract:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a polyoxymethylene resin composition where secondary contraction of a polyoxymethylene homopolymer is improved without detriment to mechanical properties and sliding performances.

SOLUTION: The polyoxymethylene resin composition comprises (A1) a polyoxymethylene homopolymer, (A2) a polyoxymethylene block polymer and (A3) a polyoxymethylene block copolymer, with a weight ratio of ((A1)+(A2))/(A3) within the range of 95/5-20/80, (B) a lubricant and (C) an inorganic filler.

title: Heat dissipating device of skid steer loader
abstract: The invention discloses a heat dissipating device of a skid steer loader. The heat dissipating device comprises a radiator and a cooling fan, and the radiator is hinged to a body frame on one side ofthe skid steer loader through a hinge; the radiator is connected to a body frame on the other side of the skid steer loader through a separable locking mechanism, and the locking connection and swingopening of the radiator on the body frames are achieved through the locking mechanism; the cooling fan is fixedly installed between an engine of the skid steer loader and the radiator, and the air inlet end of the cooling fan faces the engine; and the air outlet end of the cooling fan is in butt joint with a heat dissipating channel of the radiator movably. According to the heat dissipating deviceof the skid steer loader, the maintenance performance of the skid steer loader is improved, and the radiator is connected in a hinged manner; through swinging of the radiator, a space is provided formaintenance personnel to come in contact with the engine and other components, and the maintenance performance of the product is improved; the maintenance time is shortened, and the structure of thewhole heat dissipating device has the advantages of convenient operation, safety and reliability, and the simple mechanism.

title: Carbon dioxide copolymer polyalcohol-based polyurethane floor paving material and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a carbon dioxide copolymer polyalcohol-based polyurethane floor paving material. The carbon dioxide copolymer polyalcohol-based polyurethane floor paving material is prepared from the following component raw materials in parts by weight: 150 to 200 parts of carbon dioxide copolymer polyalcohol, 150 to 200 parts of diisocyanate, 10 to 60 parts of pore opening agent, 5 to 20 parts of chain extender, 0.1 to 1 part of water, 0.2 to 1 part of organic metal catalyst, 0.4 to 1 part of organic amine catalyst and 0.5 to 1.5 parts of foam stabilizer. The carbon dioxide copolymer polyalcohol-based polyurethane floor paving material has the advantages that under the synergistic action of components containing special content, the size stability is excellent; the mechanical property is excellent; shown by experiment results, after the floor paving material is placed for one week, the volume shrinkage rate is 0%; the tensile intensity is 1.58 to 2MPa, the elongation at break is 128 to 226%, the tear strength is 8.9 to 13.3KN/m, and the hardness is 40 to 48 Shore A.

title: Method for synthesizing environmentally friendly binder for buildings
abstract: The invention provides a method for synthesizing an environmentally friendly binder for buildings. Polyester polyol, isocyanate and a chain extender are synthesized into polyurethane in one step, andpolyacrylic acid is grafted under ultraviolet light irradiation to form a polyacrylic acid hydrophilic layer on the surface of the polyurethane. An initiation active center is present at the interfacebetween the polymer and a grafting monomer, and the hydrophilicity of the surface is enhanced without destroying properties of the main body. The ultraviolet radiation is adopted, equipment is simpleand easy to control, energy is greatly saved and the cost is reduced. The product does not contain formaldehyde and is used as a binder for building materials without causing pollution during use. The binder is an environmentally friendly binder.

title: Alkylation and transalkylation processes using a hydrated catalyst
abstract: A composition useful for catalyzing alkylation and transalkylation reactions comprises a molecular sieve having alkylation and/or transalkylation activity, an inorganic refractory oxide component and greater than 3.5 weight percent water. Such a catalyst has been found to maintain a long life when used to produce ethylbenzene in an integrated process in which benzene is alkylated with ethylene and transalkylated with diethylbenzene. The catalyst can also be used to produce cumene via an integrated process in which benzene is alkylated with propylene and transalkylated with diisopropylbenzene.

title: Ultraviolet-proof heat-insulation and waterproofing TPU (Thermoplastic Polyurethane) fabric and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses an ultraviolet-proof heat-insulation and waterproofing TPU (Thermoplastic Polyurethane) fabric and a preparation method thereof. Basalt and nanometer titania are compounded toachieve a synergistic effect, the ultraviolet-proof effect of the prepared TPU fabric is obviously improved, and the tensile strength of the obtained fabric is enhanced. Furthermore, the added bamboocharcoal fibers and nanometer titania are compounded, so that the prepared fabric has excellent bactericidal performance, and suitable for application to humid environments, such as raincoats, umbrellas and the like.

title: Multivalve for a vehicle gaseous fuel tank
abstract: A multivalve (1) for a vehicle gaseous fuel tank (2). The tank has a first portion (21) containing liquefied fuel, and a second portion (22) containing gaseous fuel. The multivalve is connected to the first portion of the tank by a ring nut (11), and has an outlet conduit (4) for drawing fuel from the first portion (21) of the tank (2), and a safety valve (10) in turn having a connecting conduit (15) communicating with the tank, and an exhaust conduit (16) communicating with the outside. The multivalve also has an elastically deformable pipe (25) made of elastomeric material, and which connects the connecting conduit (15) of the safety valve to the second portion (22) of the tank, so that, when predetermined maximum pressure and/or temperature values are exceeded, the pressure in the tank is reduced by exhausting gaseous fuel, as opposed to draining off liquid fuel. <IMAGE>

title: AIR CONDITIONER
abstract: PURPOSE:To make the effective use of hot air from an outdoor unit for the purpose of drying or the like by a method wherein an outdoor blower is operated even when a compressor motor is not operated. CONSTITUTION:When a manual switch 13 is set at a cooling effecting position 13a and a timer 12 is set, a fan motor 3a is operated first and when, in this case, the room temperature is higher than a set temperature, a fan motor 6a and the compressor motor 1a begin to operate. Further, a condenser 5 is cooled by the open air introduced by the outdoor blower 6 and a liquefied coolant is introduced into an evaporator 2 of an indoor unit A to thereby cool the room. At the same time, the air heated up to about 50-80 deg.C by the condenser 5 is blown out by the outdoor blower 6 to dry a clothing 10.

title: Preparation method of tetrafluoromethane
abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method of tetrafluoromethane. The method comprises the step of carrying out reaction in the presence of a catalyst by taking oxygen and hexafluorpropylene as raw materials, wherein the catalyst is a compound of an alkali metal, an alkaline earth metal or a transition metal. In the method, the oxygen and hexafluorpropylene are used as the raw materials, thus corrosive gases which are dear and can corrode equipment are prevented from being used. Simultaneously, the high-transformation high-selectivity preparation of the tetrafluoromethane can be achieved by using the method.

title: Nontoxic environment-friendly plant glass cleaner and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a nontoxic environment-friendly plant glass cleaner and a preparation method thereof. The nontoxic environment-friendly plant glass cleaner is prepared from the following components: 3 to 6 parts of butyl cellosolve, 1 to 2 parts of propylene glycol n-butyl ether, 10 to 12 parts of ammonium hydroxide, 16 to 24 parts of corn oil, 150 to 200 parts of soybeans, 1 to 3 parts of liquid soap, 5 to 6 parts of hydrogen peroxide and 600 to 700 parts of water. The nontoxic environment-friendly plant glass cleaner has the beneficial effects that water used in the method is neutral water which is nontoxic, odorless and non-corrosive and can be touched directly by hands; with the liquid soap, the cleaner is smooth; no water marks are retained; the cleaner can be directly wiped through a towel, and no scraper blade is needed.

title: Improvements in Washing and or Cooling Towers.
abstract: 24,262. Duff, A. B. Nov. 9. Smoke and fumes, treating.-In towers for washing or cooling fuel gases, the softening and disintegration in the lower part of the towers of the packing - material is prevented, and its removal is facilitated, by arranging the material in separately - removable sections. The brick chequer-work or other packing- sections G', G', G' are supported on metal beams H carried on angleirons H<1>, mixing- spaces J for the gases and liquids and manholes K being provided. The gas - supply pipe B is bent downwards at B<1> to distribute the incoming gas, and to allow of the pipe being sealed by water supplied through the cock E. The water or washing-liquid supplied by the pipe L is distributed by the perforated plate L' and is drawn off by the pipe D.

title: Improvements in Apparatus for the Lighting and Extinguishing of Gas Flames.
abstract: 8055. Simmance, J. F. May 1. Torches, which are improvements on those described in Specification No. 3683, A.D. 1899, are so constructed that the permanent flame of the colza or other burner can, when desired, be extended in a definite direction by a temporary jet of carburetted air. When a hydrocarbon having a high flash-point is employed for carburetting the air, the containing-chamber D, which may or may not be packed with absorbent material, is arranged near the permanent oil burner A, so that the vaporization of the hydrocarbon may be assisted by the conduction of heat from the permanent burner. By squeezing the india-rubber cover N of a groove M in the torch handle H, air is forced through the holes L<1>, L to the space K, whence it passes by an opening or tube F to the chamber D and ejects a jet of carburetted air through the tube E over the permanent flame B. When a hydrocarbon having a low flash-point is employed for carburetting the air, the chamber D may be permanently or detachably arranged at the lower end of the torch handle H. By using a vapour burner to produce the permanent flame, the extended flame may be obtained by increasing the pressure or volume of the permanent flame.

title: Air guide plate module of air conditioner, indoor unit of air conditioner and air conditioner
abstract: The invention provides an air guide plate module of an air conditioner, an indoor unit of the air conditioner and the air conditioner. The air guide plate module of the air conditioner comprises an inner air guide plate (1), a connecting part (2) and a driving mechanism (3), wherein the inner air guide plate (1) comprises a first long edge (11) and a second long edge (12) opposite to each other; afirst end of the connecting part (2) is connected to the surface of one side of the inner air guide plate (1), and a second end extends in the width direction of the inner air guide plate (1) and isprojected on the first long edge (11) of the inner air guide plate (1); and the driving mechanism (3) can be connected with the second end of the connecting part (2) to drive the second end to rotateso as to drive the inner air guide plate (1) to rotate around the second end of the connecting part (2). The inner air guide plate can totally close an air outlet when being withdrawn to cover the airoutlet, so that larger gap or even no gap in closing of the air guide plate of the air conditioner is effectively reduced, and the appearance of the air conditioner is improved.

title: Accounting is with many function combination formula tool holder
abstract: The utility model discloses an accounting is with many function combination formula tool holder, solved the required all kinds of instruments of accounting work more rationally, the safer problem of accomodating, including ladder box no. 1, ladder box no. 2, storing box, tool holder, magnetic path, iron plate, couple, ink paste standing groove, wet hand ware standing groove, storage box cover, capping and groove box, the ladder structure combination formula box body of sizes such as ladder box no. 1 and the ladder box policy of 'literature and art should serve both people and socialism' and through hinge swing joint, the up end of ladder box no. 1 can stack at the up end of ladder box no. 2 and form a cuboid structure with ladder box no. 2 through the hinge closure, the trailing flank of ladder box no. 2 bonds and has the storing box, and the preceding terminal surface of storing box has storage box cover through hinge swing joint, and the rear end face of storing box bonds and has the couple, and the left end face of storing box bonds and has the tool holder, is applicable to among the law teaching working practice.

title: MONOMERS WITH CYCLIC CARBONATE GROUPS
abstract: Monomers with cyclic carbonate groups having formula I are suitable for producing photosensitive recording materials, for example for producing offset printing plates. In said formula, A stands for a (n+m)-valent hydrocarbon residue with 3 to 30 C atoms that may be substituted by OH and have up to 8 ether bridges; R stands for H or methyl; n is an integer from 1 to 5; and m is an integer from 1 to 3, provided that n+m is at least 3.

title: Improvements in or relating to heat sealable vulcanized film
abstract: 689,416. Compound sheet materials. GOODRICH CO, B. F. Jan. 8, 1951. [Jan. 19, 1950] No. 513/51. Drawings to Specification. Class 140. An unsupported heat-sealable film comprises a, rubbery copolymer of an open chain conjugated diolefin with an alpha-methylene nitrile, the copolymer being vulcanised in one stratum but unvulcanised in a stratum of at least at one face of the film, the unvulcanised stratum comprising, in homogeneous admixture, with the rubbery copolymer, a polymer of vinyl chloride and/or vinylidene chloride. In one method of making the film, the rubbery copolymer is mixed with a vulcanising agent and other compounding ingredients and formed into a film, and a film is also made of a composition of the copolymer with the chloroethylene polymer. The two films are then bonded together between rolls and the structure is heated to vulcanise the stratum containing the vulcanising agent. Alternatively, the heatsealable stratum may be deposited by spraying, brushing or spreading on the face of the vulcanisable film, an aqueous dispersion of the rubbery copolymer and choroethylene polymer, and the structure is then vulcanised. The unvulcanised stratum may occur at each face of the film. The tear resistance and resistance of the films to petroleum hydrocarbons are increased by coating the outer face of the heatsealable stratum with a polymer prepared predominantly from vinylidene chloride. Suitable diolefins for the preparation of the rubbery copolymer are butadiene, isoprene, dimethyl butadienes, piperylene and ethyl butadiene. Specified nitriles are acrylonitrile, methacrylonitrile and etharcrylonitrile. The chloroethylene polymers may also contain small proportions of radicals derived from, for example, vinyl acetate, styrene, methyl acrylate, methyl methacrylate, ethyl acrylate, vinyl bromide, acrylonitrile and vinylidene cyanide. The usual plasticiers may be mixed with these polymers.

title: Air conditioner
abstract: The utility model relates to an air conditioner. The air conditioner comprises a shell and a filter plate. A containing space is formed in the shell. An opening is formed in the wall face of the shell, and the filter plate is embedded in the opening. The filter plate comprises a grid part provided with a plurality of through holes, and the through holes are communicated with the interior and the exterior of the shell. According to the invention, the possible damage to the filter plate in the transportation process is avoided, the aesthetic property of the whole machine is improved, and the sales of products is facilitated.

title: Die-casting aluminum alloy material produced from full-reclaimed materials and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a die-casting aluminum alloy material which is high in performance and low in cost and is produced from all reclaimed materials and a preparation method of the die-casting aluminum alloy material. The alloy comprises the following components in percentage by weight: 10%-11% of Si; 0.50% to 0.65% of Mg; 0.01% to 0.20% of Mn; cu: 1.0%-1.2%; 0 lt; ni < = 0.5%; 0.7% to 0.9% of Fe; 0 lt; 0.20% or less of Ti; 2.0% to 2.5% of Zn; 0 lt; pb < = 0.1%; 0 lt; sn < = 0.1%; the sum of the other impurities is controlled to be 1% or below. Compared with a conventional ADC12 alloy, raw materials are wider, the cost is lower, but the mechanical property, the heat conductivity and the weather resistance all exceed those of the ADC12 alloy. The alloy die-casting test bar has the following properties: the tensile strength is greater than or equal to 270MPa, the yield strength is greater than or equal to 150MPa, the ductility is greater than or equal to 2.5%, and the heat conductivity is greater than or equal to 110W/m.k. The material is a green material conforming to circular economy.

title: PURIFICATION OF HIGH TEMPERATURE REDUCTIVE GAS
abstract: PURPOSE:To remove CO and a sulfur compound in gas by treating high temp. reductive gas in a CO shift reactor to convert CO in the gas to CO2 and controlling the temp. of the gas by a heat recovery apparatus to remove CO2 and the sulfur compound. CONSTITUTION:The high temp. reductive gas in a line 1 containing a sulfur compound such as H2S or COS generated in a coal gasifying furnace is supplied to a CO shift reaction apparatus 5 while the dust therein is removed by a dry dust removing apparatus 2. The reaction apparatus 5 is packed with an Fe-Cr type catalyst converting CO to CO2 and CO is converted to CO2 by shift reaction. When the gas in a line 7 issued from the reaction apparatus 5 is introduced into a CO2 sulfur compound removing apparatus 10, the CO2 and sulfur compound in the gas are adsorbed and removed by an adsorbent with high efficiency and the obtained purified gas is used as the fuel of a turbine.

title: Assembly type garbage classification and recovery house and pedal type window opening mechanism
abstract: The utility model provides an assembly type garbage classification and recovery house and a pedal type window opening mechanism. The pedal type window opening mechanism comprises a frame body, a stockbin cover, a pedal and a power transmission unit. The power transmission unit comprises upper and lower transmission shafts, short and long driving levers and a connecting rod; the two ends of the upper and lower transmission shafts are rotationally connected with vertical beams of the frame body through bearings respectively; the upper transmission shaft is fixedly connected with the bin cover;the lower transmission shaft is fixedly connected with pedals; the short deflector rod is vertically fixed at one end of the upper transmission shaft, the long deflector rod is vertically fixed at thecorresponding end of the lower transmission shaft, and the upper and lower ends of the connecting rod are respectively hinged with the short deflector rod and the long deflector rod. According to theutility model, a plurality of garbage cans placed in the garbage can can be effectively sealed and protected, so that the pollution influence on the surrounding space environment is avoided; the appearance modeling design can be carried out according to different environments, so that the appearance is not influenced, and even a decorative scenic spot can be formed; and the window opening mechanism can effectively prevent hands from contacting a pollution source, is convenient to use, and is sanitary and safe.

title: Inhibited aqueous, methoxypropanol coolant adjusted to a pH between about 6 and 9
abstract: A coolant comprising water and one of 1-methoxy-2-propanol, 2-methoxy-1-propanol or mixtures thereof, resistant to degradation of fluoroelastomers and which is inhibited against corrosion of ferrous metals, aluminum and solder is disclosed. The desired coolant is prepared by reacting in situ or adding the reaction product of one or more phosphoric acids and an inorganic base selected from potassium hydroxide, sodium hydroxide or mixtures thereof, and optionally contains, as a copper or brass deactivator mercaptobenzothiazole, a benzotriazole, a sodium or potassium salt of mercaptobenzothiazole or a benzotriazole, or mixtures of these, wherein the pH of the coolant is adjusted to between about 6 and about 9 by balancing the relative amounts of phosphoric acids and inorganic bases to attain said pH. For example, about 53 parts 1-methoxy-2-propanol, 46 parts water, 0.8 parts K2HPO4, 0.1 part orthophosphoric acid and 0.1 part sodium tolutriazole yield a coolant of about pH 8 which gives low corrosion of metals commonly employed in cooling systems and does not induce excessive swelling or cracking and crazing of fluoroelastomers.

title: PRODUCTION OF 4,4'-(1-PHENYLETHYLIDENE)BISPHENOL
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain the objective substance in good yield using an inexpensive apparatus in a short time by using a catalyst composed of a heteropoly acid and a sulfur-containing organic compound having SH group in producing the title substance from acetophenone and phenol. CONSTITUTION:Acetophenone is reacted with phenol in the presence of a catalyst composed of a heteropoly acid (e.g. phosphotungtic acid) and a sulfur- containing organic compound (e.g. ethyl mercaptan or mercaptopropionic acid) having SH group at 40-120 deg.C for 2-12hr to produce the title substance. The heteropoly acid and the sulfur-containing organic compound are used in an amount of 0.05-0.3mol based on 1mol acetophenone and 0.5-30wt.% based on the acetophenone. Since a catalyst such as HCl having strong corrosiveness is not used, expensive apparatuses are not required. The title substance is useful as an intermediate raw material for polycarbonates, polyesters, developers for heat-sensitive paper, etc.

title: Gas primary cooler
abstract: The utility model discloses a gas primary cooler, include ware body bottom, first heat transfer section, second heat transfer section, ware body top, be equipped with coal gas export, steam inlet, a condensate outlet and the 2nd condensate outlet on the lateral wall of ware body bottom, first heat transfer section and second heat transfer duan jun are including controlling two tube sheets and twocurb plates of front and back, and the tube sheet encloses into sealed shell structure with the curb plate, is equipped with the backup pad in the shell structure, tube sheet and curb plate are connected with the heat exchange tube, and the heat exchange tube passes through the backup pad to with backup pad fixed connection, the tube sheet outside is fixed with a plurality of first water tanks andsecond water tank, be equipped with refrigeration entry and refrigeration export on the lateral wall of first heat transfer section, be equipped with the export of circulating water inlet and circulating water on the lateral wall of second heat transfer section, be equipped with a plurality of spray lines on the lateral wall at ware body top, the top at ware body top is equipped with gas inlet and diffuses the mouth. The utility model discloses light in weight, convenient equipment can improve heat exchange efficiency.

title: POLYHALOALCOHOLS AND THEIR USE AS FLAME RETARDANTS IN POLYMER COMPOSITIONS
abstract: 1,256,085. Lubricants. COLUMBIAN CARBON CO. 15 Nov., 1968 [29 Dec., 1967], No. 54432/68. Heading C5F. title: Water-saving washtub for students
abstract: The invention relates to a washtub, in particular to a water-saving washtub for students. The water-saving washtub for students includes a washtub. The washtub is divided into three areas by a partition plate A and a partition plate B which are perpendicular to each other. The partition plate A is perpendicular to the bottom of the washtub and divides the washtub into two parts from the middle; and the partition plate B is parallel to the bottom of the washtub, is located on one side of the partition plate A and is connected with the middle of the partition plate A. The side of the washtub below the partition plate B is provided with an opening. The joint of the partition plate A and the partition plate B and the bottom of the washtub on the other side of the partition plate A each are provided with a water discharging port, and the water discharging port is provided with a cover plate. According to the water-saving washtub for students, necessary articles can be all brought in one time, the trouble of taking the articles back and forth is avoided, water resources are fully utilized, and the washtub has a good water-saving effect.

title: Translation door and window
abstract: The utility model discloses a translation door and window, including door and window frame, translation fan, translation coupling assembling and door and window lock subassembly, be equipped with spout or slide rail on the door and window frame, translation coupling assembling installs on the translation fan, and translation coupling assembling is gliding to be established in the spout or on the slide rail, and door and window lock unit mount is between door and window frame and translation fan, for the translation fan, install the card and put the seat on the relative position of subassembly is locked with door and window to the door and window frame, install on translation fan and put a complex card with the card and put the device. The utility model discloses a structure can make things convenient for more, the laborsaving translation fan of closing, location when simultaneously can better realization closing the translation fan.

title: PRODUCTION OF POLYCARBONATE
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain a polycarbonate having controlled molecular weight and excellent color tone and transparency and useful for molded article, etc., by polymerizing an alkaline aqueous solution of a dihydric phenol, etc., and a halogenated carbonyl compound under specific condition to suppress the hydrolysis reaction of phosgene. CONSTITUTION:The objective polycarbonate is produced by continuously supplying an alkaline aqueous solution of a dihydric phenol such as bisphenol A and a molecular weight modifier such as phenol together with a halogenated carbonyl compound such as phosgene (the amount is preferably 1.00-1.10 equivalent based on the dihydric phenol) to an organic solvent (e.g. dichloromethane) at pH 10.0-11.0 at a definite supplying ratio and polymerizing in the presence of a polymerization catalyst such as trimethylamine.

title: Improvements in or relating to sound recording and reproducing apparatus
abstract: 263,180. De Forest Phonofilms, Ltd., (Assignees of Forest, L. de). Dec. 19, 1925, [Convention date]. Optical apparatus for recording sound photographically or for reproducing sound photo-electrically from a record, instead of the usual slit interposed between a source of light and the film, there are provided three straightedged opaque bodies so arranged in different parallel planes as to permit of the passage of a very thin band of light between their adjacent edges. title: Oil pressure control in an engine
abstract: The present invention relates to an oil pressure control in an engine. An engine having a fluid lubrication and control system is provided. The engine also includes a pump configured to maintain fluid pressure in the lubrication and control system when the engine is running. The engine additionally includes an accumulator in fluid communication with the lubrication and control system. The accumulator is configured to accumulate and retain fluid when the engine is running, and to discharge the fluid when the engine is not running in order to maintain fluid pressure in the lubrication and control system. A method for controlling oil pressure in the engine is also provided.

title: Hollow pin shaft chain
abstract: The utility model discloses a hollow pin shaft chain which comprises an inner chain plate, an outer chain plate, a hollow pin shaft and a roller, the roller is arranged on the hollow pin shaft in a rotating mode, a first oil storage space is arranged between the roller and the hollow pin shaft, and an oil outlet hole communicated with the first oil storage space is formed in the hollow pin shaft. The first oil storage space and the second oil storage space which are relatively closed are arranged to continuously lubricate the hollow pin shaft, the solid pin shaft and the roller respectively, so that lubricating oil is not easy to evaporate even at high temperature, the problem of lubrication failure is avoided, and the service life of the chain is greatly prolonged; the device is suitable for large-size lead ingot conveying chains; the inner width and the backlash of the inner section of the chain plate are better ensured by utilizing the step structure, a sleeve is not needed under the structure, and the structure is simplified; machining and assembling are convenient.

title: Turbofan Thrust Reverser.
abstract: 1,190,627. Turbofan thrust reversers. UNITED AIRCRAFT CORP. 10 May, 1967 [31 May, 1966], No. 21818/67. Heading B7G. A thrust reverser for a ducted fan propulsion engine 10 located downstream of the substantially annular outlet 26 for air discharged from the fan 24 comprises a flexible baffle 32 movable between an operative position (e.g. as shown) and a stored position when the baffle 32 is located in a storage chamber 42 in the housing 28, there being pulling means (e.g. reels 46 and cables 48) to draw the baffle into the chamber. The reverser also includes tension rods 34 connecting the baffle 32 to the housing 28 upstream of the baffle. The baffle 32 may be of fabric material such as canvas, metallic reinforced canvas, fibreglass fabric, or flexible metallic fibre cloth. The chamber 42 may be closed either by a door 44, Fig. 3, having a rubber flap 45, and attached to the housing 28 or a door (44a), Fig. 4 (not shown), carried on the ends of the rods 34. The baffle 32 may comprise a fluted construction with passages 68, 70, 72 to allow discharged fan air to permeate the baffle and provide a cooling layer on its outer surface, thereby protecting the baffle from hot jet pipe exhaust flow reversed by clam shell reverser 20. Reference has been directed by the Comptroller to Specification 1,083,623.

title: Improvements in or relating to fluid pressure remote control systems
abstract: 533,667. Pneumatic single stroke apparatus. AUTOMOTIVE PRODUCTS CO., Ltd., and THORNHILL, P. W. Nov. 8, 1939, No. 29672. [Class 8 (ii)] [Also in Group XXIX] A fluid pressure remote control system which is especially applicable for actuating fluid motors such as the jacks 20, 21, Fig. 1, on aircraft for controlling wing flaps, under-carriages &c. is constructed with a series of selector valves 28 ... 33, each operable by a handle 61 to control the pressure in pipe lines 36, 37, 38 leading to separate control valves 23, 24, for controlling the supply of the fluid to the motors 20, 21, the control valves being adapted to operate the motors in either direction or to leave the motor inoperative according to the setting of the appropriate handle 61. The liquid control shown comprises a pump 11 fed from a reservoir 13 and supplying liquid to an accumulator 10 connected to the pressure supply line 18. The return line 19 is connected to the reservoir 13 as is the overflow from the accumulator 10. The control valves 23, 24 are connected by pipes 25, 26, to the lines 18, 19, and by pipes 22 to the motors 20, 21, and one pressure line 36, 37, 38 leads from each selector valve to each control valve. One of the selector valves is shown in Fig. 2 in the ' off ' position with the handle 61 in a mid-position which enables a spring-pressed plunger 53 to assume its extreme position towards the right. In this position a pipe 35 connects the pipe 36 to the pipe 19 so that there is no operative pressure in pipe 36. Connection between the pipe 35, 36 takes place through the hollow stem of a valve 42 and radial ports 51. The valve 42 which can be set to connect the pressure inlet pipe 34 to the pipe 36 is pressed on its seat by the pressure of fluid entering the port 34a and acting upon an annular washer 47 attached to a secondary plunger 46 which draws the valve 42 to its seat by acting upon a shoulder 49 of an enlarged part of the valve stem. When the handle 61 is raised to engage a stop 72 so that a pivot 63 acts on a thrust plate 65 to move the plunger 53 to the left, the connection to the pipe 35 is closed by the engagement of a sleeve 57 with a washer 58 on the secondary plunger 46, and the plunger 46 is finally moved to the left and so releases the pressure on the valve stem which can then open partially under the fluid pressure, the valve acting as a pressure reducing valve to reduce the pressure in pipe line 36 to a predetermined proportion, say one-half, of the pressure of pipe 18. If the pressure exceeds this the secondary plunger is moved to the right and the fluid can pass to the pipe 35 leading to the reservoir 13. The sleeve 57 is formed with a flange 59 which engages the end surface 60 of the plunger 46 to permit a thrust to be transmitted without damage to the plunger 46. By moving the handle 61 over to its extreme clockwise position a pivot 64 causes a further movement of the plunger 53 towards the left, and the valve 42 opens fully and the pressure transmitted to the pipe 36 is equal to the full pressure of the pipe 18. The valve mechanism for controlling the fluid supply to the motors 20 is shown in Fig. 6 in the position which the valves E, P : E<SP>1</SP>, P<SP>1</SP> occupy when the selector valve is in the ' off ' position. In this position the motors are connected to the exhaust lines by valves E, E<SP>1</SP> so that compensation for temperature variation can take place. To operate the motor in one direction the selector valve is set to the half-pressure position and the pressure in pipe 36 then causes a small plunger 104 to move to the left and actuate a lever 96 which opens a valve P<SP>1</SP> leading to the inlet of one end of the motor 20, and closes the valve E<SP>1</SP>, the exhaust then being through connection 22a, passage 114, valve E pipe 26. When the pressure in pipe 36 is raised to full pressure a large plunger 99 is moved to the right with a pressure which corresponds to the same as that which moved the small plunger 104 to the left. The plunger 104 which has a lost motion connection 107 with the large one is at the same time withdrawn. The valve P is now opened and the valve E shut, the valves E<SP>1</SP>, P<SP>1</SP> are returned to their original position by a spring 92. The operation of the motor is thus reversed. The pressure on the face of plunger 99 due to fluid admitted to port 36b is opposed by pressure admitted to a space 110 from the main pressure line. When the pressure in pipe 36 is half that of the pressure line these forces balance. When the pressure in pipe 36 is made equal to that of the pressure line the resultant force acting on the lever 95 is the same as that which previously acted upon the lever 96. In a modified form of selector valve, Fig. 7, the handle 61 is arranged when in mid-position to set the valve for half pressure, and the control valve is so arranged that the motors are inoperative when the valve is in this position, and are operative in opposed directions according as the pressure in the pipe line 36 is connected to the pressure line 18 or the return line 19. The handle 61 operates a cam with recesses 122, 123, 124 which engages a ball on the plunger 53 the end of which is of frusto-conical shape to act as a valve with the end of a sleeve 126 which has an aperture 128 leading to the reservoir passage 35a. In the position shown, which is the half-pressure position, the valve 44 opens against the action of a light-spring under fluid pressure from a conduit 34a. If the pressure exceeds the half pressure it acts on the end of the sleeve 126 which is moved to permit of escape of fluid by conduit 35a. When the handle 61 is raised to position 61a the valve 57a opens under spring action and the fluid is connected by conduit 35a to the reservoir. In the 61b position the valve 44 is held fully open. In a simpler form of valve the handle 61 is arranged to have two operative positions only, and a valve similar to 57a, Fig. 7, is arranged to move to two positions which permit of the fluid which enters the conduit 34a having access to the conduit 35a or the pipe 36, the valve 44 being fully open in the latter case. The form of the valve E, P, E<SP>1</SP>, P<SP>1</SP> is varied to suit the pressure control system described in connection with Fig. 7.

title: STILL VIDEO CAMERA
abstract: PURPOSE:To prevent useless cost at the sender side by predict outline of a transmission charge for a picked-up picture to send the picture with a cheap cost. CONSTITUTION:Each terminal number of a sender side and a receiver side is inputted by a ten-key 10 to pick up a charge system between a transmission district and a reception district from a transmission line charge system data stored in advance. Number of picked-up pictures set at a low cost is calculated in the picked-up charge system. Then when the limit number calculated is picked up, an alarm lamp 8 and a microphone/speaker device 9 raise alarm at least to inform it to the user that the transmission charge is increased when the succeeding picture is sent. Thus, useless cost for the user is avoided in the case of picture transmission.

title: Spray orifice tablet
abstract: The invention discloses a spraying piece with spraying layer, wherein the spraying layer contains first surface, second surface, at least one spraying hole, at least one ink-accumulating reserving tank and at least one ink-accumulating conductive groove; the spraying hole pierces spraying layer, which connects first and second layers of spraying layer; the ink-accumulating reserving tank and ink-accumulating conductive groove lie on the first surface, which nears one end of first surface of spraying hole in connection with ink-accumulating reserving groove; the ink-accumulating reserving groove interconnects one end of ink-accumulating conductive groove, which guides and cleans the accumulated ink around spraying hole between ink-accumulating reserving tank and ink-accumulating conductive groove.

title: IMAGE FORMATION DEVICE, IMAGE TREATMENT DEVICE, AND IMAGE FORMATION SYSTEM
abstract:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an image formation device, an image treatment device, and an image formation system which judge whether a total number of a number of sheets to be printed and a loading number of sheets corresponds to the height of plugging a discharge opening, or not, to thereby prevent generation of paper jam due to the clogging of a discharge paper.

SOLUTION: The image formation device includes a counter of the loading number of sheets (a counter 111 of the loading number of sheets) for counting the loading number of sheets to be loaded in a loading part; a calculation part (a calculation part 1082 of the number of sheets to be printed) for calculating the number of sheets to be printed in print treatment based on an image data from a printing condition information; a judging part (a judging part 1083 for and against printing) for comparing the total number of a counter value of the counter of the loading number of sheets and a calculated number of sheets to be printed with the threshold value of a number of sheets loadable on the loading part established beforehand, to judge as printable if the total number is equal to or below the threshold value, and judge as unprintable if the total number is over the threshold value; and a control unit (a control part 101) for performing an unprintable after-treatment corresponding to unprint status if judged unprintable.

title: Pneumatic lifting bridge plate
abstract: The utility model discloses a pneumatic lifting bridge plate, which relates to the field of bridge plates and comprises an upper cross beam, a lower frame, a first swing rod, a second swing rod and acylinder, the upper cross beam and the lower frame are arranged in parallel, and the first swing rod and the second swing rod are arranged between two ends of the upper cross beam and the lower frame.The upper ends and the lower ends of the first swing rod and the second swing rod are movably connected with the upper beam and the lower rack respectively, an air cylinder is installed on the lowerrack, and one end of the air cylinder is connected with the first swing rod. title: Vegetables dehydrating tank system of disinfecting
abstract: The utility model discloses a vegetables dehydrating tank system of disinfecting, including being used for transporting dehydrating tank's conveyer belt and liquid sterilization mechanism and the ultraviolet ray disinfection mechanism that the conveyer belt both sides were arranged in to the branch, liquid sterilization mechanism includes transparent disinfectant tank, antiseptic solution shower nozzle, first processor module, a PIR, the 2nd PIR and pressure sensor module, ultraviolet ray disinfection mechanism includes ultraviolet lamp, second processor module and ultraviolet intensity detection module, liquid sterilization mechanism still includes a wireless transmission module, and ultraviolet ray disinfection mechanism still includes the 2nd wireless transmission module, a wireless transmission module and the 2nd wireless transmission module all with a long -range warning module wireless connection, long -range warning module sets up in the disinfection monitor. The utility model discloses a conveyer belt transports dehydrating tank and carries out ultraviolet ray disinfection and antiseptic solution disinfection respectively automatically, improves dehydrating tank disinfection work efficiency, reduces the water consumption, improves dehydrating tank disinfection effect simultaneously.

title: Off-line software authorized operation method and device
abstract: The invention provides an off-line software authorized operation method and device, and relates to the technical field of off-line authorization management, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining public key information managed by an authorized operation party, and encrypting to-be-authorized information based on the public key information; according to the encrypted to-be-authorized information, querying from authorized operation party management, and determining authorization data corresponding to each authorized operation party; and corresponding strategy operation is performed based on the authorization data, so that the technical problem that the application efficiency is affected due to the fact that a client needs a tedious authorization means to use enterprise authorization software in the prior art is solved.

title: COOLER BOX
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a readily producible cooler box having the outer shell part and the inner shell part of a volume part both of which can be readily located. SOLUTION: The volume part of this cooler box has an inner shell part 11 and an outer shell part 12. Columnar parts 31 are columnar part members integrally attached to the inner shell part 11 and are provided with female screw parts 31a from columnar head parts in the axial direction. On the other hand, column receiving parts 32 are columnar members integrally attached to the outer shell part 12 and are opened upward. title: CORDLESS TELEPHONE
abstract: PURPOSE:To eliminate the necessity of a switch to be used for permitting the start of identification code writing by automatically confirming the connection between a handset and base unit by means of a connection cord for writing identification code and causing the start of the identification code writing to be permitted by the confirmation. CONSTITUTION:At the time of writing an identification code in a handset 1, the cord plug for telephone line is first pulled out from a modular jack 270 for telephone line. Then the plug 192 of a connection cord 190 for identification code writing is inserted into the modular jack 270 and a plug 191 is inserted into a jack for writing identification code. abstract: To provide a mirror door for facilitating change-over of displaying in a display part.SOLUTION: A first mirror door 1 (mirror door) includes a door main body 2, a mirror part 20, and a display part 30.
