title: B4C+Al bead welding remelting method for magnesium alloy surface
abstract: The present invention relates to welding technology, and is B4C+Al bead welding re-melting method for magnesium alloy surface. The present invention has the following steps: 1) treating magnesium alloy workpiece surface via grinding, eliminating oxide, flushing with anhydrous alcohol and drying in the air; 2) mixing B4C and Al powder, and adding PVB via stirring to obtain coating material; 3) painting the compounded coating material onto the surface of magnesium alloy workpiece, and drying naturally or stoving; and 4) tungsten electrode arc welding and re-melting of the magnesium alloy workpiece surface under the protection of inert gas. The present invention can raise the surface hardness, wear resistance and corrosion resistance, and has simple equipment, easy operation, low production cost and other advantages.

title: Plastic molding equipment
abstract: The utility model discloses plastic molding equipment, which is provided with a frame, a feeding mechanism, a positioning mechanism, a heating mechanism, a molding mechanism, a power mechanism and a control mechanism, wherein the frame is provided with a processing station and heating sliding rollers; the processing station is provided with a material charging inlet and a material discharging outlet; the heating sliding rollers are fixed on the frame and arranged above the processing station; the positioning mechanism is movably arranged on the processing station; the heating mechanism is movably arranged on the heating sliding rollers; the molding mechanism is provided with an upper mold and a lower mold; the upper mold and the lower mold are movably arranged above and below the processing station respectively; and the plastic molding equipment is also provided with an air blowing mechanism, an auxiliary material charging mechanism and a cutting device. According to the plastic molding equipment, automatic plastic molding can be realized under the control of the control mechanism; and the plastic molding equipment has the characteristics of high production efficiency and good product quality.

title: Hot pressing production equipment for automobile cushion
abstract: The invention relates to hot pressing production equipment for automobile cushions. The hot pressing production equipment comprises a frame, a first feeding device, a second feeding device and a hot pressing device; the hot pressing device comprises an upper die, a lower die, a heating plate and a temperature control system; and the temperature control system comprises a control terminal for controlling the heating plate to heat the upper die and the lower die and controlling operation of the upper die and the lower die, a temperature detection module for detecting the temperatures of the upper die and the lower die in real time, a threshold module with a built-in temperature preset value database, a calling module for calling required preset values in a temperature preset value database for setting, a comparison module for receiving the detected temperature and comparing with a temperature preset value called by the calling module, and a trigger module for triggering a main control terminal to control the heating plate to heat the upper die and the lower die. The temperature conditions of the upper die and the lower die can be known in real time, and when the temperatures of the upper die and the lower die are reduced, the heating plate is controlled to heat the upper die and the lower die.

title: Paper industry production waste crushing and recycling device with pre-compression function
abstract: The utility model discloses a pre-compressed paper industry production waste crushing and recycling device which comprises a crushing box, a linear moving assembly, a recycling assembly and an extruding assembly. The linear moving assembly comprises a fixed seat arranged on the supporting rod, a lead screw in bearing connection with the fixed seat and a rotating motor fixedly connected with the lead screw, and the recycling assembly comprises a recycling box in threaded connection with the lead screw; the extrusion assembly comprises a second fixing plate arranged at the top end of the fixing base, a second air cylinder arranged on the second fixing plate and an extrusion plate arranged at the bottom end of the second air cylinder. The recycling box can collect crushed waste materials, a rotating motor of the linear moving assembly can push the recycling box to horizontally move through a lead screw until the recycling box is located under the extrusion assembly, and then a second air cylinder of the extrusion assembly can drive an extrusion plate to extrude the waste materials in the recycling box. And the waste materials can be compressed into cakes so as to be conveniently carried and treated.

title: Fixed rotary powder spraying type degasser
abstract: The utility model relates to the field of degassing machines, in particular to a fixed rotary powder spraying type degassing machine. The utility model provides a fixed rotary powder spraying type degassing machine which can adjust the direction of a stirring rod to stir molten aluminum and ensure complete degassing of the molten aluminum. A fixed rotary powder spraying type degasser comprises a base, a rotating rod, a lead screw, a rotating block, a first motor and the like, the rotating rod is rotationally connected to the upper side of the base, the lead screw is rotationally connected into the rotating rod, the rotating block is connected to the upper portion of the lead screw in a threaded mode, the rotating block is slidably connected with the rotating rod, and the first motor is connected to the upper side of the rotating rod. According to the aluminum liquid degassing device, a third motor is started to drive a second pinion to rotate, so that the second pinion and a second large gear are meshed to move, a cam rotates, a rotating rod is driven to rotate, and the effects that the direction of a stirring rod can be adjusted to stir aluminum liquid, and it is ensured that the aluminum liquid is completely degassed are achieved.

title: Waste heat boiler adopting efficient heat exchange element
abstract: The waste heat boiler comprises a smoke box and a reaction furnace body, the reaction furnace body is installed at the upper end of the smoke box, a connecting plate is arranged on the outer wall of the front end of the smoke box, a smoke inlet is formed in the outer wall of the right end of the smoke box, and a smoke outlet is formed in the outer wall of the right end of the smoke box. The heat exchange efficiency of the waste heat boiler is improved through a brand-new design, heat exchange is enhanced through the spiral finned tubes, the stress of the waste heat boiler is reduced, the peakshaving requirement of a combined cycle unit is fully met, the heat exchange efficiency of a boiler heat exchange assembly is improved through the flue gas baffling type waste heat boiler, and hot flue gas at the tail of the unit is utilized as much as possible; meanwhile, the size of the waste heat boiler is improved, the weight of the waste heat boiler is reduced, a smoke flowing part is dividedinto a high-temperature section, a middle-temperature section and a low-temperature section through a heat exchange module in the waste heat boiler and a smoke flowing path designed in a folding range, respective heat exchange conditions and elements are designed for each part, and smoke heat in different temperature intervals is utilized to the maximum extent.

title: POWER VEHICLE
abstract: PURPOSE:To prevent a front wheel side from running thoughtlessly at a high speed during low speed work so as to improve safety by correlating a suitable detector, which detects a running car speed, to a front wheel side acceleration switching machine in a manner wherein acceleration of the front wheel side is invalidated caused by the running car speed increased to a predetermined high speed or more. CONSTITUTION:In the case of performing farming work by mounting a work machine to a tractor, high speed work such as running on a road is not normally performed. Accordingly, a subtransmission 7 is shifted to a low speed side to place a main transmission 6 in an intermediate or low speed. Here, by reading a rotational speed of an input gear 16 of a car speed detecting part by a detector 18, its detection signal is input to a CPU20 through an A/D converter circuit. When a running speed is increased to a high speed, a switch of an acceleration switching mechanism 14 is controlled off by the CPU20 to excite a solenoid based on the rotational speed of the gear 16 detected by the detector 18. In this way, rotation in a side of a front wheel 2 is maintained to a stance of acceleration inability.

title: Stacking trolley for transporting and/or storing a stack of stackable chairs, and a stackable chair
abstract: The stacking trolley has an at least approximately vertical support frame (40) composed of at least two supports (50). On the lower part of the support frame there is a rack (42) inclined relative to the supports (50) and intended for the stack (44) of the chairs (46) which are to be stacked. The support frame (40) and the rack (42) are connected to a wheel frame (48). Suitable for use with the stacking trolley is a stackable chair (46), the front legs (8) of which have a smaller outer distance between them than the inner distance between the rear legs (10). In addition, the width of the seat shell (2) is smaller than the inner width between the rear legs, and, as a result, the chair can be slid onto a chair of identical design, starting from the front and sliding to the rear. <IMAGE>

title: Beautifying liquid injection device for mask production
abstract: The utility model discloses a beautifying liquid injection device for mask production, and belongs to the field of beauty makeup industry. The device comprises a box body and an output port in the bottom of the box body, a partition plate is arranged in the box body, the bottom of the partition plate is connected with a sleeve, the input end of a water pump is connected with a liquid conveying pipe, the liquid conveying pipe is located in the sleeve, and the lower end of the liquid conveying pipe extends downwards in the sleeve; a spiral heating plate is connected in the box body, the outer wall of the box body is connected with a heat source generator, the heat source generator is electrically connected with the spiral heating plate, and the end, away from the water pump, of the liquid spraying pipe is located above the spiral heating plate; according to the utility model, the solidification phenomenon can be prevented, meanwhile, the spiral sheet is used for stirring at the bottom ofthe box body, a stock solution at the bottom of the box body can be turned over to prevent the stock solution from depositing, and the ultraviolet lamp at the top of the spiral heating plate is usedfor carrying out ultraviolet sterilization on the stock solution flowing on the spiral heating plate, so that the quality of the stock solution is improved.

title: RESEALABLE BEVERAGE CAN LID
abstract: A resealable beverage can lid is disclosed having a lid having a top side having a first scored opening and a second scored opening and a bottom side, a first rivet formed in the lid and extending outwardly from the top side of the lid, a second rivet formed in the lid and extending outwardly from the bottom side of the lid, the second scored opening encompassing the first rivet and the second rivet, a tab portion connected to the first rivet, and a closure element connected to the second rivet.

title: Torque converter cover
abstract: A torque converter cover (3) has a rim (3a) which is created by deformation of the central area using a single piece of material. The rim is further shaped by the incorporation of a central depression in one end-surface. Finally, the cylindrical sides of the rim (3a) are machined to size and fit.

title: Preparation method of composite microsphere coating with adjustable hydrophobicity
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of hydrophobic materials, and particularly relates to a preparation method of a composite microsphere coating with adjustable hydrophobicity, and the preparation method comprises the following steps: preparing silicon dioxide spheres with different particle sizes by using TEOS as a silicon source, and modifying the silicon dioxide spheres with KH-570 respectively; then, allowing vinyl-terminated polydimethylsiloxane (VS 500) and hydrogen-containing silicone oil XL-1341 to be subjected to crosslinking to prepare silicone rubber microspheres; then compounding the two microspheres through hydrosilylation to obtain a composite microsphere; and finally, dispersing the composite microspheres in normal hexane to prepare the composite microsphere coating with adjustable hydrophobicity. The silicon dioxide pellets with different particle sizes are compounded with the silicon rubber microspheres through hydrosilylation to prepare the composite microspheres with different size ratios and double-size roughness, so that the hydrophobicity is adjusted by adjusting the size ratio of a subject to an object, and finally the microsphere coating with high hydrophobicity and high adhesion is obtained.

title: Transparent conductive layered structure and method of producing the same, and coating liquid for forming transparent conductive layer used in production of transparent conductive layered structure and method of producing the same
abstract: The present invention relates to a transparent conductive layered structure having a transparent substrate and a transparent conductive layer and transparent coating layer formed in succession on this substrate, used in, for instance, the front panel of CRT, etc., display devices. The main components of said transparent conductive layer are noble metal microparticles with a mean particle diameter of 1 to 100 nm, wherein the microparticles are made from gold and/or platinum and silver and the gold and/or platinum content is within a range exceeding 50 wt% up to 95 wt%, and a binder matrix. Moreover, the main components of the coating liquid used to form a transparent conductive layer in the production of a transparent conductive layered structure are solvent and noble metal-coated silver microparticles with a mean particle diameter of 1 to 100 nm dispersed in this solvent, wherein the surface of the silver microparticles is coated with gold or platinum only or a compound of gold and platinum and the gold and/or platinum content is within a range exceeding 50 wt% up to 95 wt%.

title: Resin injector
abstract: The utility model relates to a resin injector which comprises a cylinder, a piston, a piston rod and an injecting seat, wherein, one side of the piston arranged in the syringe type cylinder is connected with the inner end of the piston rod of which the outer end is connected with a handle; the injecting seat is connected with the front end of the cylinder via threads. The upper part of the piston rod is provided with a flat wing, and the shaft center of the piston rod is provided with an injecting through hole of which the inner end is provided with a reflux prevention port. One part of the piston rod, which is positioned in the cylinder, is sheathed with a coil spring. The back end of the cylinder is provided with a cover body via threads. Both ends of the coil spring are respectively supported between the inner side of the cover body and the inner side of the piston. The center of the cover body is provided with a flat hole fitted with the section of the flat wing of the piston rod. The injecting through hole of the utility model can be connected with an injecting machine for high-pressure injection. Resin left in the cylinder after high-pressure injection can be continuously pressed in cracks via the strong spring in the utility model, and the strong uniform elastic force of the strong spring is used for durably pressing the resin in, so that remote tiny cracks can be repaired to enhance the quality of members. The flat wing of the piston rod can be pulled out from the cover body, rotated at a certain angle and fixed, so that the spring lies in the compression state. When the piston is needed for injection, the piston rod is rotated back till the flat wing is inserted in the flat hole on the cover body, so the resin injector is transformed to the injecting state. The utility model has the advantages of convenient operation and labor saving.

title: Avocado-containing fiber capable of conditioning skin and preparation method of avocado-containing fiber
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of textiles, in particular to avocado-containing fiber capable of conditioning skin and a preparation method of the avocado-containing fiber. The avocado-containing fiber comprises the following raw materials in parts by mass: 2-5 parts of an avocado extracting solution, 2-10 parts of fiber forming polymer, 1-4 parts of an additive, 10-20 parts of firstcoagulating bath, 0.2-1 part of an antioxidant, 2-5 parts of polyester filament yarns, 10-20 parts of ethanol, 30-50 parts of purified water and 10-20 parts of second coagulating bath. The prepared fiber is rich in various plant essential oils, can condition the skin, is good in size stability and heat stability, can be widely applied to the field of textiles, and is particularly suitable for health care products such as infant products, mask base materials and daily necessities.

title: Preparation method of multi-phase and multi-scale AlSiMgNiCu high-silicon aluminum-based composite material
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of a multi-phase and multi-scale AlSiMgNiCu high-silicon aluminum-based composite material, and relates to a preparation method of a high-silicon aluminum-based composite material. The invention aims to solve the technical problems that the performance of the existing high-silicon aluminum-based composite material is influenced by a thick primary Si phase, the machining difficulty is high, and the manufacturing cost is high. According to the AlSiMgNiCu high-silicon aluminum-based composite material and the preparation method thereof, the AlSiMgNiCu high-silicon aluminum-based composite material with eight precipitated phases is finally obtained through reasonable component design, addition of a certain amount of alterant and refiner and extrusion casting of semi-solid slurry under a high-pressure condition, formation of a coarse primary Si phase is effectively inhibited, the size of the Si phase is obviously refined and is about 20 microns, and the size of the Si phase is about 20 microns. And meanwhile, an alpha-Al matrix and other precipitated phases are refined to different degrees, and a uniformly-distributed multi-phase and multi-scale microscopic structure is formed.

title: SEMICONDUCTOR MANUFACTURING EQUIPMENT
abstract: PURPOSE:To make it possible to selectively remove, at a high accuracy, unwanted resist films only formed at the outer peripheral portion of a wafer and also prevent the occurrence of pin holes in resist films due to splashing of a chemical solution for dissolving resist films. CONSTITUTION:This is a semiconductor production equipment 10 for forming a thin film on the surface of a wafer 1 by coating a required chemical solution by rotation on the wafer 1; and it comprises a cover 4 for covering a region inside the outer peripheral portion 3 of the surface of the wafer 1 placed on a wafer-placing base 7 with a gap maintained between the cover and the wafer surface and an etching solution dripping nozzle 6 for dripping a solution for etching a thin film formed on the surface of the wafer 1.

title: POS data communication method, device, terminal device and system
abstract: The invention provides a POS data communication method. The method comprises the following steps: determining whether a POS terminal in a wireless network is connected for the first time; If yes, receiving a pairing request from the POS terminal, and establishing a connection with the POS terminal based on the pairing request; and if not, reading a pre-stored Mac address corresponding to the POS terminal from a pre-stored list of the Mac addresses, and establishing connection with the POS terminal according to the pre-stored Mac address. The POS terminal actively initiates a pairing request and successfully pairs for one time; and if the subsequent Bluetooth needs to be reconnected due to disconnection, the paired POS card reader can also be automatically connected back to the POS terminalthrough the Bluetooth, and the POS terminal does not need to initiate the pairing request again, so that the trouble that the POS terminal initiates the pairing request for multiple times is solved.

title: Special dismounting device for screw pump
abstract: The invention discloses a dismounting device for a screw pump. The dismounting device for the screw pump comprises a pin shaft dismounting device and a stator and rotor dismounting device. According to the dismounting device for the screw pump provided by the invention, the stator and rotor dismounting device and the pin shaft dismounting device are combined for use, so that the screw pump can berapidly dismounted and maintained, the maintenance time is saved, the labor cost is reduced, and the operation safety is also improved. The dismounting device for the screw pump has the advantage of low cost, is convenient for enterprises to better improve the production efficiency, and avoids severe economic loss caused by long-time delay.

title: SMALL ANIMAL DETECTION SYSTEM, SMALL ANIMAL DETECTION METHOD AND PROGRAM
abstract: To provide a small animal detection system, small animal detection method and program capable of detecting small animals through a simple structure.SOLUTION: A small animal detection system includes: a moving body detection sensor that is installed in a facility; an acquisition unit that acquires moving body detection data detected by the moving body detection sensor; and an estimation unit that estimates whether a small animal or a human has entered and is currently inside in the facility on the basis of the moving body detection data acquired by the acquisition unit.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: APPARATUS AND METHOD FOR SCREENING GEL COATED SEED
abstract:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an apparatus and method for screening gel coated seed, which can conduct differentiation in any color wavelength region by eliminating an irregular reflection caused by surface roughness of a gel coating.

SOLUTION: This gel coated seed screening apparatus 14 comprises a transfer device 5 in which a storage part 2 for storing gel coated seeds 1 rotates seed storage rotators 4, provided at equal intervals on an outer peripheral end 3, in a direction indicated by an arrow T to transfer the gel coated seeds. This apparatus further comprises a feeder 6 for storing a given amount of gel coated seeds 1 fed along the outer peripheral end 3 in the transfer device 5 and for feeding the gel coated seeds 1 one by one to the storage part 2, an immersion device 8 for immersing the gel coated seeds 1, fed to the storage part 2, in a liquid 7, a differentiating device 9 for judging whether the gel coated seeds 1 are acceptable or unacceptable in such a state that the gel coated seeds 1 are immersed in the liquid 7, and a discharge device 11 for discharging the differentiated gel coated seeds 1 to a storage part 10.

title: Children game human bowling device
abstract: The utility model discloses a children game human body bowling device which comprises a base, a bowling ball body, a bowling ball body, a bowling ball body and a bowling ball body, the first vertical plate is fixed on one side of the base; the second vertical plate is fixed to the other side of the base, and the first vertical plate and the second vertical plate are both perpendicular to the base; and the slip rope rail is fixed between the first vertical plate and the second vertical plate. The sliding rope swing has the advantages that the conventional stimulation playing method function of the sliding rope swing is achieved, and the impact stimulation sense is added, so that the playing method is more interesting; the bowling scene is added, so that the playing method is more special and immersive, children can have certain preliminary understanding of the bowling sports, and the insight is increased.

title: Improvements in and relating to Electric Junction Boxes for Telephone Systems.
abstract: 28,127. Sch÷rg, L., and L÷hner, K, [trading as Schorg, F.]. Dec. 11, 1905, [date applied for under Patents Act, 1901]. Man-hole doors and frames.-The cover of an electric junction or terminal box for underground telephone systems is made with a groove f to correspond with a similar groove in the lower half, the two grooves forming, when the cover is in position, a channel which can be filled through the holes g with ' Bergmann ' or similar waterproof cement ; a screw plug h is also provided so that the box can be connected to a pressure or vacuum pump for joint-testing purposes. The cover is held on by a single screw k, carried on a pivoted yoke i.

title: APPLICATION OF SOLDER TO CONNECTOR
abstract: PURPOSE:To stabilize junction between a connecter and a mother board by providing a flange at one side of a cylindrical solder and engaging the solder into a throughhole in the mother board and letting it reflow. CONSTITUTION:A cylindrical solder 13 molded in the form of an eye rivet is engaged into a throughhole 1-1 provided in a mother board 1 from the side of a connecter 2. A pin 2-1 of the connector 2 is put through the inside of the cylindrical solder 13 to apply the connecter 2 to the mother board 1. The solder 13 is let to reflow under an atmosphere of high temperatures in this condition, so the throuhhole 1-1 and the pin 2-1 are connected with each other. The fused solder 13 is not scattered to the tip of the pin 2-1, but filled in the hole 12-1 instead, thereby a stable junction of a good reliability can be achieved.

title: CONTROL CIRCUIT FOR A VAPOUR PROVISION SYSTEM
abstract: A control circuit for a vapour provision system comprises a first controller with capability to control a first set of components in the vapour provision system; a second controller with capability to control a second set of components in the vapour provision system, at least one component in the second set being also in the first set; and a communication link between the first controller and the second controller by which at least one controller can monitor operation of the other controller; wherein one or both controllers is operable to, via the communication link, detect a fault with the capability of the other controller to control the at least one component and, in response, assume control of the at least one component.

title: Equipment calibration method and device, storage medium and electronic device
abstract: The invention discloses an equipment calibration method and device, a storage medium and an electronic device. The method comprises the steps that an operation instruction of a target object is received through a client side of a terminal; a first target audio is played to a plurality of pieces of target equipment in response to the operation instruction, and first energy values fed back after the plurality of pieces of target equipment respond to the first target audio are received, wherein the distances between the plurality of pieces of target equipment and the terminal are within a preset range, and the first energy values are used for calibrating first target components of the plurality of pieces of target equipment; after the calibration of the first target components of the plurality of pieces of target equipment is completed, specified equipment in the plurality of pieces of target equipment is indicated to play a second target audio, and second energy values obtained after the plurality of pieces of target equipment respond to the second target audio are received for calibrating second target components of the plurality of pieces of target equipment; and after the calibration of the second target components is completed, a compensation coefficient matrix determined according to the first energy values and the second energy values is sent to the plurality of pieces of target equipment, so that the plurality of pieces of target equipment calibrate the first target components and the second target components according to the compensation coefficient matrix.

title: Stiff skeleton structure for bridge closure
abstract: The utility model provides a stiff skeleton structure for bridge closure. The stiff skeleton structure comprises a first tooth base, a second tooth base, pre-burying boards, reserved bolts, a skeleton beam and an adjusting cushion block. The first tooth base and the second toot base are oppositely arranged on the two sides of a bridge closure segment respectively, a first closure face is formed on the first tooth base, and a second closure face is formed in the second tooth base. The pre-burying boards are fixedly arranged on the first closure face and the second closure face respectively. The reserved bolts are fixedly arranged on the pre-burying boards respectively. The skeleton beam comprises a first connection end and a second connection end, the first connection end is fixedly connected to and abuts against the first closure face through the reserved bolts, the second connection end is fastened to the reserved bolts on the second closure face, and a length adjusting interval is formed between the second connection end and the second closure face. The adjusting cushion block is arranged in the length adjusting interval, and at least one side in the length adjusting interval tightly abuts against the second connection end, so that the interval between the second connection end and the second closure face is controlled. By means of the stiff skeleton structure, the problem that an existing skeleton cannot be used repeatedly is solved, and the adjustability, efficiency and quality of bridge closure construction are further improved.

title: Flight-shaped two-phase mixing and intensified burning apparatus
abstract: The invention provides a spiral fin-shaped two-phase mixing and supplemental firing device, which belongs to the technical fields of two-phase mixing device and supplemental firing device. The device is applicable to gas-liquid two-phase mixing and similar supplemental firing of flame moving to the lower reaches of a detonation tube. The invention is characterized by comprising a plurality of evenly distributed spiral fins, wherein, the thread pitch of the spiral fins is 25mm to 300mm; the number of the spiral fins is determined by both the total block area ratio and the width of the spiral fins, wherein, the total block area ratio is between 40 percent and 60 percent. The invention overcomes the shortcomings of the prior art, reduces kinetic energy loss of the gas flow, and evenly distributes the turbulence level.

title: SEED TRAY
abstract: Seed tray (1), provided with a number of essentially cylindrical passages (4) spaced from each other and extending vertically between the main surfaces (2,3) of the tray (1), each of which passages (4) has a supporting rim (8) at one of the main surfaces (3) of the tray (1), said rim (8') being suitable for holding thereon a seed pot, each passage (4) being provided with at least one rib (5) running essentially in the longitudinal direction of the passage (4). <IMAGE>

title: Wind tunnel type turbine generator
abstract: A disclosed wind tunnel type turbine generator comprises a wind tunnel apparatus with thermal insulation property, the wind tunnel apparatus comprises an air-inflow constriction section, a test section and an exhaust expansion section; the front end of the air-inflow constriction section is provided with an air compressor; the front end of the air compressor is provided with a heating member; and the test section is inside provided with an airflow turbine connected with a power generator. Therefore, by heating air passing through the air compressor by means of the heating member, a high-speed airflow is formed in the test section of the wind tunnel apparatus and drives the airflow turbine to rotate to generate electric power, and also steam is prevented from being coagulated at an outlet of the airflow turbine because of low temperature, and thus the electric generating effect is guaranteed.

title: Sensing temperature changes just corrugated container board of auto -enhancement structure
abstract: The utility model relates to a sensing temperature changes just corrugated container board of auto -enhancement structure, include from interior past interior corrugated board, the layer that absorbs water, waterproof layer, signal shielding layer, elastic layer and the outer corrugated board who sets gradually outward, be provided with a core section of thick bamboo between interior corrugated board and the outer corrugated board, a core section of thick bamboo pierces through the layer that absorbs water, waterproof layer, signal shielding layer and elastic layer and interior corrugated board and outer corrugated board are connected respectively to both ends, interior corrugated board corresponds a core section of thick bamboo with outer corrugated board surface and is provided with interior conducting strip and outer conducting strip respectively, interior conducting strip is connected through a heat conduction stick that sets up in a core section of thick bamboo with outer conducting strip, heat conduction stick overcoat is equipped with the sealed air bag of annular elasticity, air bag set up a core section of thick bamboo and heat conduction stick enclose close the cavity that forms in, outer conducting strip surface coating has the themochromic layer.

title: Tipping paper length abnormity detection system
abstract: The utility model discloses a tipping paper length abnormity detection system. The extension direction of a first mounting bracket of the tipping paper length abnormity detection system is the same asthe extension direction of a central shaft of a detection drum; the second mounting bracket is connected with the first mounting bracket in a sliding fit manner; the second mounting bracket is provided with a detection surface extending along the circumferential direction of the detection drum wheel and a detection hole extending along the extending direction of the detection surface; the tippingpaper position detection mechanism comprises a first detection unit and a detection driving unit; the abnormal cigarette position detection mechanism comprises a second detection unit. The tipping paper position detection mechanism of the tipping paper length abnormity detection system can detect the position of the tipping paper of the cigarette on the detection drum; and the abnormal cigaretteposition detection mechanism can detect the position of the cigarette with abnormal tipping paper length on the detection drum wheel.

title: AEROSOL-GENERATING DEVICE
abstract: An aerosol-generating device is disclosed. The aerosol-generating device of the disclosure includes a housing having an insertion space, a heater configured to heat a stick inserted into the insertion space, at least one sensor configured to output a signal corresponding to the insertion space, a power circuit electrically connected to the heater to transmit power to the heater, and a signal circuit electrically connected to the sensor to transmit a signal corresponding to the sensor. The power circuit includes a low-pass filter.

title: Stirring and pressurizing type instant tea powder hollow granulating device
abstract: The utility model provides a stirring and pressurizing type instant tea powder hollow granulating device, and belongs to the technical field of instant tea production. The device comprises a concentrated solution storage tank and a carbon dioxide storage tank, the concentrated solution storage tank is connected with a pressurized mixing tank through a first plunger pump, the pressurized mixing tank is provided with a stirrer, the carbon dioxide storage tank is connected with the pressurized mixing tank, the pressurized mixing tank is connected with a second plunger pump, and the second plungerpump is connected with a spray drying tower. According to the utility model, carbon dioxide and tea concentrate can be stably fed respectively without mutual influence, the feeding process is stableand reliable, the feeding device is suitable for large-batch production operation, and hollow instant tea powder is obtained.

title: Undergroung Water Supply System
abstract: An underground water supply system having an induction groove which is opened on one side which gets to the pointed end part from the inlet port is provided. The system is simple in structure and easy to mold and thus reduces the manufacturing cost. In the conventional underground water supply system comprising a pumping device for pumping water in a storage tank, an inlet port(12) for supplying the pumped water to the ground and a water supply device(10) with a pointed end part(13) at the lower part, an induction groove(20) is formed at the lower part of the inlet port and opened on one side which gets to the pointed end part. A main hose has a plurality of connecting holes and is connected to the pumping device. A scale(15) is formed the outer peripheral surface of the water supply means to indicate the depth.

title: Reinforcing steel bar hoisting device for capping beam construction
abstract: The utility model discloses a reinforcing steel bar hoisting device for capping beam construction, which belongs to the technical field of bridge construction and comprises a bearing section, a hoisting rope and a hoisting hook, each bearing section is an arc-shaped block, the bearing sections are sequentially connected to form a bearing beam, a through hole is formed in the middle of the side face of each bearing section in a penetrating mode, a lifting rope is arranged above the bearing beam, the two ends of the lifting rope are connected with the through holes in the two ends of the bearing beam respectively, and the lower portion of each through hole is connected with a lifting hook through a rope. The device disclosed by the utility model has the advantage of uniform stress, and can solve the problem that the straight beam is extremely easy to damage due to non-uniform stress of the straight beam.

title: Oxiracetam freeze-dried powder preparation and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to an oxiracetam freeze-dried powder preparation and a preparation method thereof. The preparation comprises: a. an active component: a compound with a structure of formula (I) and a molecular formula of C6H10N2O3*0.25H20 (I); b. a freeze-drying protective agent. Samples of the obtained freeze-dried powder preparation are subjected to a 6-month accelerated test and a 36-month long-term stability test under a commercial packing condition, and the tests observe that each detection index is within the scope prescribed by the quality standard and shows no obvious change. Thus, the preparation of the invention has stable quality under a commercial packing condition.

title: LOUDSPEAKER CIRCUIT
abstract: PURPOSE:To attain simultaneous loudspeaker talking without feeling of disorder by switching a loss of a variable loss element inserted respectively to a transmission circuit and a reception circuit alternately at a frequency higher than the voice frequency so as to prevent howling. CONSTITUTION:A variable loss element AS1 is inserted to the transmission circuit amplifying an output of a microphone MC and sending the result to line L1, L2 via a side tone prevention circuit CL, and a variable loss element AS2 is inserted to the reception circuit amplifying a reception signal from the lines L1, L2 via the circuit CL and sending the result to a speaker SP. The control circuit CT switches the high loss state and the low loss state of both the elements AS1, AS2 alternately at a frequency being twice or over the voice frequency. Since either of the elements AS1, AS2 is in the high loss state at all times, the loop gain is always the unity or below in a closed circuit comprising microphone transmission circuit reception circuit speaker microphone and no oscillation takes place. Moreover, since the switching frequency is higher than the voice frequency, it is not perceived.

title: Single-layer blade driving device for beam-limiter of X-ray apparatus
abstract: The utility model relates to a medical instrument, in particular to a single-layer blade driving device for a beam-limiter of X-ray apparatus, which comprises a horizontal blade and a vertical blade, wherein the horizontal blade and the vertical blade are arranged on a beam-limiter substrate; the horizontal blade is fixed on a horizontal blade bracket after being connected to one end of a horizontal driving wire rope; a horizontal blade guide rail is arranged in a guide rail hole of the horizontal blade bracket; the horizontal driving wire rope passes by a horizontal reversing idler wheel along the vertical direction after passing through horizontal guiding idler wheels arranged on four corners of the beam-limiter substrate; the vertical blade is fixed on a vertical blade bracket after being connected to one end of a vertical driving wire rope; a vertical blade guide rail is arranged in the guide rail hole of the vertical blade bracket; and the vertical driving wire rope passes by a vertical reversing idler wheel along the vertical direction after passing through vertical guiding idler wheels arranged on four corners of the beam-limiter substrate. The single-layer blade driving device has simple structure, is low in cost and can be used for efficiently shielding redundant X-rays.

title: Improvements relating to riveting machines
abstract: 289,539. Brittain, F. C., and Westing- house Brake & Saxby Signal Co., Ltd. Jan. 28, 1927. Riveting. - A percussive riveting tool 6 is mounted eccentrically in a sleeve 11 which is itself eccentrically mounted in a fixed sleeve 12, the relative angular positions of the tool and the sleeve 11 being adjustable by handwheels 15, 18 so that the tool may be displaced from the work axis by an amount varying from zero to the sum of the eccentricities of the tool and the sleeve 11. The sleeve 9 may be rotated by pawl and ratchet mechanism driven by compressed air. The work may be carried in a frame to which the tool is attached, or the tool may be mounted on a radial arm so as to be vertically, radially and angularly adjustable. The outer sleeve 12 may be under control of a piston to advance or retract the tool relatively to the work.

title: Lantern-shaped water treatment biological stuffing sleeve
abstract: The invention relates to a lantern-shaped water treatment biological stuffing sleeve which comprises a stuffing sleeve body and connecting units.Two ends of each layer of the stuffing sleeve body are opposite end to end, each connecting unit is fixed between the corresponding two ends and composed of two connecting lines in a direction parallel to axis of the stuffing sleeve, the axis of the stuffing sleeve is enabled to be on a plane formed by the two connecting lines, namely the corresponding connecting unit and enabled to have an equal distance to the connecting lines, and an included angle between planes formed by each two adjacent connecting units is 1-35 degrees.Round openings are formed at two ends of the stuffing sleeve body, the stuffing sleeve is lantern-shaped and is hollow inside, the shape of the stuffing sleeve body has certain radian, grids are distributed on the surface of the stuffing sleeve body in longitude-latitude direction, and the inside of the stuffing sleeve body can be seen through the surface.The stuffing sleeve is made of a relatively hard material, stuffing penetrates into the inside of the stuffing sleeve for working, the stuffing sleeve on the outer layer can effectively prevent a stuffing hanging film inside from being affected by hydraulic impact and can protect the hanging film from being damaged due to the fact that the stuffing is distributed closely and wound mutually, and efficiency of the stuffing during actual running is improved.

title: Color-adjustable lighting assembly
abstract: The utility model discloses a lighting assembly with an adjustable color. The lamp comprises a mounting bottom plate, a lower clamp, a bearing plate, a lampshade and a box body, adsorption discs are mounted at the four corners of the bottom of the mounting bottom plate correspondingly. A stabilizing sucker is mounted in the middle of the bottom end of the mounting bottom plate, a lower clamp is mounted at the top end of the mounting bottom plate, an upper clamp meshed with the lower clamp is mounted at the top end of the lower clamp, a bearing plate is mounted at the top end of the upper clamp, a damping spring is mounted at the top end of the bearing plate, and a stabilizing rod is mounted at the top end of the damping spring. The device is provided with the lower clamp and the adsorptiondisc arranged at the bottom end of the mounting bottom plate; two placement modes can be adopted for the device, the device can be clamped to a bed head through mutual cooperation of the lower clampand the upper clamp, or the mounting bottom plate can be prevented from toppling over through the adsorption disc at the bottom end of the mounting bottom plate, the stability of the device is enhanced, and the device can be effectively prevented from toppling over.

title: Device for uniformly stirring and mixing raw materials
abstract: A device for uniformly stirring and mixing raw materials relates to the field of mechanical stirring equipment, and comprises a movable shaft, a hollow shaft, a tank body and a tank cover, a solid column is arranged at one end of the hollow shaft, and a plurality of linear guide grooves are formed in a shaft body of the hollow shaft. A stirring motor is mounted at the bottom of the tank body, an output shaft of the stirring motor is correspondingly connected with a solid column of the hollow shaft, and a first stirring paddle is fixed on the outer wall of the hollow shaft; a limiting sleeve is fixed to the center of the tank cover, the outer end of the movable shaft is sleeved with a rotary supporting sleeve, the rotary supporting sleeve and the movable shaft are rotationally connected and axially fixed, and a telescopic cylinder capable of driving the rotary supporting sleeve to vertically move is installed on the upper surface of the tank cover. The inner end of the movable shaft is correspondingly inserted into the hollow shaft, a shaft body of the movable shaft is fixedly provided with a sliding sheet which is matched with the section of the linear guide groove and can slide along the linear guide groove, and the outer end of the sliding sheet is fixedly provided with a second stirring paddle; according to the raw material stirring and uniform mixing device, the distance between the stirring paddles can be changed in the stirring process, so that the uniform mixing effect is improved.

title: Trimming jaw and processing table of burr removing device
abstract: The invention provides a trimming jaw and a processing table of a burr removing device. According to the invention, the trimming jaw can be mounted easily. The trimming jaw is used for removing burrson the inner surface of a puller body of a zipper. The trimming jaw includes a pair of carrier parts (3a, 3a) arranged on a pair of side bases (4a, 4a) that are arranged in a spaced manner in the leftand right direction; a pair of side jaw parts (3b, 3b) protruding from the carrier parts in a manner of narrowing the gap between the side jaw parts, guiding the puller body (90) in a manner of linear movement in the forward and backward direction and used for removing burrs formed on the inner surface of an inner passage (98) penetrating through the puller body in the forward and backward direction; and a joint part (3c) connected to a pair of the carrier parts above the side jaw parts, wherein a pair of the carrier parts, a pair of the side jaw parts and the joint part are arranged integrally.

title: Doppler frequency shift compensation method and device
abstract: The invention relates to the field of communication, in particular to a Doppler frequency shift compensation method and device, which are used for ensuring the consistency of a terminal side and a network side in Doppler frequency shift compensation. The method comprises the following steps that: a network side indicates Doppler compensation reference information preset for each beam cell in a satellite coverage area to a terminal side, so that a terminal accessed to each beam cell can obtain a Doppler compensation value of the terminal side in time, and the consistency of the terminal side and the network side in Doppler frequency shift compensation is ensured; the terminal side and the network side can jointly compensate and eliminate Doppler frequency shift caused by satellite movementaccording to unified configuration information, the influence caused by Doppler frequency shift is eliminated to the maximum extent, the communication performance of the system is guaranteed, the Doppler frequency shift compensation problem caused by satellite movement is effectively solved, the data communication performance of the terminal is ensured, and the service reliability of a satellite communication system is improved.

title: Composite heat-preservation system steel bar truss welding forming production line and truss production method
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of wire mesh machining device, and discloses a composite heat-preservation system steel bar truss welding forming production line and a truss production method. The composite heat-preservation system steel bar truss welding forming production line is mainly technically characterized in that a straightening mechanism, a welding mechanism, a net pull mechanism, a net cutting mechanism, a net piece sending mechanism, a bending mechanism and a discharging mechanism are included; the welding mechanism comprises one or more pairs of horizontal wire positioning mechanisms, each horizontal wire positioning mechanism comprises a fixing base and a fixing bracket, a spring steel sheet is arranged on the upper portion of each fixing bracket, a fixed ruler head is arranged at the front end of each spring steel sheet, a transverse wire penetrating hole is formed in each fixed ruler head, a wire outlet is formed in the front end of each wire penetrating hole, and a magnetic block is arranged at the rear end of each wire penetrating hole; and the bending mechanism comprises an upper bending cutter and a lower bending cutter corresponding to the upper bending cutter, a wire-jacking clamping groove with the section being semicircular is formed in the upper portion of the lower bending cutter, and a net piece conveying rack is located between the upperbending cutter and the lower bending cutter. When a net piece is pulled forwards, a transverse bar is pulled out from the wire outlet, the net piece is uplifted, abrasion of a lower electrode is avoided, the bent net piece is hooked by a discharging hook, and discharging is facilitated.

title: Cable bridge convenient to overhaul
abstract: The utility model discloses a cable bridge convenient to overhaul, which comprises a fixed frame, a top cover and a bottom plate, the top cover and the bottom plate are connected to the top end and the bottom end of the fixed frame, the two sides of the fixed frame are connected with liftable side plates, and the bottom plate is connected with a pressing mechanism used for synchronously pressing the two side plates. The pressing mechanism comprises four positioning heads, two L-shaped plates, a fixing seat, a stud, a threaded block and two push-pull plates, the two positioning heads are connected to the corresponding L-shaped plates, the end of the stud is rotationally connected to the fixing seat, the stud is used for driving the threaded block to ascend and descend, the two ends of each push-pull plate are connected with the corresponding L-shaped plates and the corresponding threaded block, and the two ends of each push-pull plate are connected with the corresponding L-shaped plates and the corresponding threaded block. The fixing base is connected with a positioning mechanism used for positioning the two L-shaped plates. According to the cable bridge, the two side plates can be synchronously loosened, the transverse plate can be lifted to drive the two side plates to synchronously move upwards, the two side plates can be conveniently fixed again, at the moment, the two sides of the fixing frame are in an open state, the interior of the cable bridge can be conveniently overhauled, the operation space is large, and practicability is high.

title: DATA WRITE ARRANGEMENT FOR COLOR GRAPHIC DISPLAY UNIT
abstract: A plurality of color graphic memories (41,51,61) are assigned the same address space, and are connected to a common data bus (X1). It is determined by a separately output memory select data which one of the color graphic memories (41,51,61) is to be written into. In the case of writing the same data into two or more of the color graphic memories (41,51,61) at the same address, the color graphic memories to be written into are selected by the memory select data first and then the same data is written into the selected colour graphic memories in the same write cycle.

title: IMAGE PROCESSOR AND RECORDING MEDIUM
abstract:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an image processor and a recording medium allowing the automatic execution of the control or the like of a system on an image processor side on the basis of taken-in image data.

SOLUTION: An image database wherein a plurality of photographed images are previously associated to prescribed processing and stored is created and stored in a storage medium 8. When photographing an object by a camera 20, a CPU 1 in a mobile terminal 10 compares the photographed image with an image stored in the image database, and executes processing corresponding to an approximate image.
