title: Sludge drying device
abstract: The invention provides a sludge drying device. A lifting device which is capable of integrally lifting a sludge pool is arranged at the bottom of the sludge pool, a cutter and a guide rail are arranged above the sludge pool, and the cutter can move along the guide rail; a nozzle is arranged on the upper part of the cutter, the cutter includes a left blade and a right blade which are arranged in aconical shape, and the guide rail is fixedly connected with vertical telescopic rods; hot water pipes are arranged on the outer circumstance and the bottom surface of the sludge pool, the hot water pipes are connected to a solar heating device, and through illuminating of the sludge pool and heating of the hot water pipes, drying of sludge is accelerated, and meanwhile when the dried sludge needsto be transported out after drying, the whole sludge pool can be lifted out of the ground by the lifting device; then the sludge is cut into multiple pieces by the cutter, so that the sludge pieces are moved to a sludge cart through a forklift conveniently, and the sludge at different positions can be cut through the cutter moving along the guide rail.

title: Automatic alarm device used in tall formwork system, and working method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses an automatic alarm device used in a tall formwork system, and a working method thereof. The key point of the technical scheme is as follows: a BGK-4000 strain gauge has a length of about 165 mm, mounting blocks are arranged on the two ends of the BGK-4000 strain gauge and are fixed on a steel pipe by screws, each mounting block comprises a sensor, two thermistors are arranged at the middle end of the strain gauge, the sensors on the two ends reflect the strain change conditions on the steel pipe to the thermistors through steel dazzle, then the thermistors are connected with an information collector through communication cables, the information collector converts a resistance change value into a corresponding strain value by calculation, and finally transmits the collected steel pipe strain value to the Internet cloud through a 4G base station to convert the strain value into a stress value, and the automatic alarm device disclosed by the invention has the advantages that monitoring points are arranged and a complete tall formwork automatic alarm system is established to completely meet the monitoring demands of a tall formwork supporting system.

title: REINFORCED DOOR FRAME
abstract: A door frame made up of two jamb sections and a head section connected together to fit into a rough door opening. The sections are made up of an elongated, generally channel-shaped member, generally z-shaped member having a first wall disposed parallel to the legs of the channel. Surfaces of the z-shaped member are supported in spaced, parallel relation to the surfaces of the channel member, providing spaces to receive wall material therebetween.

title: Device for carrying out moisture-proof treatment for packaging paper preparation
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of packaging paper preparation, and discloses a device for carrying out moisture-proof treatment for packaging paper preparation. The device comprises a lower conveying structure and an upper conveying structure; the lower conveying structure comprises two supporting plates I, the two ends of the bottom of each supporting plate I are connected with one ends of electric telescopic rod, the other ends of the electric telescopic rods are connected with the top of a supporting column, and the bottom of the supporting column is connected with the ground; and the upper conveying structure comprises two supporting plates II, the supporting plates I are located above the supporting plates II, and the two supporting plates II are connected with the ground through fixing rods. According to the device for carrying out the moisture-proof treatment for the packaging paper preparation, through arrangement of electric telescopic rods I, the heights of the supporting plates I can be changed through stretching and retracting of the electric telescopic rods I, the distance between the supporting plates I and the supporting plates II can be changed, packaging paper of different thicknesses can be conveyed through the device, and the packaging paper of different thicknesses can be conveniently covered with films; and the practicability of the device is improved.

title: Novel constant velocity cardan joint assembly
abstract: The utility model discloses a novel constant velocity cardan joint assembly, aims at providing a body building device which has the advantages of simple structure, fix constant velocity cardan joint assembly effectual and that the practicality is strong to the balancing piece, its technical scheme main points are equipped with fixed subassembly between balancing piece and the connecting axle, fixed subassembly is including setting up the adapter sleeve on the balancing piece, set up in the clamp of connecting epaxial connection annular and being used for connecting the adapter sleeve and connecting the annular, be equipped with a plurality of spacing rings on the adapter sleeve, be equipped with the spacing groove with spacing ring looks adaptation on the connection annular, the utility model is suitable for an auto -parts technical field.

title: NETWORK RELAY DEVICE AND PACKET TRANSFER CONTROL METHOD
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a network relay device with a shared buffer system which can suppress degradation of throughput at the time of congestion detection, and a packet transfer control method.SOLUTION: A network relay device includes: a congestion notification section 3 for determining a mark rate to add congestion detection information using a marking curve in which the mark rate is set to be 0% when a buffer quantity of a port or a queue which has detected the congestion is equal to or less than mark starting quantity, the mark rate is set to be 100% when the buffer quantity is equal to or more than the maximum mark quantity, and the mark rate is set so as to increase, in proportion to the buffer quantity, from 0% of the mark rate to the maximum mark rate when the buffer quantity is more than the mark starting quantity and less than the maximum buffer quantity; and a mark rate adjustment section 4 for changing one or more of the mark starting quantity, the maximum mark quantity, and the maximum mark rate in response to the amount of change of the maximum buffer amount when the maximum buffer amount which can be used for each port or queue is changed.

title: DRYING PREDICTION SYSTEM AND DRYING PREDICTION PROGRAM
abstract: To predict drying time no matter what type an object to be dried is, as there is no need for classification regarding a material of the object to be dried.SOLUTION: A drying prediction system includes: a moisture sensor 10 for measuring moisture content data of an object to be dried; first detection means 27-1 for detecting whether or not the moisture content data acquired during measurement has exceeded a drying completion moisture threshold value; second detection means 27-2 for detecting a change amount of the moisture content data which is acquired during measurement from moisture content data for comparison before the measurement; drying time prediction means 28 for predicting the drying time based on the detection result by the first detection means 27-1 and the detection result by the second detection means 27-2; and prediction time output control means 29 for outputting the prediction time by the drying time prediction means 28.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Method for rapidly detecting type and content of flocculating agent in machine-made sand
abstract: The invention discloses a method for rapidly detecting the type and content of a flocculating agent in machine-made sand, and belongs to the technical field of machine-made sand detection. The method for rapidly detecting the type and content of the flocculating agent in the machine-made sand comprises the following steps: mixing and stirring the machine-made sand and water, standing, and observing whether supernatant is clear or not; if the machine-made sand is clarified, the machine-made sand contains the flocculating agent, and if the machine-made sand is not clarified, the machine-made sand does not contain the flocculating agent; after the flocculant is detected by the method, the type detection and the content detection are carried out. According to the method, whether the machine-made sand contains the flocculant or not can be rapidly and conveniently detected, the whole detection process can be completed only on the construction site, and the type and content of the flocculant can be distinguished, so that whether the detected machine-made sand is suitable for preparing concrete or not is judged in advance.

title: Combined assembly of tiles and fixing element. (Machine-translation by Google Translate, not legally binding)
abstract: Combined tile and fastening element assembly, characterized in that each tile has a shape such that it has a peripheral groove of conical cross section, said fastening elements having a substantially cruciform transverse shape; the horizontal ribs of which are inclined to adapt under pressure in the opposite grooves of the adjacent tiles and which have a depth equal to the thickness of the tiles and in which at least some of the fixing elements are nailed to some boards; slats or to a lower floor by means of a plurality of nails passing through them downwards forming a certain angle with the vertical; each tile being, except for the tiles located on the edge of the floor, coupled around its entire periphery with fastening elements in order to join the adjacent tiles. (Machine-translation by Google Translate, not legally binding)

title: Wave light spring device
abstract: The utility model relates to a wave light spring device. Wherein the support slides and lifts along the supporting carrier, the tank body is hinged to the support, the opening is formed in the upper portion of the tank body, the nozzle is communicated with the opening, the colored lamp is arranged in the tank body, the water inlet is formed in the lower portion of the tank body, and the water pumpis communicated with the water inlet. The supporting carrier is provided with a sliding rail for the support to slide and preventing the support from being disengaged. A limiting assembly for limiting movement of the supporting carrier in a damping mode is arranged between the supporting carrier and the support, the problem that under the condition that the heights of the liquid levels of pools are different, the nozzle of the wave light spring is still kept exposed out of the water surface is solved, and the advantage of keeping the original spraying height is achieved.

title: Vehicle collision safety warning recording device
abstract: The utility model discloses a vehicle collision safety warning recording device, which comprises an image processing chip, a singlechip, an image sensor arranged on the front part of an automobile, a vehicle speed sensor arranged on a middle axle of the automobile, a memory, a buzzer and a light-emitting diode, wherein the image sensor is connected with the image processing chip through an image decoding chip; the memory is connected with the image processing chip; and the image processing chip, the vehicle speed sensor, the buzzer and the light-emitting diode are connected with the singlechip respectively. By the device, a longitudinal distance between a vehicle ahead and a vehicle with the device can be accurately detected, whether the vehicle with the device is to collide with the vehicle ahead or not is judged according to the running status of the vehicle, and if the vehicle with the device is to collide with the vehicle ahead, sound and light alarming is started, and corresponding image information is stored at the same time; and moreover, the device is low in cost, simple in structure and convenient to mount.

title: -i(M)-ARY FSK RECEIVER
abstract: An M-ary FSK receiver in which a frequency down-converted signal is treated as an M-ary DPSK signal with symbol repetition coding. The output of a frequency demodulator (20) is integrated (22) over an optimally chosen time interval which is a fraction of the symbol interval to obtain N phase change estimates per symbol. These N sub-symbols are manipulated (24, 26) to obtain corresponding soft decisions which are then summed (32, 34) over a symbol period (or a substantial fraction thereof) to provide an overall soft decision for each bit comprising an M-ary symbol. These outputs may be used directly as soft decisions for forward error correction or applied to a threshold circuit to obtain hard decisions.

title: METHOD OF CHARACTERIZING TOUCH ON A TACTILE SCREEN
abstract: Method of characterizing touch on a surface of a tactile sensor comprising the following steps of: updating at least one first characteristic value of a current zone of the surface of the tactile sensor to be characterized, said first characteristic value being associated with a type of touch on the surface of the tactile sensor, and determination of a state of characterization of said current zone to be characterized, as a function of said at least one first characteristic value updated, by a set of characteristic values associated with types of touch on the surface of the tactile sensor.

title: NOISE REDUCTION IN DIGITIZING SYSTEMS
abstract: Disclosed are systems and methods related to a noise reduction device employing an analog filter and a corresponding inverse digital filter. The combination and placement of the filters within the systems aids in reducing noise introduced by processing the signal. In some embodiments, the combination of filters may also provide for increased flexibility when de-embedding device under test (DUT) link attenuation at higher frequencies. Further, the filters are adjustable, via a controller, to obtain an increased signal to noise ratio (SNR) relative to a signal channel lacking the combination of filters. Additional embodiments may be disclosed and/or claimed herein.

title: Liquid crystal display with reduced parasitic capacitance variation
abstract: A liquid crystal display capable of operating with little parasitic capacitance variation is presented. The display includes a substrate, a gate line disposed on the substrate, a storage electrode line disposed on the substrate and having a main portion that extends parallel with the gate line, a data line crossing the gate line and the storage electrode line and including a source electrode, a drain electrode facing the source electrode; and a pixel electrode connected to the drain electrode, wherein the storage electrode line includes a plurality of storage electrodes extending from the main portion in the same direction as the data line, and the storage electrodes overlap different regions of the data line.

title: SYSTEM FOR DISINFECTING MEDICAL INSTRUMENTS
abstract: The invention concerns a system for disinfecting medical instruments (4), comprising at least one first chamber (2) including means forming a hatch for access (3) inside same to place therein at least one medical instrument (4) to be disinfected, under the action of a disinfecting radiation during a disinfecting cycle. The invention is characterized in that it comprises means (5) for creating a vacuum in this first chamber (2), means (6) for introducing in this first chamber (2) a gas generating, via electrical excitation, the disinfecting radiation, connected to a gas source (7), and electrode-forming means (9, 10) connected to an electric power source (11) to excite the gas and generate the disinfecting radiation.

title: REHABILITATION SUPPORT SYSTEM
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a rehabilitation support system capable of improving operational efficiency of rehabilitation.SOLUTION: A rehabilitation support system capable of improving operational efficiency of rehabilitation while securing safety of a patient can be achieved by providing a comment creation function with a management terminal 300 separate from a center terminal 100 for monitoring biological information of a patient performing rehabilitation to inform the management terminal 300 from the center terminal 100 of the patient performing rehabilitation.

title: Linear motor for pump
abstract: The invention relates to a linear motor for a pump. The linear motor adopts a moving-iron type symmetrical structure, and two groups of coils serve as stators and are symmetrically distributed on two sides of a permanent magnet active cell. The stator coils of the motor is connected to a three-phase alternating current power supply and produces a specific traveling wave magnetic field, the active cell produces axial pushing force relative to the stators under the effect of the traveling wave magnetic field, the direction of pushing forced produced by two stators and the active cell are consistent under the effect of the traveling wave magnetic field, and the active cell directly acts energy on a plunger rod to enable the plunger rod to perform reciprocating motion along a guide rail. The linear motor for the pump achieves output of large pushing force, improves the effective pushing force and work efficiency and is suitable for driving of a plunger pump with high and medium voltage and large flow.

title: Vehicle control method, device and program product
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a vehicle control method and device and a program product, and is applied to a control device, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining target communication quality data with a vehicle in response to a vehicle control instruction; wherein the target communication quality data is used for representing the signal strength of a short-range channel and is used for representing the communication efficiency between the short-range channel and a remote channel; determining a target channel from the short-range channel and the remote channel according to the target communication quality data; and sending the vehicle control instruction to the vehicle through the target channel. Through the reference signal intensity, the situation that the signal is unstable due to the fact that the short-range channel is located in a connection critical area when being just connected is avoided. By referring to the communication efficiency of the two channels, the situation that near-field communication is unstable and the communication efficiency is low due to the fact that multiple devices exist nearby the vehicle or channel interference exists is avoided. Therefore, the vehicle control success rate is improved, and the user experience is optimized.

title: Low-noise amplifiers
abstract: A low-noise amplifier, that utilizes multiple monolithic transformer magnetic feedback to simultaneously neutralize the gate-drain overlap capacitance of the amplifying transistor and achieve high gain at high frequencies when driving an on-chip capacitance, is shown. The multiple transformer topology permits negative and positive feedback to be applied constructively, allowing for a stable design with adequate gain and large reverse isolation without Noise Figure degradation.

title: Electric arc prevention socket
abstract: The utility model discloses an arc protection socket, which comprises a main body, the inner wall of the main body is provided with a sliding cavity, the inner wall of the sliding cavity is slidably connected with a front shell, the inner wall of the main body is provided with a circuit metal sheet, and the front surface of the front shell is provided with jacks. According to the electric arc prevention socket, through the arrangement of the main body, the sliding cavity, the front shell, the circuit metal sheet, the jack, the fixed shell and the screw rod, when the electric arc prevention socket is used, the screw rod can perform threaded motion with a fixed block of the front shell when rotating, so that the front shell can slide back and forth in the sliding cavity of the main body, and the distance from the jack to the circuit metal sheet is adjusted; therefore, the purpose that the metal sheet of the plug can be contacted with the circuit metal sheet after being completely inserted into the jack is achieved, the electric shock phenomenon caused by the fact that a child touches the metal sheet of the plug with fingers and the plug is contacted with the circuit metal sheet when the metal sheet of the plug is inserted into the jack is prevented, and the safety performance of using the socket is improved.

title: THREE-DIMENSIONAL DISPLAY DEVICE
abstract: A three-dimensional display device comprising a display panel, an optical element, a detecting device, and a controller which, on the basis of the detected position of one of a first eye and a second eye, controls the display panel so that a first image and a second image are displayed in a combined manner. The controller is configured to perform: a first shifting process for shifting an active area outward such that the amount of shift increases by one sub-pixel at a time; a second shifting process in which, when one eye is shifted by one sub-pixel, a boundary of the first shifting process is shifted by one sub-pixel at a time; and a third shifting process in which the sub-pixels for a second period are shifted by one sub-pixel, and the boundary is shifted by the number of sub-pixels for a first period.

title: Hierarchical data storage method based on data format analysis
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of data storage, and discloses a hierarchical data storage method based on data format analysis, which comprises the following steps of: a, automatically identifying and analyzing the format of input data, classifying different types of original data by adopting a dynamic format identification algorithm, and automatically selecting a proper storage mode according to data format characteristics; b, converting the analyzed data into a unified standardized format, standardizing the data format by adopting a self-adaptive conversion module, and performing feature extraction on the data, including but not limited to improving the storage efficiency of the data through data segmentation, compression, aggregation and the like; and c, based on the data access frequency, the data type and the timeliness. By analyzing and standardizing data in different formats, heterogeneous data is unified into a standard format to be stored. In this way, on one hand, chaos on a storage structure is avoided, and on the other hand, the data can be more efficiently indexed and managed.

title: SEMICONDUCTOR DEVICE
abstract: PURPOSE:To provide a semiconductor device which can surely prevent the defect due to short circuit between a semiconductor element and leads. CONSTITUTION:On one main surface of a carrier tape 1 composed of insulative resin or the like, a plurality of wiring leads 2 are arranged regularly on straight lines in the width direction of the carrier tape 1, in the manner in which the leads 2 face the longitudinal direction of the carrier tape 1 and the tip parts are alternately adjacent to each other. In the carrier tape 1, slits 6 and aperture parts 6a for connection are formed, in the manner in which the tape 1 is selectively left as a frame type insulating film 5 which surrounds the tip parts of the wiring leads 2 to be connected with electrode bumps 4 formed in the central part of a semiconductor pellet 3. The insulating tape 5 prevents the short circuit between the semiconductor pellet 3 and a plurality of the wiring leads 2, and the slits 6 acts so as to sufficiently spread fluid resin around the semiconductor pellet 3 in a resin sealing process.

title: INPUT TERMINAL CIRCUIT
abstract: PURPOSE:To enlarge a voltage between a base and an emitter, to simplify an input circuit and to enlarge the dynamic range of an input signal by using a heterojunction bipolar transistor as a transistor. CONSTITUTION:The heterojunction bipolar transistor is used as a device applied to the circuit. A terminal resistance RT1 is added between the base/collector of an input transistor T1, and a capacity C1 cutting a direct current to the base part of the input transistor T1. Since the voltage between the base/emitter of the heterojunction bipar transistor becomes larger compared to a silicon bipolar transistor, the dynamic range of the input signal can be enlarged. Furthermore, the elements of the input circuit, which largely influence the feature of a logic circuit or that of an amplifier, can be suppressed to a minimum since the dynamic range of the input signal can be enlarged, and the dispersion of circuit performance owing to the dispersion of the elements can be suppressed.

title: POWER SUPPLY NOISE DETECTION CIRCUIT
abstract:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a power supply noise detection circuit capable of detecting even noise superimposed on a power supply line.

SOLUTION: The noise level attenuation effect by an RC filter comprising a resistor 2 and a capacitor 3 connected to a VDD terminal 13of an inverter 1 decreases a potential drop at the VDD terminal 13when noise is superimposed on the power supply line than that at a VDD line 4. This permits reduction in a circuit threshold of the inverter 1 and detection of the noise by means of an inverted output of the inverter 1 due to potential drop caused by the noise superimposed on the VDD line 4 connected to an input terminal 15. An RS latch 7 whose initial state level depends on a reset signal given to an input terminal 8 receives the result of noise detection by the inverter 1 via an inverter 6 to invert its status level and latch the result of noise detection and outputs the result of latch to an output terminal 10 via an inverter 9.

title: Drum brake device particularly for a motor vehicle
abstract: The invention relates to a drum brake device for a motor vehicle. This device comprises at least one pair consisting of a shoe 1 and a lining 2, carried on a casing-plate 3 of an axle and capable of being moved at least mechanically by an actuating lever 6, a hooking part 7 of the actuating lever being connected to a stop fitting 8 of a sheathed pull cable 9 operated by a control system, the pull cable 9 penetrating into a housing 22 formed between the casing-plate 3 and the shoe-lining pair by means of an inlet orifice 21, whereas an elastic return element 12 is interposed between the actuating lever and a fixed part of the device, characterised in that it includes a system for guiding the stop fitting 8 and the pull cable 9 inside the housing 22, this guide system being capable, when the cable is mounted, of routing the fitting 8, from its insertion into the inlet orifice, until it is permanently stably engaged on the hooking part 7. This braking device applies to a motor vehicle of any type. <IMAGE>

title: VISUAL AND RADAR PERCEPTION FUSION METHOD AND TERMINAL DEVICE
abstract: A vision-radar perception fusion method and a terminal device are provided in the disclosure. The method includes: acquiring a vision target and a radar target in front of a vehicle at a current moment and a tracked target at a previous moment; matching the vision target, the radar target and the tracked target and determining a matching state of each target; determining a type of the each target according to the matching state, the type being a fusion target and a single radar target; and determining a score of each target by combining the matching state and the type of the target, and if the score is greater than or equal to a preset score threshold, a target corresponding to the score being a fusion target. In the method of this disclosure, in the vision-radar perception fusion, a stable and reliable single radar target is output as the fusion target according to information such as an operating state of the vehicle and the dangerous area, which solves problems of flash alarm and false alarm for a single radar, greatly reduces a false detection rate and missing detection rate of the fusion target, and improves precision and stability of target perception; and the method has expansibility.

title: FOCUSED ENERGY BEAM PROCESSING DEVICE AND PROCESSING METHOD
abstract: PURPOSE:To perform the processing with high position precision and depth precision by providing an optical component provided at the center with a hole physically allowing a focused energy beam to pass through it on the optical axis of the focused energy beam. CONSTITUTION:A radiating system of the focused light and a detecting system of the reflected light and the interference light are provided so that at least part of the optical axis coincides with the optical axis of the focused energy beam. A reflecting mirror 22 provided with a hole at the center is installed on the optical axis of the ion beam below a deflector electrode 8, the ion beam passes through the center hole and is radiated to a sample 10. On the other hand, the light from an observation lighting lamp 33 passes through half mirrors 24 and 19 and a window 20 and enters a vacuum chamber 14 and is collected by an objective lens 21 and is radiated on a sample 10 by a reflecting mirror 22. The reflected light from the sample reversely passes through the same path and is image-formed by a camera 25, the optical microscope image thus obtained is sent to a main controller 30 and displayed on a monitor 32. The processing with high position precision and depth precision can be thereby performed.

title: Community electric vehicle charging pile system and charging method
abstract: The invention discloses a community electric vehicle charging pile system and a charging method. The community electric vehicle charging pile system comprises a main control cabinet, a charging connector and a mobile charger. Wherein the number of the charging connectors is multiple, the charging connectors are distributed on all parking spaces, and the charging connectors are electrically connected with the main control cabinet through cables; the two ends of the mobile charger are connected with a connecting joint and a charging joint through cables respectively, the connecting joint is used for being matched with the charging connector in an inserted mode, and the charging joint is used for being matched with a vehicle charging interface in an inserted mode. According to the invention, the problems of low use efficiency and low economic benefit of a fixed charging pile on a public parking space in the prior art are solved.

title: Methods and systems for accepting data from users by disaggregation of users identity
abstract: The present invention relates to methods and systems for accepting data from users by disaggregation of user's identity. The method performed by a server system includes receiving a request from a user device of a user for registering to a private non-interactive platform. The method includes generating a unique identifier for the user. The unique identifier provides access to the user to login to the private non-interactive platform and at least one research service rendered in the private non-interactive platform. Further, the method includes transmitting the unique identifier and a unique link appended with a research topic to the user device. The method includes validating user information related to the research topic based on validation rules. The method includes facilitating anonymous aggregation of the deidentified user information related to the research topic with other users' submitted information associated with the research topic.

title: Access method of multiple transmission systems in space-based communication network
abstract: The invention discloses an access method of multiple transmission systems in a space-based communication network, and belongs to the technical field of satellite communication. The method and the device are used for solving the access problem when multiple receiving transmission systems and multiple sending transmission systems exist in the satellite beam at the same time. Therefore, each wave beam on the satellite is interconnected with modulation and demodulation equipment through a branching combiner or/and an intermediate frequency matrix. And the modulation and demodulation equipment aregrouped according to a transmission system. And each group of modulation and demodulation equipment is interconnected with the service adaptation equipment through the switching equipment and is connected with the backbone network switching equipment through service adaptation. Through a three-level switching mode of beam-modem-intra-system switching-backbone network switching, terminal access ofa multi-transmission system and flexible scheduling of modulation and demodulation resources are realized.

title: Image processing device, image correcting method and program
abstract: An image processing device includes: an image correcting unit configured to correct a size of an image by inserting or deleting a predetermined number of pixels into and from the image based on size changing information of the image in which a plurality of pixel data is arranged, wherein the image correcting unit includes: a reading unit configured to read at least any one of attribute data and the pixel data; a characteristic determining unit configured to determine a characteristic of the pixel of interest in the image; a deforming process selecting unit configured to select a type of a deforming process related to determination of a position and determination of a pixel value of a pixel; and a correction executing unit configured to execute the deforming process selected by the deforming process selecting unit.

title: Semiconductor structure and method for forming same
abstract: A semiconductor structure and a method for forming same, the forming method including: providing a base, where a dummy gate structure is formed on the base, an interlayer dielectric layer is formed on the base the dummy gate structure exposes, and the interlayer dielectric layer exposes the top of the dummy gate structure; forming an isolation structure in the interlayer dielectric layer between adjacent dummy gate structures, where the isolation structure further extends into the base; after forming the isolation structure, removing the dummy gate structure and forming a gate opening in the interlayer dielectric layer; filling a gate electrode material into the gate opening, where the gate electrode material further covers the top of the interlayer dielectric layer; and performing at least one polishing treatment to remove the gate electrode material above the top of the interlayer dielectric layer and retaining the gate electrode material in the gate opening as a gate electrode layer, where the step of the polishing treatment includes: performing first polishing treatment using a metal polishing liquid; and performing second polishing treatment using deionized water. With the second polishing performance, the probability of forming a residue of the gate electrode material on the top surface of the interlayer dielectric layer is reduced, thereby improving device performance.

title: Cns-active acylamidopyrrolidinediones - from n-acylglycine esters via diacylamido-acetoacetic esters by thermic cyclisation
abstract: Cpds. of formula (I) (where X is H or CO-CR3R4R5) or of formula (II): (where R1 and R2 (same or not) = H, alkyl, cycloalkyl, aralkyl or aryl, or CR1R2 forms a cycloaliphatic 3-7 ring or a cycloaliphatic ring fused to an aromatic ring; R5 is H if R3 and R4 = R1, R2; or R3, R4, R5 (same or not) = H, alkyl, aralkyl, aryl or a single or fused cycloaliphatic ring; R = 1-4C aliphatic residue). They act on the CNS and vegetative systems and are also analgesics, antipyretics and antiphlogistics. Pref. from N-acylglycine esters via (II) by thermic cyclisation.

title: Apparatus and method for motion detection and tracking of objects in a region for collision avoidance utilizing a real-time adaptive probabilistic neural network
abstract: Apparatus for motion detection and tracking of objects in a region for collision avoidance includes a signal transmitter which provides first and second detection signals for at least partial reflection by an object located in a spatial region. The apparatus further includes a signal receiver for receiving the deflected first and second detection signals corresponding to first and second object parameter data signals. The apparatus further includes a Fourier transform circuit for receiving the first and second object parameter data signals and providing first and second Fourier transform object parameter data signals. The apparatus further includes a probabilistic neural network for receiving and sorting the first and second Fourier transform object parameter data signals without the use of a priori training data.

title: Quantitative trait loci (QTL) associated with shatter resistant capsules in sesame and uses thereof
abstract: The invention relates to sesame genetics and breeding. Specifically, the invention relates to genetic improvement for shatter resistant capsules. More specifically, the invention relates to novel quantitative trait loci (QTL) conferring shatter resistant capsules, and methods thereof, including methods for introgressing the novel QTL into elite germplasm in a breeding program for shatter resistant capsules.

title: Flight helmet with goggles capable of being quickly disassembled and assembled
abstract: The utility model provides a flying helmet with goggles capable of being disassembled and assembled rapidly, which belongs to the technical field of goggles and comprises a helmet, a platform is arranged on the side face of the helmet, a fixing belt is fixedly connected to the surface of the platform, a rotating block is fixedly connected to the middle of the platform, and a rotating rod is arranged on the rotating block. According to the flying helmet with the goggles capable of being rapidly disassembled and assembled, through the arrangement of the positioning groove, the fixing block, the positioning hole, the positioning column, the tension spring and the adjusting hole, a user pulls up the positioning column, the legs of the goggles are inserted into the fixing block, the goggles can be rapidly disassembled and assembled, the goggles can be rapidly disassembled and assembled, and the goggles can be rapidly disassembled and assembled through the positioning groove, the fixing block, the positioning hole, the positioning column, the tension spring and the adjusting hole. After the adjusting holes and the positioning columns are aligned, the positioning columns are loosened, the positioning columns penetrate through the adjusting holes to return to the positioning grooves, the glasses legs are locked, the goggles are rapidly disassembled and assembled, different adjusting holes are selected to adjust the distance of the glasses frame, operation is easy, and use is convenient.

title: Leakage scanning method and device for docking multiple scanners based on single-node forwarding service
abstract: The invention relates to a scanning missing method and device for docking multiple scanners based on a single-node forwarding service, and the method comprises the steps: a private network forwarding server is docked with a plurality of scanning engines, and the private network forwarding server interacts with a conventional private network through a tunnel; the private network forwarding client actively performs tunnel registration on the selected scanning engine to the private network forwarding server, and obtains a tunnel ID corresponding to the selected scanning engine allocated by the platform; the platform issues a target scanning task to a specified scanning engine and the associated tunnel ID; and completing vulnerability scanning detection of the target host of the traditional private network according to the target scanning task. The application can avoid opening multiple exposed surface IPs, reduce the exposed surface risk, reduce the maintenance cost, and improve the user experience.

title: Data transmission method and device
abstract: The application discloses a data transmission method and device. The method comprises: according to a first direction of an antenna beam transmitted by a transmitting terminal, a channel transmission parameter of a data transmission channel between the transmitting terminal and a receiving terminal in a first direction is obtained; when the channel transmission parameter in the first direction is larger than a first threshold value, a direction of an antenna beam transmitted by the transmitting terminal is adjusted to be a second direction, thereby reducing the interference intensity generated by data transmission in the data transmission channel by an interference source. The first threshold value is a minimum value of the channel transmission parameter needed by the data transmission channel. Therefore, a technical problem that the network delay is large under the circumstance that the interference intensity of the interference source is high when data are transmitted wirelessly at an authorization-free frequency band in the prior art can be solved.

title: Image compression method
abstract: The invention relates to an image compression method. According to the method, a first block, a second block and a third block are respectively used as compression units of a brightness component, a first chrominance component and a second chrominance component of an image; compression coding calculation is performed on the brightness component of the first block, the first chrominance component of the second block and the second chrominance component of the third block according to prediction results of multiple candidate prediction modes, so as to obtain an aggregated pre-compressed data size of the first block, the second block and the third block corresponding to the candidate prediction modes to determine a predicted mode; if the pre-compressed data size of the predicted mode is greater than or equal to an aggregated original data size of the first block, the second block and the third block, the components of the first block, the second block and the third block are not compressed; and if the pre-compressed data size is less than the original data size, semi-fixed length coding is performed on components of the first block, the second block and the third block in the predicted mode.

title: POWER AMPLIFIER CIRCUIT
abstract: The invention discloses a power amplification circuit. The power amplification circuit comprises an input port, an output port, a first switch module, a second switch module and at least two power amplification links, the first end of the power amplification link is electrically connected with the first switch module, the second end of the power amplification link is electrically connected with the second switch module, the first switch module is used for conducting the corresponding power amplification link with the input port, and the second switch module is used for conducting the corresponding power amplification link with the output port. The second switch module is used for conducting the corresponding power amplification link with the corresponding output port; the power amplification link comprises an adjustable attenuator, a first temperature compensation attenuator, a first amplifier, a second temperature compensation attenuator, a second amplifier and a third amplifier which are sequentially cascaded between the first end of the power amplification link and the second end of the power amplification link. The power stability of the power amplification circuit can be improved.

title: DRIVE DEVICE, DRIVE METHOD, AND PROGRAM
abstract: A device (20), which is a drive device, is provided with a drive unit (W), a control unit (24) which acquires an application including a plurality of blocks and controls the drive unit (W) in accordance with the plurality of blocks by executing the application, a first sensor (25a), and a second sensor (25b), wherein: each of the plurality of blocks has a parameter and a termination condition; and if a second drive status detected by the second sensor (25b) satisfies a parameter change condition when a first drive status detected by the first sensor (25a) while a first block is being executed satisfies the termination condition of the first block, the control unit (24) changes the parameter of a second block to be executed after the first block, and controls the drive unit (W) in accordance with the second block having the changed parameter.

title: Fluid Examination Chip and Method of Manufacturing the Fluid Examination Chip
abstract: There is provided a a fluid examination chip includes a channel through which a fluid flows in at least one of a surface and an interior thereof. The channel includes a capture area where a predetermined substance contained in the fluid is caught. Arithmetic average roughness on a surface in at least the part of the capture area of the channel is larger than that on a surface in the other area of the channel.

title: LIGHT EMITTING DEVICE PACKAGE
abstract: The present invention relates to a light emitting device package. More specifically, the present invention relates to a light emitting device package capable of faithfully implementing the blackbody locus (BBL). To this end, the light emitting device package according to an embodiment of the present invention includes a first light emitting part for emitting white light having a color temperature of 1750 to 2400K; a second light emitting part for emitting white light having a color temperature of 2400 to 4000K; a third light emitting part for emitting white light having a color temperature of 4000 to 7000K; and a fourth light emitting part for emitting white light having a color temperature of 7000 to 18000 K. The first to fourth light emitting parts can be driven independently, and at least one light emitting part can be driven.

title: Charging pile mounting base
abstract: The utility model relates to a charging pile mounting base, and relates to the technical field of mechanical and electrical installation, the charging pile mounting base comprises a base body, the top of the base body is provided with a groove, and a charging pile is clamped and matched with the groove; a locking assembly used for locking the charging pile in the groove is arranged between the base body and the charging pile, the locking assembly comprises a sliding groove formed in the base body, a locking rod arranged in the sliding groove in a sliding mode and a locking groove formed in the side wall of the charging pile, and the sliding groove penetrates through the groove; the locking rod is matched with the locking groove in an inserted mode, and an elastic piece used for driving the locking rod to be inserted into the locking groove is arranged in the sliding groove. The mounting base and the charging pile are of a detachable structure, so that the charging pile is convenient to replace, and time and labor are saved.

title: Electronic device
abstract: The utility model relates to an electronic device which comprises a battery containing unit and an energy storage unit. A battery containing space used for containing a battery is formed in the battery containing unit, and the battery containing space is communicated with the outside. The energy storage unit is connected with the battery containing unit and comprises an energy storage element used for charging the battery. According to the utility model, the storage space of the batteries is reduced, the batteries are prevented from being placed in disorder and easy to lose, the used batteries can be charged after being placed, and the problem of outdoor charging of the batteries is solved.

title: Adjustable surgical instrument containing device
abstract: The utility model discloses an adjustable surgical instrument containing device. The device comprises a bottom box, a long knife storage box and a short knife storage box, a long knife storage box isarranged at the top of the bottom box; storage boxes are arranged on the side walls of the two sides of the long knife storage box. A short knife storage box is arranged on the side wall of one side of the long knife storage box; scalpel after cleaning, a scalpel with a long scalpel body and a wide scalpel body is inserted into the wide scalpel insertion opening. A scalpel with a long scalpel bodyand a narrow scalpel body is inserted into the narrow scalpel insertion opening; a scalpel with a relatively short size is inserted into the short knife insertion opening; other surgical supplies areplaced in the two storage boxes; water dripping from the scalpels in the short scalpel storage box flows into the bottom box from the inclined face under the action of gravity, water in the long scalpel storage box is discharged into the bottom box from the leakage plate and then discharged from the water outlet, storage work of various types of scalpels is achieved, classification of the scalpels is achieved, and the scalpels are convenient to use during an operation.

title: Testing device
abstract: The utility model provides a testing device, a cable comprises an insulation wire core and a sheath which are sequentially arranged from inside to outside in an attached mode, the testing device is used for measuring friction force between the insulation wire core and the sheath, the testing device comprises a fixing frame, a traction assembly, a fixing assembly and a gravity part, the fixing frame comprises a fixing clamping plate, the fixing assembly is installed on the fixing clamping plate, and the gravity part is installed on the fixing clamping plate. The fixing assembly is used for fixing a cable in the vertical direction, one end of the traction assembly is used for being connected with an insulated wire core, the other end of the traction assembly is connected with the gravity part, and the gravity part is used for placing weights; a small section of a sheath is stripped from one end of the high-voltage cable to be detected, then a small section of an insulating layer on an insulating wire core is stripped, and a conductor is connected with a gravity part through a traction assembly; then the cable is fixed in the vertical direction through the fixing assembly, the moving distance is measured and recorded every day, and the relation between the static friction force and the weight of the cable is calculated according to the sliding amount of slight sliding of the insulated wire core measured in continuous five days and the weight of the weight.

title: ION GENERATOR
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an ion generator capable of amplifying and blowing the jet air sent from a compressor.SOLUTION: An ion generator 1 includes a discharge electrode 21 extending toward a blow-out opening 11, a counter electrode 23, and an air discharge opening 16 for supplying jet air, and it sends air ion which is generated by applying a high voltage between both electrodes 21, 23 through the blow-out opening 11. At the counter electrode 23, an arc-like notch part 32A is formed with the discharge electrode 21 as a center when viewed from the blow-out opening 11. The notch part 32A is arranged to provide a gap 25 with a part of the entire periphery of the discharge electrode 21, and the jet air is made to flow toward the gap 25.

title: Electronic device, electronic device operation method and non-instantaneous computer readable medium
abstract: The invention provides an electronic device, an electronic device operation method and a non-instantaneous computer readable medium. The electronic device operation method comprises the steps that a touch screen is started and at least one encryption layer is covered, the at least one encryption layer comprises area characteristics corresponding to a display desktop of the touch screen, the display desktop comprises a plurality of desktop areas, and the area characteristics decide the permission of an object in each desktop area after covering the at least one encryption layer. According to the electronic device and the operation method thereof, one or more encryption layers are covered to provide a display desktop, and then a user unlocks the specific encryption layer by himself or herself to make the specific encryption layer ineffective. Therefore, locking or permission setting can be carried out on different information contents or application programs, the elasticity and convenience are improved, and meanwhile, the safety is ensured. According to the invention, the orderly angle change among the plurality of tracks is used as a judgment basis for judging whether to unlock or not. Therefore, a user can intuitively unlock the electronic device at any angle.

title: Red pepper cultivation methods and plastic
abstract: The present invention relates to a cultivation method for chili peppers and to vinyl, which can cultivate the chili peppers by covering the vinyl with holes through which rainwater penetrates in plowed rows in a field without using agricultural chemicals, when cultivating chili peppers in the condition that vinyl is laid on the plowed rows in a field. In the cultivation method for chili peppers, which implants and cultivates the chili peppers by covering ridges with farming vinyl and making holes thereon, furrows are covered with the vinyl and the sides of the vinyl overlaps the side of the vinyl covering the ridges to be fixed by driving a fixing pin, and the vinyl covering the ridges have holes through which the rainwater permeates at regular intervals.

title: Battery panel body assembly, battery and electronic device
abstract: The utility model discloses a battery panel body assembly, a battery and an electronic device, the battery panel body assembly comprises a panel body, a sealing member and a sealant, the panel body is provided with a liquid injection hole, the panel body comprises a first surface and a second surface which are arranged oppositely, the liquid injection hole penetrates through the first surface and the second surface, and the sealing member comprises a top cover part and an extension part connected with the top cover part. The top cover part covers the first surface of the plate body and shields the liquid injection hole, the extending part at least partially penetrates through the liquid injection hole, and the sealant covers at least part of the outer surface of the top cover part and seals a gap between the extending part and the liquid injection hole. Thus, plugging is conducted through the sealing piece and the sealant, the thickness of the plate body can be effectively reduced on the premise that the plugging effect is guaranteed, and the sealing piece and the sealant cannot affect the plate body. Meanwhile, the method of the sealing element and the sealant has low requirements on the planeness of the plate body, so that the yield of the battery is improved, and the cost is reduced.

title: CHOCOLATE
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a chocolate to which a pattern that several kinds of chocolate raw materials having at least different color tones are visually and tastily harmonized in a desired extent is applied. SOLUTION: This chocolate to which a pattern is applied by several kinds of chocolate raw materials that are approximately simultaneously injected into a mold and have at least different colors, characterized in that the pattern is a pattern in which the chocolate raw materials are approximately alternately disposed in a prescribed region on all cross sections orthogonal to the injection direction by simultaneously injecting the several kinds of chocolate raw materials into injection regions preliminarily set in the mold, and that at least one part of the pattern in which the chocolate raw materials having the different colors are disposed in the adjacent states is integrally molded in a prescribed complicated degree in the injection direction by extruding the several kinds of chocolate raw materials from the same nozzle.

title: METHOD AND DEVICE FOR DISPLAYING INFORMATION WITH RESPECT TO SELECTED IMAGE ELEMENTS OF IMAGES OF A VIDEO SEQUENCE
abstract: The invention relates to a method for displaying information with respect to selected image elements. The aim of the invention is to simplify the interactive work via, for example, a frame. To this end, an image element is selected from the images of a video sequence with which an information is associated. The selection proceeds partially via an additional image element or signal element that is likewise presented on the display unit that displays the frame.

title: Dynamic electrocardiogram analysis tool recommendation method, device and equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to a dynamic electrocardiogram analysis tool recommendation method and device, equipment and a storage medium, and the method comprises the steps: analyzing historical data of a user analysis process, and extracting process feature information and an alternative function module set; the process feature information comprises an alternative workflow sequence; inputting user basic information, the process feature information and the alternative function module set into a preset tag classification model, and outputting user tag information; inputting the user tag information and the dynamic electrocardio preprocessing data into a preset function module sequence model, and outputting to obtain an alternative function module sequence; and recommending an electrocardio analysis main function module according to the alternative workflow sequence and the alternative function module sequence. The invention relates to a dynamic electrocardio analysis tool recommendation method, device and equipment and a storage medium, and aims at adjusting a functional module according to different users and dynamic electrocardio preprocessing data and recommending a proper dynamic electrocardio analysis tool so as to improve the analysis efficiency.

title: Vascularized neutralizationossification active scaffold applied to repair of large-segment bone defects
abstract: The invention discloses a vascularized neutralizationossification active scaffold applied to repair of large-segment bone defects. The vascularized neutralizationossification active scaffold includesa main body part, the main body part is concentrically provided with first channelsin the axis direction, the main body part is furtherprovided with second channelsin the axis direction, and the second channelsareevenly arrangedby takingthe axes of the first channels as the center in distribution modes; and the main body part is provided with third channelsin the radial direction, the third channelscommunicate with the first channels and the second channels, and nutrient solutions transported by the first channels and the second channelsare diffused in human tissues through the third channels.According to thevascularized neuralizationossificationactive scaffold applied tothe repair ofthe large-segment bone defects, the vascularized neutralizationossification active scaffold is applied tothe repair of the large-segment bone defects and heterotopicosteogenesis to treat the large-segment bone defects,the structure of the active scaffold is reasonable,the active scaffold is buried in muscles in a body,through the double-layer function of blood vessels and nerves, the effect of the heterotopic osteogenesis is promoted to treat and repair the large-segment bone defects.

title: METHOD FOR RELIEVING GLOSSOPLEGIA
abstract: FIELD: medicine. ^ SUBSTANCE: invention concerns medicine, particularly maxillofacial surgery. A hypoglossus is separated, and an end-to-end nerve graft is anchored thereto. The nerve graft is presented by a sural nerve delivered through a pre-formed tunnel extending from a proglossis through a root of the tongue into a digastric triangle. ^ EFFECT: method enables improving the tongue functions with the minimally damaged donor area. ^ 1 ex

title: METHOD AND APPARATUS FOR CEREBRAL TEMPERING
abstract: The present invention relates to a system and a method for controlling the temperature of a selected brain hemisphere, to maintain a low temperature in the selected brain hemisphere. When used in conjunction with the treatment of stroke, the present invention comprises cooling the stroke-affected brain hemisphere during the time necessary to make a diagnosis and provide medication, and during the time necessary for the ischaemic part of the brain to recover. The present invention also provides for oxygenation of the blood before it is cooled and reintroduced into the patient.

title: PROCESS FOR ENHANCING THE FLOTATION PROCESS OF NON-FERROUS METAL MINERALS
abstract: The invention relates to a process for enhancing the flotation process of the non-ferrous metal minerals by treating the flotation pulp in a direct current electric field. According to the invention, the process consists in placing some specific working electrodes in the flotation cells, said electrodes being connected to a direct current source, ensuring an electrode variable supply voltage ranging between 3 and 30 V, so that the required current density be obtained on electrodes, thereby replacing the flotation reagents employed in the activation or the settling of minerals.

title: Cable joint health state assessment method and system based on multi-dimensional data fusion
abstract: The invention discloses a cable joint health state assessment method and system based on multi-dimensional data fusion, and relates to the technical field of cable state assessment, and the method comprises the steps: collecting cable joint operation parameters, unifying a time sequence, and forming a two-dimensional matrix; performing spectral analysis on the operation parameters, and calculating energy characteristics of each sub-band by applying multi-stage wavelet decomposition; and constructing a Bayesian network structure, and calculating probability distribution according to the energy characteristics of the sub-bands. According to the method, spectral analysis is carried out through Fourier transform, the effect of identifying main frequency components and noise characteristics in signals is achieved, the effect of extracting energy characteristics of the signals in different frequency ranges is achieved by decomposing a two-dimensional matrix into a plurality of sub-bands by applying multi-stage wavelet decomposition, and the method has the advantages of being simple in structure and convenient to operate. By constructing a Bayesian network structure and defining feature nodes and state nodes, the health state evaluation of the cable can be dynamically updated according to data collected in real time.

title: STEREO DEMODULATOR
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain a stable operating characteristic by converting a stereo composite signal voltage into a current at a voltage current converting circuit and feeding the converted current as an operating current of a differential amplifier to decrease an operating voltage. CONSTITUTION:The differential amplifiers 2, 4 repeat alternately the conductive and nonconductive state based on a switching signal inputted to terminals 14, 16, demodulate a stereo signal from a stereo composite signal source 64 and left and right stereo signals are extracted individually from terminals 46, 52. In this case, a stereo composite signal voltage from the signal source 64 is converted into a current signal by the voltage current converting circuit 62 and attains the operating current of the differential amplifiers 2, 4 while the current is inverted by current inverting circuits 66, 68, 70, 72 and 74. That is, a different operating current is fed to the amplifiers 2, 4 in response to the signal from the signal source 64, the amplifiers 2, 4 are excited by a stereo composite signal to be modulated and the stereo signal is separated into the left and the right signal by a switching signal from terminals 14 and 16.

title: Electrodeposition of high damping magnetic alloys
abstract: A method includes immersing a wafer in an electrolyte including a plurality of compounds having elements of a high damping magnetic alloy with very low impurity and small uniform grain size. The method also includes applying a pulsed current with a certain range of duty cycle and pulse length to the wafer when the wafer is immersed in an electrolyte. The wafer is removed from the electrolyte when a layer of the high damping magnetic alloy is formed on the wafer.

title: Broadband oscillation source identification method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a broadband oscillation source identification method. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring broadband measurement data of a broadband oscillation alarm time period; calculating a steady-state fundamental component and an oscillation component of a voltage amplitude according to the broadband measurement data; calculating the ratio of the voltage amplitude oscillation component to the steady-state fundamental component at the corresponding moment to obtain a voltage amplitude ratio; and comparing the voltage amplitude ratios of different measuring points, and determining the broadband oscillation source according to the maximum value of the voltage amplitude ratios. The method is not affected by device measurement deviation and system parameter deviation, can accurately and reliably identify the broadband oscillation source, and is high in adaptability.

title: High-voltage bushing digital evaluation method and system based on time-frequency domain feature fusion
abstract: The invention provides a high-voltage bushing digital evaluation method and system based on time-frequency domain feature fusion, and belongs to the technical field of high-voltage bushing state monitoring. The system comprises a measurement interval section determination unit which determines a high-voltage bushing target measurement interval section which needs to be subjected to state evaluation; a measurement interval section sampling interval division unit determines a plurality of sampling intervals; the digital evaluation unit accesses at least one first sampling interval of the plurality of sampling intervals to the time domain evaluation subunit, and accesses at least one second sampling interval of the plurality of sampling intervals to the frequency domain evaluation subunit; and obtaining a digital evaluation result of the high-voltage bushing based on the first time domain evaluation result of the time domain evaluation subunit and the second frequency domain evaluation result of the frequency domain evaluation subunit. According to the method, the defect that state evaluation is carried out by singly adopting frequency domain or time domain characteristic data is avoided, and meanwhile, multi-parameter acquisition and determination of a sampling interval can be more reasonable.

title: Antenna state detection circuit
abstract: The invention discloses an antenna state detection circuit. The antenna state detection circuit comprises a power supply circuit module, a load circuit module and a main control module, wherein the power supply circuit module is used for providing stable voltage for the first end of the load circuit module; the second end of the load circuit module is connected with an antenna to be detected, and the third end of the load circuit module is connected with the ADC interface end of the main control module; the main control module is used for detecting the third end voltage of the load circuit module and determining the antenna state of the antenna to be detected according to the detected voltage; and under the condition that the antenna state of the to-be-detected antenna is changed, the load partial voltage of the load circuit module is changed. According to the antenna state detection circuit provided by the invention, the comprehensive detection of the antenna state is realized by utilizing the change of the load partial voltage of the load circuit module.

title: Method and device for measuring heart rate signal quality, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a method and device for measuring heart rate signal quality, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and the method for measuring the heart rate signal quality comprises the following steps: obtaining original data of a plurality of pulse plethysmography (PPG) signals at a first set time and a heart rate value at a first moment when the plurality of first set time ends; performing short-time Fourier transform on the original data of the PPG signals at the first set time to obtain corresponding amplitude vectors and frequency vectors; determining first heart rate signal quality of each first moment and second heart rate signal quality of a second set time according to the amplitude vector and the frequency vector of each first set time and the heart rate value of each first moment; and calculating target heart rate signal quality according to the first heart rate signal quality and the second heart rate signal quality. Therefore, the method can comprehensively measure the quality of the heart rate signal, so that the method can be used for measuring the performance of a photoelectric signal hardware module and the quality of wearable equipment worn by a user.

title: Magnetic coupling resonant mode wireless electric energy transmission device
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a magnetic coupling resonant mode wireless electric energy transmission device which comprises a high-frequency power amplification module, a resonance system, a rectifier module, a constant resistance type direct-current conversion module and a feedback controller. The resonance system is connected with the output end of the high-frequency power amplification module, the rectifier module is connected with the output end of the resonance system, the input end of the constant resistance type direct-current conversion module is connected with the output end of the rectifier module, the output end of the constant resistance type direct-current conversion module is connected with electric equipment, and the input impedance of the constant resistance type direct-current conversion module is in conjugate fit with the output impedance of the high-frequency power amplification module. The feedback controller is connected with the resonance system, and when the phase position of the acquired input voltage of the resonance system is different from the phase position of the acquired input current of the resonance system, the capacitance value of a resonant capacitor corresponding to a transmitting coil in the resonance system is adjusted until the phase position of the input voltage is identical to the phase position of the input current so that the maximum transmission efficiency of electric energy can be tracked on the premise of lowering the control difficulty of the feedback controller and simplifying the complexity of the programming of the feedback controller.

title: 6P pulse wave excitation rectification method and system, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a 6P pulse wave excitation rectification method and system, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining different coefficients of the number of six pulse wave paths, adjusting the number of excitation rectifier bridges, and outputting the pulse wave number of an excitation regulator; different connection modes and winding configurations are adopted for the exciting transformer; the number and the arrangement sequence of the power cabinets and the position of the alternating current side wire inlet cabinet are optimally configured, and stable direct current voltage is output. Harmonic waves of the transformer can be reduced, loss of the transformer can be reduced, the problems that the exciting transformer is large in loss and harmonic waves are solved, the same effect is achieved by adopting the small exciting transformer design capacity, meanwhile, exciting voltage ripples can be reduced, and temperature rise of an exciting winding of a generator is reduced to a certain degree.

title: Sensor time sequence data anomaly detection method and device
abstract: The invention discloses a sensor time series data anomaly detection method, which comprises the following steps of: S1, establishing an adjacent matrix for describing a relationship between sensor nodes according to the correlation of data acquired by each sensor; s2, training a variational auto-encoder based on original sample data collected by a sensor to obtain a reconstruction module; s3, training a graph neural network based on the reconstruction module and the original sample data to obtain a prediction module; and S4, performing joint anomaly scoring on the to-be-detected time series data based on the reconstruction module and the prediction module to obtain a joint score value, and performing anomaly judgment on the to-be-detected time series data based on the joint score value. The method has the technical effect of high detection precision.

title: Electric flocculation reactor
abstract: The utility model discloses an electric flocculation reactor which comprises a flocculation tank, an electric flocculation device is arranged in the flocculation tank, the electric flocculation devicecomprises a giant magnetostrictive driver and an integrated vibrating plate, a group of guide rods are arranged on the integrated vibrating plate, and electrode rods are fixedly arranged on the guiderods. A vibration output shaft of the giant magnetostrictive driver is fixed to the center of the integrated vibration plate, and the guide rod fixed to the integrated vibration plate is driven to vibrate at high frequency through continuous high-frequency vibration of the giant magnetostrictive driver, so that the electrode rod connected with the guide rod correspondingly generates high-frequency vibration. The utility model has the beneficial effects that the electrode stem is connected with the giant magnetostrictive driver through the guide rod, and the friction effect of the electrode stem and wastewater on the liquid-solid two-phase junction surface is generated through the continuous high-frequency vibration of the giant magnetostrictive driver, so that the concentration polarization phenomenon of the anode of the electrode stem is reduced.

title: Different volume weight wheat grain image segmentation algorithm based on improved U-Net network
abstract: The invention discloses a different-volume-weight wheat grain image segmentation algorithm based on an improved U-Net network, and the algorithm employs a residual error stacking module as a main backbone structure in a down-sampling process, and in a feature fusion part, a CBAM attention mechanism module is embedded behind a primary feature map, so as to achieve the segmentation of wheat grain images with different volume weights. Adaptively adjusting feature fusion weights of different pixel points from channels and spatial positions; a self-attention module is embedded in a decoder part, and correlation between different targets is enhanced. According to the method, the wheat grains with different volume weights are identified and detected from an image angle, and a traditional method for detecting the wheat volume weight by adopting a volume weight cylinder is changed, so that the efficiency can be improved, and a solid foundation is laid for subsequently detecting the wheat volume weight by applying an image method.

title: SEMICONDUCTOR DEVICE AND METHOD FOR MANUFACTURING IT
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To increase the storage capacity of a capacitor, without increasing the surface step difference of a base body, within a limited cell area of a DRAM (dynamic random access memory). SOLUTION: On a sidewall surface of a storage node electrode 12 of a hollow cylinder capacitor, a wavy ruggedness 9 is provided for enlarging a surface area, so that the storage capacity is increased. The wavy ruggedness 9 is formed in self-matching manner by an SOG(spin-on-glass) film is embedded in an opening of a resist pattern, where a wavy rough surface is intentionally generated on a side wall by utilizing the standing wave effect of photolithography, which is to be a sacrificial layer 10a, and then etching back a polysilicon film which covers the sacrificial layer 10a, after the resist pattern has been removed. Or the sacrificial layer may be formed of a porous silica film, so that a small-hole pattern of the film is transferred to the polysilicon film for forming minute projections, to increase the surface area of a storage node electrode.

title: LED bootstrap control system based on linear drive
abstract: The utility model discloses an LED bootstrap control system based on linear drive. The LED bootstrap control system based on linear drive mainly includes a rectifying and filtering circuit, a voltage detection circuit connected with an output end of the rectifying and filtering circuit, a bootstrap circuit connected with the voltage detection circuit, and a voltage stabilizing circuit connected with the bootstrap circuit, and is characterized in that the system also includes a linear drive circuit connected with the rectifying and filtering circuit and the voltage detection circuit at the same time, and the linear drive circuit comprises a drive chip U3, a triode VT2, a triode VT3, a triode VT4, a triode VT5, a polar capacitor C11 whose positive electrode is connected with the rectifying and filtering circuit and negative electrode is connected with an IN1 pin of the drive chip U3 through a resistor R11, and a resistor R12, one end of which is connected with the collector electrode of the triode VT5 and the other end of which is connected with the base electrode of the triode VT3 through a resistor R13. Compared with a conventional LED drive system, the LED bootstrap control system based on linear drive is provided with the linear drive circuit, so that the load capacity of the drive system can be effectively improved, thereby driving more LED lamp groups at the same time, so as to satisfy requirements of people.

title: MOVABLE LIGHT EMITTING ELEMENT
abstract: PURPOSE:To drive a plane driving vibration part by providing the plane driving vibration part with coils together with a light emitting element and by flowing currents through those coils. CONSTITUTION:A light emitting element 1 is provided in the center of a plane driving vibration part 2 and around it, three coils 6 are also provided. Around the plane driving vibration part 2, a damper 9 is provided. Magnets 4 are arranged over and under the vibration part 2 and so magnetized that the center and outer circumference of each coil 6 have different polarities. A control signal for tracking or correcting jitters is composed and inputted to three coils 6. The coils 6 may be divided into tracking coils inputting low-frequency signals and jitter-correcting coils inputting high-frequency signals.

title: Active non-contact identity authentication method based on WiFi channel state information
abstract: The invention discloses an active non-contact identity authentication method based on the WiFi channel state information.
