The user body type, habits and other features contained in the human body behaviors are extracted through the WiFi channel state information. The first application of the WiFi channel state information on an identity recognition direction is utilized, the features are extracted by reasonably and effectively denoising the channel state information CSI in a WiFi signal extensively utilized at this stage; the waveform data related with the actions is segmented according to the extraction result; the user behavior recognition and the user identity related information (action direction, speed, user body type and others) extraction are further performed on the segmented data; and then the feature results are used for recognizing the user identity, and meanwhile, the reality of the whole mechanism is guaranteed.

title: Bone surgery special cable
abstract: The utility model provides a bone surgery special cable, it includes multiple spot temperature precision measurement, electrode transmission, high -speed signal transmission and on -off control function, the cable size is little, and is soft resistant crooked, and can satisfy the biocompatibility requirement. Its cross section that includes that outside -in arranges in proper order is the annularrestrictive coating of circle, a PTFE lacing, the interior intracavity of a PTFE lacing is provided with a plurality of groups thermocouple extension line, a plurality of radio frequency coaxial lines, three direct current supply line, arrange after the transposition of three direct current supply line in the central point of inner chamber puts, and three direct current supply line insulate together with the inlayer and form the cylinder structure, the outer loop bread of cylinder structure covers and has a plurality of roots the radio frequency coaxial line, a plurality of roots the transposition of radio frequency coaxial line forms the loop configuration, the equivalent outer loop bread of loop configuration covers and has the 2nd PTFE lacing, the outer loop bread of the 2nd PTFE lacingcovers and has the shielding layer, the outer loop bread of shielding layer covers and has the 3rd PTFE lacing.

title: Phase-selection switching control system of high-voltage circuit breaker
abstract: The invention provides a phase-selection switching control system of a high-voltage circuit breaker. The phase-selection switching control system comprises a controller, a synchronous signal zero point detection circuit, a drive circuit, a circuit breaker and a state feedback correction module, wherein the controller is connected with the synchronous signal zero point detection circuit, the drive circuit and the state feedback correction module separately; an output end of the drive circuit is connected with a control terminal of the circuit breaker; the circuit breaker is also connected with an input end of the state feedback correction module; the synchronous signal zero point detection circuit is used for converting an external fixed-frequency sine wave signal into a digital reference signal capable of being recognized by a zero crossing point and transmitting the digital reference signal to the controller; the controller obtains a switching phase and a switching instruction according to external input and determines delay time according to a current delay parameter, the digital reference signal and the switching phase, and controls the circuit breaker to carry out a switching action corresponding to the switching instruction through the drive circuit after the delay time; and the state feedback correction module is used for detecting a state change of the circuit breaker and transmitting state feedback information to the controller.

title: Phase current zero crossing point detection method and related equipment
abstract: The invention provides a phase current zero crossing point detection method and related equipment, which are applied to a phase switch module, and the phase switch module comprises a high-side switching device and a low-side switching device. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a first control level signal of a high-side switching device, a second control level signal of a low-side switching device and an output voltage signal of a phase switching module; determining dead time at least according to the first control level signal and the second control level signal; and obtaining a phase current zero crossing point detection result of the phase switch module at least according to the first control level signal, the output voltage signal and the dead time. In the phase current direction switching process of a phase circuit with dead time, the duration of outputting a high level by a conducting phase is inconsistent with the duration when a control signal of a high-side switching device is a high level, and a voltage signal is obtained based on a control level signal and a voltage feedback digital circuit, so that digital circuit detection of a phase current zero crossing point is realized; therefore, the implementation simplicity of the scheme is improved.

title: Diagnosis and treatment system for foot drop
abstract: The utility model discloses a diagnosis and treatment system for foot drop, comprising a foot drop prescription machine, used for receiving pulse signal attribute information input by a doctor and an included angle threshold; and a foot drop rectifier, which is placed on a patient position needing to be rectified, connected with the foot drop prescription machine through wired or wireless connection, and used for carrying out foot drop rectification on a patient according to the pulse signal attribute information and the included angle threshold received by the foot drop prescription machine. According to the utility model, through communication between the foot drop prescription machine and the foot drop rectifier, a doctor can set different pulse signal attribute information according to different conditions of patients; the purpose of rectification with pertinency according to the patients of different types is achieved; and application scope is wide.

title: ELECTROMAGNETIC DEVICE DRIVING SYSTEM
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To shorten a recovery time to a prescribed boost voltage by effectively shortening a charging time of an output capacitor of a booster circuit, in an electromagnetic device driving system including the booster circuit.SOLUTION: An electromagnetic device driving system includes a first booster circuit 100 including an output capacitor C102, a second booster circuit 130, and a driving circuit Tr112 for driving an electromagnetic device L110 by supplying a prescribed boost voltage output from the output capacitor. The second booster circuit implements charging to the output capacitor with the first booster circuit, until a terminal voltage of the output capacitor reaches a prescribed boost voltage, after the supply of voltage to the electromagnetic device from the output capacitor is terminated, and the charging to the output capacitor by the first booster circuit is started.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Opening and closing data acquisition method and device, equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to an opening and closing data acquisition method. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring signal emission time of a switching-on and switching-off signal for a target switching-on and switching-off device, and acquiring current data of the target switching-on and switching-off device in a time interval matched with the signal emission time; acquiring a plurality of sub-current data of the current data at different time points in the time interval, and acquiring the difference degree between each sub-current data and the previous sub-current data; on the basis of the difference degree, acquiring sudden change point current data from the plurality of sub-current data; based on the catastrophe point current data, obtaining opening and closing time corresponding to the catastrophe point current data and a phase angle corresponding to the catastrophe point current data, and based on the signal sending time and the opening and closing time, obtaining duration information required by the target opening and closing device to complete opening and closing operation; and taking the phase angle and the duration information as switching-on and switching-off data of the target switching-on and switching-off device. By adopting the method, the opening and closing data of the target opening and closing device can be accurately obtained.

title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR MONITORING AND CONTROLLING A STATE OF A PATIENT DURING AND AFTER ADMINISTRATION OF ANESTHETIC COMPOUND
abstract: A system and method for monitoring and controlling the administration of at least one drug having anesthetic properties are provided. The method includes arranging a plurality of sensors configured to acquire physiological data from a patient and reviewing the physiological data from the plurality of sensors and an indication from a user interface. The method also includes assembling the physiological data into sets of time-series data and analyzing the sets of time-series data to determine signature profiles consistent with the administration of at least one drug. The method further includes identifying, using signature profiles, at least one of a current state and a predicted future state of the patient, controlling the administration of the least one drug to attain the predicted future state, and then generating a report including information regarding at least one of the current state and the predicted future state of the patient induced by the drug.

title: EDDY CURRENT ANALYSIS METHOD, EDDY CURRENT ANALYSIS DEVICE, AND PROGRAM
abstract: To provide an eddy current analysis method which can numerically determine the eddy current that is generated when an electrical conductor is placed in a magnetic field that changes over time.SOLUTION: An analysis object defined in an analytic space is divided into a plurality of volume elements, and a magnetic moment is added to each of the plurality of volume elements. An external magnetic field to be applied to the analysis object from the outside is defined. A step of calculating a vector potential at each position of the plurality of volume elements on the basis of the magnetic moment of each of the plurality of volume elements and the external magnetic field, a step of calculating an eddy current on the basis of the vector potential at each position of the plurality of volume elements, a step of calculating an induced magnetic field at each positions of the plurality of volume elements, and a step of updating the magnetic moment of each of the plurality of volume elements on the basis of the induced magnetic field are repeated. In the step for calculating the vector potential, a binding condition that a normal direction component of the eddy current on the surface of the analysis object becomes zero is imposed.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title: High-efficiency BOOST circuit
abstract: The invention provides a high-efficiency BOOST circuit which is mainly used for solving the problems that an existing low-voltage new energy power supply inverter is high in power consumption, low in efficiency and poor in reliability. The high-efficiency BOOST circuit comprises an input current sampling circuit and an output current sampling circuit. The output ends of the input current sampling circuit and the output current sampling circuit are sequentially connected with the input end of a VMOS switching circuit through a width-adjusting impulse control circuit, a driving signal synthesizing circuit and a VMOS switching driving circuit. A follow current inductor comprises two difference module symmetric inductors. The input current sampling circuit comprises a current sensor CS1, a capacitor C13, a resistor R21, a diode D4, a reverse isolation circuit and a VMOS tube which carries out synchronous rectification together with the VMOS switching circuit. The driving signal synthesizing circuit is synchronously driven by the follow current driving circuit.

title: 3D holographic image artificial intelligence minimally invasive endoscope system
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of medical instruments, and particularly discloses a 3D holographic image artificial intelligence minimally invasive endoscope system. The 3D holographic image artificial intelligence minimally invasive endoscope system comprises an endoscope body with a shell, a control handle and a host, wherein the endoscope body is connected with the control handle through a snake bone; the endoscope body comprises a 3D lens module, a light source module and a 3D image acquisition module which are arranged in the shell, the output end of the 3D lens module is in communication connection to the input end of the 3D image acquisition module, and the light source module is electrically connected to the control handle; and a 3D image processing module is arranged in the control handle, and a display module is arranged on the host. The 3D holographic image artificial intelligence minimally invasive endoscope system has the advantages that all the modules are arranged in the endoscope shell, a series of processing can be performed on obtained images to obtain clear 3D holographic images, and therefore, a doctor can know the internal condition of the body of a patient more clearly.

title: Stretchable LED Patch And Health Care Device Including The Same
abstract: The present invention relates to a stretchable LED patch, wherein a stretchable electrode is stacked on one surface of a stretchable film, a conductive bond is stacked on the other surface of the stretchable electrode, the conductive bond connects the stretchable electrode and an LED light source, a support is stacked on the other surface of the stretchable film, a protruding portion of the LED light source is flattened with a stretchable LED cover, and a double-sided adhesive band is stacked on the flattened surface.

title: DEVICE FOR GENERATING EXTRAORDINARY SOUND USING PERCUSSION INSTRUMENT
abstract: PURPOSE: A device for generating an extraordinary sound using a percussion instrument is provided to produce various drum sounds to create extraordinary and pleasant sounds. CONSTITUTION: A device for generating an extraordinary sound includes a percussion instrument(120), a sensor(140), a device main body(160), and a speaker(180). The sensor senses a vibrating sound generated from the percussion instrument. The device main body includes a memory chip in which individual extraordinary sounds or mixed extraordinary sounds are stored as audio files. The memory chip is selectively connected to the sensor. When the sensor senses a signal, the main body controls a sound stored in a selected audio file to be output. The speaker is connected to the device main body to output a selected extraordinary sound.

title: Electric restraint strap
abstract: The utility model discloses an electric restraint strap, and relates to the field of mechanical equipment. The electric restraint strap comprises a first fixing strap, a second fixing strap and a circuit board, wherein one end of the first fixing strap is connected with one end of the second fixing strap, and the other end of the first fixing strap is movably connected with one end of the first fixing strap; the circuit board is arranged on the first fixing strap; the first fixing strap is an inflatable fixing strap; the second fixing strap is a non-inflatable fixing strap. According to the electric restraint strap, after such restraint straps are fixedly arranged on four limbs in an electric inflation manner, releasing time and suitable tightness are input, and a skin temperature measurement alarming mode is started; when the restraint strap is released, the skin on the fixing part is massaged by the inner side of the restraint strap, so that blood circulation is promoted; the electric restraint strap is safe and convenient, and in addition, massage and healthcare effects are achieved.

title: MASSAGE MACHINE
abstract: This massage machine is provided with a massaging element, a motor (102) for driving the massaging element, an inverter circuit (104) for driving the motor (102), and a control unit (800) for controlling the inverter circuit. The massage machine is further provided with a current detection unit (809) which is connected to the inverter circuit (104) to detect a current flowing to the motor (102). In addition, the control unit (800) is provided with: a torque current calculation unit (801) which, on the basis of the value of detected current, calculates a torque current that indicates the torque level; and a feedback control unit (810) which calculates control information for controlling the inverter circuit (104) on the basis of the torque current so as to bring the rotation of the motor to a prescribed target state. With this configuration, the present invention is able to provide a massage machine which is capable of reducing differences in pressing force due to differences in physique.

title: Segmented CRC-assisted volume active code coding and decoding scheme
abstract: The invention discloses a segmented CRC (Cyclic Redundancy Check) auxiliary decoding scheme based on volume active codes based on a sliding window algorithm, and mainly solves the problems that the complexity of the existing SCL and CRC-SCL is very high and the performance of the existing segmented CRC auxiliary decoding algorithm cannot be improved. The implementation scheme is as follows: 1) carrying out Monte Carlo simulation to count the error probability of each bit channel; 2) searching a continuous sub-channel with the highest error probability by using a sliding window algorithm; 3) according to a search result in the step 2), performing CRC (Cyclic Redundancy Check) at the most error-prone sub-channel so as to improve the retention probability of a correct path; and 4) repeating the process, and sequentially adding other CRC segments. And 5) carrying out volume active code coding, modulation and noise addition. And 6) carrying out segmented decoding on the received information sequence. Compared with an existing decoding algorithm, the decoding method has certain performance gain while the calculation complexity is reduced, and has better decoding performance compared with a polarization code under the same condition.

title: Rock plug blasting device
abstract: The utility model provides a rock plug blasting device which comprises explosive, a high-precision nonel detonator, an electronic digital detonator and a bamboo chip which are arranged in a blast hole, and a blocking section for blocking an opening is arranged at the tail end of the opening of the blast hole; and leg wires of the high-precision nonel detonator and the electronic digital detonatorare exposed out of the blocking section. According to the utility model, the high-precision nonel detonator and the electronic digital detonator are simultaneously arranged in the explosive, so that a'repeated 'type initiation network is formed. The utility model discloses a'repeated 'type initiation network. The high-precision nonel detonator can overcome the risk that the detonation reliabilityof an electronic digital detonator is reduced under the conditions of water and pressure, and the electronic digital detonator can overcome the risk that the high-precision nonel detonator cannot be subjected to network detection after ammunition coating is completed, so that a'repeated 'detonation network can ensure successful rock plug detonation, and the detonation rate is increased.

title: Visually impaired person crossing sound prompting method and system for pedestrian crossing signal lamp
abstract: The invention relates to a visual impaired person crossing sound prompting method and system for a pedestrian crossing signal lamp, and the method comprises the steps: when a prompting device receives a triggering message which is from a mobile terminal and comprises a representative visual impaired person, the prompting device broadcasts a first type of information of a signal lamp state associated with the prompting device in advance, the blind person street-crossing sound prompting device has the advantages that the influence of the blind person street-crossing sound prompting device on the outside is reduced, and visually impaired people can conveniently and safely pass through the pedestrian crosswalk.

title: Method for rf excitation with two resonance frequencies to detect the cest effect
abstract: The invention relates to a method for detect the CEST effect by utilization of magnetic resonance apparatus (5) and by performing HF excitation (25) with two resonance frequencies (f1, f2). The RF excitation (25) is achieved with the use of a first RF antenna (4) and a second RF antenna (4') of the magnetic resonance apparatus (5) with a first portion of the RF excitation at a first resonance frequency (f1) of the two resonance frequencies being implemented with the first RF antenna (4), and a second portion of the RF excitation at a second resonance frequency (f2) of the two resonance frequencies is implemented with the second RF antenna (4').

title: Data driver, organic light emitting display device using the same, and method of driving the organic light emitting display device
abstract: A data driver capable of displaying images with a substantially uniform brightness, an organic light emitting display device using the same, and a method of driving the organic light emitting display device. The data driver includes a current sink unit for controlling a predetermined current to flow through a data line, a voltage generator for resetting values of gray scale voltages using a compensation voltage generated when the predetermined current flow s, a digital-to-analog converter for selecting one gray scale voltage among the gray scale voltages as a data signal in response to bit values of data supplied from the outside, and a switching unit for supplying the data signal to the data line. The predetermined current may be set equal to pixel currents that correspond to a maximum brightness.

title: SEMICONDUCTOR DEVICE
abstract: The present invention is a trench-gate-type insulated-gate-type bipolar transistor wherein current will not come into the lower section of trenches (6) by a roundabout path, the generation of a high electrical field in the lower section of the trenches (6) can be suppressed even if a high voltage is impressed in an OFF state or the like, increases in ON-resistance and reductions in destruction resistance can be suppressed, and reductions in voltage strength can be suppressed. The present invention is a semiconductor device wherein a plurality of trenches (6) are formed so as to reach the back (2b) of a drift layer (2) and a collector layer (5) is formed on the tip section side of the front layer section of the drift layer (2) in the direction of extension of the plurality of trenches (6). When a prescribed voltage is impressed on a gate electrode, a channel region is formed in the parts of a base layer (3) that are in contact with the trenches (6) so that current flows in the direction of extension of the trenches (6) along the trenches (6).

title: ANIMAL-SENSING SECURITY PATCH AND USE METHOD THEREFOR
abstract: An animal-sensing security patch and a use method therefor. The security patch comprises a decorative layer (11), an inductive layer (12), an adhesive layer (13), a protective film (14), a processor (4), and an alarm (5). The decorative layer (11) is used for coating/printing a pattern. An excitation lead (2) and an inductive lead (3) are arranged on the inductive layer (12). The adhesive layer (13) is affixed onto the surface of an insulating material. The protective film (14) covers the surface of the adhesive layer (13). The excitation lead (2) is used for forming an induced electric field. The inductive lead (3) is arranged in the induced electric field to detect a change in the induced electric field caused by the magnetic field of a human body or animal and to transmit the change to the processor (4). The processor (4) is used for determining whether the alarm (5) needs to be activated.

title: Online selection method for effective reactive power compensation location of power system
abstract: The invention relates to an online selection method for effective reactive power compensation locations of an electric power system. The online selection method comprises the following steps that S1,a voltage dangerous node is given, and a local system is equivalent to a double-node system through multi-port Thevenin equivalent, and the correlation index of each reactive power compensation node to a voltage unstable place is calculated; S2, the obtained correlation index is subjected to normalization computing; S3, a threshold value K is set, nodes with correlation indexes smaller than K areeliminated, and a set of the effective reactive power compensation locations is obtained; and S4, according to a real-time power network structure and power flow, the reactive power compensation location ordering of the system is obtained. According to the online selection method, only impedance information of a local power grid and voltage information of each reactive power compensation node needto be known, so that an effective reactive power compensation location selection method can be obtained. Compared with an existing method, the online selection method can quickly identify effective reactive power compensation nodes through online information, and quickly improve the voltage stability of the system.

title: Mobile type diaphragm clamp basin with cell growth substrate coating
abstract: A moving patch clamp bath with a cell growth matrix coating layer relates to the patch clamp bath for electrophysiology experiment. The patch clamp bath includes a bath cup 1, a bath cup cover 2 and a bath cup rack 3 to solve the problems of slow cell attachment and low cell attachment rate during the experimental process of the moving patch clamp bath and significantly prolong experimental operation time; a hole 5 to place the bath cup 1 is arranged at the upper surface of the bath cup rack 3, and the cell growth matrix coating layer 4 is coated on the inner wall of the bath cup 1. The moving patch clamp bath with the cell growth matrix coating layer of the invention has easy cell attachment, shortened experimental operation time, simple structure and easy processing and manufacture.

title: AUTOMATIC SHIP PILOT DEVICE ACTIVATED BY BRAIN WAVES
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To previously detect a doze by automatically beginning steering by an automatic ship pilot device when a theta wave or a delta wave is detected in brain waves. SOLUTION: As a brain wave input means 1, an electroencephalograph can be used. A brain wave analysis means 2 is constituted of an amplifier, a band pass filter, an A/D converter, and a computer or a microprocessor. Hereat, when the brain waves of a navigation officer on duty is analysed by the computer of the brain wave analysis means 2 to detect a doze, a computer 4 for operating a ship immediately begins autopilot by indication of a brain wave analysing computer 9. When the member on duty only puts on the brain wave input means 1, by indication of the brain wave analysing computer 9, warning to the member on duty is output, simultaneously, a warning lamp in the sitting room of a navigation officer off duty is lighted, and the doze of the member on duty can be informed to the member off duty.

title: Electroporation apparatus based on chip formula electrode
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of biomedical research device, a electroporation apparatus based on chip formula electrode is disclosed, including empty core rod (1), the one end of empty core rod (1) is provided with chip electrode (2), chip electrode (2) just, negative pole and power connecting wire (3) just, the negative pole corresponds and is connected, follow power connecting wire (3) the other end of empty core rod (1) is worn out. The utility model discloses can realize the electroporation operation on tissue surface, make the electric field coverage on tissue surface controllable, and to mains voltage require for a short time, the suitability is strong, convenient to carry.

title: Brain magnetic source positioning method based on nearest neighbor multiple linear regression model
abstract: The invention provides a brain magnetic source positioning method based on a nearest neighbor multiple linear regression model. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a brain model based on a nearest neighbor multiple linear regression model and representing space-time correlation between brain source activities; constructing a source covariance matrix in the model based on a graph Laplacian smoother, and representing spatial correlation of covariance hierarchies between source activities; and based on Bayesian reasoning and a convex optimization theory, carrying out reasonable hypothesis on the model, and deducing a model parameter iterative solution formula. According to the source localization algorithm, more accurate source estimation including accurate localization source position, range size and source time waveform estimation can be obtained, and a solid technical basis is provided for medical application of brain magnetism.

title: Electric ablation device
abstract: The utility model provides an electric ablation device. The electric ablation device comprises a mainframe box and a plurality of electrodes, a control circuit is arranged in the mainframe box and comprises a power supply, a controller, a direct current generator and an electric pulse generator; the power supply is electrically connected with the controller, the direct current generator and the electric pulse generator respectively; the controller is in signal connection with the control ends of the direct current generator and the electric pulse generator. And the direct current generator andthe electric pulse generator are electrically connected with the port of each electrode. According to the utility model, electroporation ablation and electrolytic ablation are combined together to generate a synergistic effect, so that the electric injury to a human body is reduced, the treatment time is shortened, and the treatment effect is improved.

title: Brain CT image segmentation model training method and device, segmentation method for brain CT image
abstract: The invention discloses a brain CT image segmentation model training method and device, a segmentation method for a brain CT image. The training method comprises the following steps: obtaining an input feature map obtained by a to-be-trained coding network according to the brain CT sample image with label information, obtaining a segmentation result obtained by a to-be-trained decoding network according to the input feature map, and carrying out spatial information fusion and channel information fusion on a plurality of feature maps with different channel numbers by the decoding network, aggregating the obtained space fusion features and channel fusion features to obtain a segmentation result; and calculating the difference between the segmentation result and the label information of the brain CT sample image, and updating the model parameters of the coding network and the decoding network according to the difference. In the training process, rich spatial information in the encoding stage is extracted through spatial information fusion, the segmentation precision is improved, meanwhile, a dynamic non-dependency relationship between channels is established through channel information fusion, the learning process is simplified, and the representation capability of the model is remarkably enhanced.

title: Contactless twelve-lead electrocardiogram signal acquisition device
abstract: The invention relates to a contactless twelve-lead electrocardiogram signal acquisition system, belonging to the field of medical electronics, which is composed of a contactless electrocardiogram acquisition collector, a signal filtering and amplifying module, an A/D module, a microprocessor, a liquid crystal display module, a wireless communication module, a microprocessor and a power managementsystem. The non-contact ECG collecting electrode is connected with the signal filtering and amplifying module through a signal line. The filtering amplification module is electrically connected with the A/D module, the microprocessor is connected with the A/D module, the wireless communication module and the liquid crystal display module; the power management system is connected with the signal filtering and amplifying module and the microprocessor through the power line and the control bus respectively. The collected signals are sent to the processor for processing.

title: MACHINE LEARNING APPARATUS, CLASSIFICATION APPARATUS, METHOD AND PROGRAM
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To improve accuracy and efficiency of work to detect firing from neuronal extracellular potential data.SOLUTION: A machine learning apparatus, with respect to data representing the change over time of extracellular electric potential of nerve cells, learns the relationship between firing and electric potential values using electric potential values measured over a prescribed period and teacher values indicating occurrence of firing in said period. The machine learning apparatus is also provided with a learning processing unit that corrects a coefficient used in a prescribed function using: the electric potential values; a feature amount calculation unit that calculates feature amounts on the basis of the function; a value based on the feature amount calculated by the feature amount calculation unit; and the teacher value.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 7

title: Physiological signal determination of bioimpedance signals
abstract: Embodiments relate generally to wearable computing devices in capturing and deriving physiological characteristic data. More specifically, disclosed are one or more electrodes and methods to determine physiological characteristics using a wearable device (or carried device) and one or more sensors. In one embodiment, a method includes determining a drive signal magnitude for a bioimpedance signal to capture data representing a physiological-related component and selecting the drive signal magnitude as a function of an impedance of a tissue. The bioimpedance signal can be applied to electrodes that are configured to convey the bioimpedance signal to the tissue. In some cases, data representing a value a signal-to-noise (“SNR”) ratio may be adapted to form an adaptive signal-to-noise value. A portion of a received bioimpedance signal may be detected, the received bioimpedance signal being based on the adaptive signal-to-noise value. A physiological characteristic can be derived.

title: Electro-optical analysis of integrated circuits
abstract: An integrated circuit die having silicon on insulator (SOI) structure is analyzed in a manner that improves the ability to obtain a signal from the SOI structure. According to one example embodiment, a stimulating device is adapted to stimulate an integrated circuit having SOI structure. An electro-optic probe arrangement is focused on a selected portion of the integrated circuit in a manner that makes possible the detection of a response to the stimulation from the SOI selected portion. In this manner electro-optic probing portions of an integrated circuit having SOI structure is enhanced.

title: Electrode device for generating seismic waves and usage method
abstract: The invention relates to an electrode device for generating seismic waves and a usage method. The electrode device is used for a cardiovascular stenosis lesion recanalization system. The electrode device comprises an electrode pair, a connecting wire and a catheter, the electrode device is arranged on the catheter, the arrangement mode of the electrode pair is coaxial radial arrangement, and the electrode pair comprises an electrode tip and a wire; the device can be matched with a balloon catheter to control a generator of a recanalization system to apply vibration waves to vibrate and expand a narrow blood vessel attached to the periphery of a balloon to a certain recanalization rate, the action direction and effect after the vibration waves are generated are controlled, the purpose of keeping the blood vessel normal for a long time is achieved, and finally cardiovascular stenosis is treated. The device is simple in structure, low in cost and easy to store.

title: Cerebral stroke risk prediction method and system
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of risk prediction, and discloses a cerebral apoplexy risk prediction method and system. The method comprises the following steps: capturing cerebral apoplexy risk assessment knowledge big data and historical clinical big data; performing data preprocessing; constructing a cerebral apoplexy risk knowledge graph; carrying out secondary data processing; constructing a cerebral apoplexy risk prediction model by using a deep learning algorithm; performing data dimension reduction on the real-time clinical data; performing cerebral apoplexy risk prediction; and cerebral apoplexy prevention measures are obtained. The system comprises a big data capture module, a data preprocessing module, a knowledge graph construction module, a data secondary processing module, a cerebral apoplexy risk prediction model construction module, a data dimension reduction module, a cerebral apoplexy risk level prediction module and a cerebral apoplexy prevention measure acquisition module which are connected in sequence. The problems of low efficiency, poor accuracy, medical resource waste and low data value in the prior art are solved.

title: IMPLANTABLE SENSOR
abstract: An implantable sensor is proposed comprising a ring shaped element and a coil. The ring shaped element is made of a silicone and is electrically conductive. The coil may be formed by a wire with a number of windings, wherein at least the free ends of the wire, i.e. of the coil are enclosed by the silicone of the ring shaped element, wherein an electrical resistance of the ring shaped element varies upon a deformation of the ring shaped element.

title: Fatigue driving monitoring method and device and computer readable storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a fatigue driving monitoring method and device and a computer readable storage medium, and relates to the technical field of fatigue detection. The method comprises the steps ofacquiring visual features of a face image of a driver; inputting the visual features into a trained network model to obtain a fatigue index represented by EEG signals corresponding to the visual features, wherein the network model is obtained by training the visual features corresponding to the sample face image and the synchronously obtained sample EEG signals for multiple times; and determiningthe fatigue state according to the fatigue index. The EEG signals can accurately reflect the fatigue state of the driver, and the fatigue state of the driver can be accurately judged through collecting the face image of the driver according to the network model obtained by training the visual features and the EEG signals.

title: Diaphragm electromyographic signal noise reduction method, system and device and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a diaphragm electromyographic signal noise reduction method, system and device and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of computers. The method comprises the following steps: decomposing a surface diaphragm electromyographic signal through a multi-scale wavelet, determining a wavelet coefficient of a corresponding scale based on a frequency range of the electrocardio signal, squaring the wavelet coefficient to amplify wavelet features of an electrocardio interference signal to obtain a wavelet energy coefficient, and positioning the interference signal by adopting a dual-threshold algorithm, noise and useful diaphragm electromyographic signals can be effectively distinguished. And determining an average energy threshold value based on the wavelet energy coefficient in an interval adjacent to the interference interval where the electrocardio position is located, performing noise reduction processing on the interference interval according to the average energy threshold value to remove interference signals in the interference interval, and performing reduction and wavelet reconstruction operation on the wavelet energy coefficient after noise reduction to obtain the diaphragm electromyographic signal. The signal-to-noise ratio of the diaphragm electromyographic signals can be improved, and more effective diaphragm electromyographic signals can be reserved.

title: Microelectrode system having double-spiral structure, electrochemical sensor and preparation method of the microelectrode system having double-spiral structure
abstract: The invention discloses a microelectrode system having a double-spiral structure, an electrochemical sensor and a preparation method of the microelectrode system having a double-spiral structure. The microelectrode system having the double-spiral structure is used for electrochemical detection and comprises an insulating substrate, a first electrode and a second electrode, wherein the first electrode and the second electrode are arranged on the insulating substrate; the first electrode and the second electrode have spiral shapes, are electrically isolated from each other and are nested with each other thereby forming the double-spiral structure. The microelectrode system having the double-spiral structure can provide continuous field distribution thereby improving the response stability in electrochemical measurement.

title: IMS MTL PERSONAL MERIDIAN ELECTRICAL IMPULSE APPARATUS HAVING THE EFFECT ON BLOOD CIRCULATION AND AUTONOMIC REGULATION BY LOW FREQUENCY USING INNER MUSCLE STIMULATION TYPE AND APPLYING MULTI WAVELENGTH LIGHT EMITTING DIODE TECHNOLOGY
abstract: Disclosed is a personal electric meridian stimulation apparatus having an effect on blood circulation and reinforcement of an autonomic regulation function by low frequency waves using an inner muscle stimulation (IMS) type and application of multi-wavelength light emitting diode (MTL) technology. According to the present invention, a second abdominal pad and a footplate, which include first and second light emitting diode (LED) chip modules emitting light with a plurality of wavelengths, are added to a smart self-care personal electric meridian stimulation apparatus including a first abdominal pad, which emits the low frequency waves and heat, and the like. Accordingly, through low frequency electric stimulation using the IMS type, provided are effects on diet, physical treatment, blood circulation, muscle reinforcement, and the reinforcement of the autonomic regulatory function. Moreover, through the application of the MTL technology, provided are treatment effects on chronic dermatopathy, skin aging, wounds, freckles, mitigation of inflammation, cell regeneration, cellulite decomposition, reinforcement of renal function, and the like.

title: method for prognostigation of occurrence of heart arrhythmia at patients with ischemic heart disease with depressive and anxious disorders
abstract: A method for prognostigation of occurrence of heart arrhythmia at patients with ischemic heart disease with depressive and anxious disorders consists in that the daily electrocardiogram monitoring is carried out to patients with the determination of amount and duration of painful and painless ischemia, quantity of extrasystoles and attacks of auricle fibrillation per day. By means of a hospital scale of depression and anxieties, a level of anxieties and depressions is determined, and quantity of psychoemotional conflicts is determined for a week, and at determination of acute psychoemotional stresses 2 and more for a week, increasing of parameters of HADS anxieties scale on 10 points and more, depressions on 9 points and more, quantity of painful myocardium ischemia of 2 episodes and more for a week, duration of painless myocardium ischemia of more than 6 minutes day the occurrence of auricle extrasystols and fibrillations is prognosticated.

title: MAPPING AND NAVIGATION SYSTEM
abstract: Provided herein are systems, devices, and methods for performing a medical procedure on a patient. The system includes a catheter device and a console for operating the catheter device. The catheter device includes a functional assembly that is located on the distal portion of the catheter and includes one or more electrodes. The console includes a diagnostic module for recording signals from the electrodes and a processing unit for processing the recorded signals.

title: MEDICAL INSOLE
abstract: medical engineering. SUBSTANCE: device has conducting and nonconducting magnetophoretic layers provided with acupressure massage protrusions and means for connecting selected foot zones through pulse shapers to negative output unit of ferropiezogenerator of module structure with conic type pressure drive. Joining drive edges are manufactured as coupled conic surfaces having generatrix slope angle of 40-75 deg to cross-section plane running in perpendicular to the axis. Seignette member groups of the generator modules are connected in opposition to each other with their positive output being connected to passive electrode. EFFECT: combined magnetic, electric and acupressure stimulation of selected foot zones; enhanced effectiveness of treatment. 8 dwg

title: Intelligent monitoring system for nursing of critical patient
abstract: The invention provides a critical patient nursing intelligent monitoring system. The system constructs an artificial intelligence algorithm model by using the electroencephalogram parameters, the blood physiological parameters, the respiratory rate and the doctor's advice, and the constructed artificial intelligence algorithm model generates a patient nursing intelligent monitoring strategy according to the real-time electroencephalogram parameters collected by the server, the real-time blood physiological parameters of the user, the current respiratory rate and the current doctor's advice. The nursing means of the nurse are flexibly adjusted according to the patient nursing intelligent monitoring strategy, so that the humanized nursing target is achieved. According to the intelligent nursing system, the special requirement of the patient for precise nursing is met, the intelligent nursing effect is achieved, and the life quality of the patient is improved.

title: Novel vibratory massage magnetic therapy cap
abstract: A novel vibration massage magnetic therapy cap comprises an inner container, a plurality of sets of magnetic therapy buckles distributed at equal intervals are installed on the outer side of the inner container, a shell is arranged on the upper side of the inner container, a plurality of sets of vibration blocks distributed at equal intervals are installed on the outer side of the shell, supporting frames are fixedly connected to the left side and the right side of the shell, and screw holes are formed in the middles of the two sets of supporting frames. When the outer shell is installed on the outer side of the inner container, the vibration blocks driving the outer shell can press the magnetic therapy buckles of the inner container to massage the head, the inner container and the outer shell can be installed and detached mutually, the outer shell can be directly taken down after massage is finished, the magnetic therapy buckles on the inner container continue to conduct magnetic therapy on the head, the weight of the head is reduced, and the head is more comfortable. When the shell massages the head, the screw rods are screwed to enable the supporting plates to be attached to the shoulders of the user, the shell is supported through the two sets of supporting plates, the weight of the device is greatly reduced, and the neck of the user is effectively prevented from being sprained.

title: Virtual reality psychological disease cognition experience system and method
abstract: The invention discloses a virtual reality psychological disease cognition experience system and method, and the system comprises an information collection module, a cognition experiment module, a comprehensive evaluation module, a communication module, and an early warning module. A data processing center is used for receiving data collected by the information collection module and signals transmitted by the communication module; the behavior analysis of the cognitive experiment module and the comprehensive evaluation module is carried out in real time through a carried algorithm program; according to the system, parameter data of an experiencer is monitored in real time through the information acquisition module, data analysis and processing are performed through the data processing center, accurate monitoring and intelligent judgment are achieved, and the coping efficiency of psychological diseases is improved; whether acquisition succeeds or not is judged by combining the parameters acquired by the information acquisition module with the standard value parameters of the system and the standard degree of the actions of the experiencer, and an alarm is given in time in combination with the alarm module, so that the data acquisition accuracy and the processing and correction efficiency of the experiencer are improved.

title: Fluid property sensing array utilizing a neural network
abstract: A fluid property sensing array includes a first sensor including a first electrode assembly and a first sensing layer at least partially coating the first electrode assembly, the first sensor having a first response to a property of the fluid; and a second sensor including a second electrode assembly and a second sensing layer at least partially coating the second electrode assembly, the second sensor having a second response to the property of the fluid. The array can include a third sensor including a third electrode assembly and a third sensing layer at least partially coating the third electrode assembly, the third sensor having a third response to the property of the fluid. The first sensing layer, the second sensing layer, and the third sensing layer can be compositionally different, such that the first response, the second response, and the third response to the property of the fluid are different.

title: WILL DISPLAY DEVICE AND WILL DISPLAY METHOD
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a will display device for displaying the will of a user by detecting the change of a measured brain blood volume. SOLUTION: A head part is irradiated with near infrared light, a fitting curve 2-15 for the measured value of transmission light intensity in a rest period indicated by the period of a point (a) and a point b and the period of a point c and a point d among the intensity 2-14 of transmission light scattered and transmitted inside the head part is calculated and a difference Ds between the fitting curve and the measured value of the transmission light intensity is obtained. The mean square value Crest of Ds in the rest period and the mean square value Ctask of Ds in a task period are calculated, a Ctask/Crest is compared with a predetermined threshold and the presence/absence of the change of the brain blood volume based on the conscious brain function activity of the user of this device is discriminated. Thus, the intention is expressed by using the fluctuation of the brain blood volume accompanying the brain function activity without using motion functions.

title: Therapeutic pillow for neurology department
abstract: The invention discloses a therapeutic pillow for the neurology department and belongs to the field of medical tools for the neurology department. The pillow includes an edge part, a headrest part anda neck pillow part, and the headrest part, the lower portion of the neck pillow part and the edge part are all filled with stretch cotton; the headrest part is composed of a bamboo carbon fiber layer,a Chinese medicine layer and a heating layer from top to bottom in sequence, and the neck pillow part is higher than the headrest part. Medicinal components of the therapeutic pillow can be utilizedto the maximum degree and have a remarkable therapeutic effect on insomnia.

title: METHOD OF GLIAL BRAIN TUMOUR TREATMENT
abstract: FIELD: medicine. ^ SUBSTANCE: treatment of glial brain tumours is ensured by partial tumour extraction. During operation photosensitiser is delivered in the cavity formed by partial tumour extraction. Photodynamic laser therapy implies using diode laser of cylindrical diffuser with spherical radiation pattern. Wavelength is 660 nm, power is 100-200 mW. ^ EFFECT: higher concentration of photosensitiser in cavity of partially extracted tumour, reduced amount of introduced photosensitiser, more uniform radiation of tumour tissue, lower probability of postoperative complications and length of hospital stay. ^ 3 ex

title: Local pulsed electric field ablation head end
abstract: The utility model discloses a local pulsed electric field ablation head end which comprises an anode electrode and a plurality of cathode electrodes, the anode electrode is arranged at the farthest end of the ablation head end, and the ratio K of the sum of the surface areas of the cathode electrodes to the surface area of the anode electrode is 3: 1-1: 1. The K value is preferably in a range of 3: 1-1: 1, a relatively good ablation depth can be obtained, and meanwhile, the anode electrode does not generate an ionization phenomenon. According to the local pulse electric field ablation head end, a high-voltage pulse energy source can be accurately applied to target tissue, a focus area can be ablated in a targeted mode, surrounding healthy tissue is prevented from being damaged, and efficient and accurate ablation is achieved.

title: Control method and device for electronic equipment using EOG and EMG
abstract: The present invention relates to a method and a device for controlling electronic devices using electrooculogram (EOG) and electromyogram (EMG) and, more specifically, provides a human computing interface (HCI) which is conveniently used by disabled people using an electroo culogram (EOG) signal and an electromyogram (EMG) signal. Specially, the present invention provides the HCI capable of being conveniently used by sensing the EOG signal and the EMG signal using the temporalis muscle of a user; by constructing a command system of various patterns; by directly analyzing the signals; by individually patterning the EMG signal and the EOG signal; by constructing the command patterns; and by patterning the various numbers of the commands. Therefore, the present invention can improve the reliability and the competiveness for a product and a system in an HCI field for the disabled people and the similar field with the HCI field.

title: Zero-flux closed-loop circuit
abstract: The invention relates to a zero-flux closed-loop circuit which comprises a self-oscillation fluxgate current sensor, a magnetic integrator and a feedback circuit. Wherein the self-oscillation fluxgate current sensor can generate a magnetic field signal under the action of excitation current, the magnetic integrator can generate a corresponding voltage signal according to the magnetic field signal, the feedback circuit can generate a feedback signal according to the magnetic field intensity corresponding to the voltage signal, and the feedback signal acts on the self-oscillation fluxgate current sensor. Therefore, the self-oscillation fluxgate current sensor adjusts the excitation current, thereby ensuring that the magnetic flux of a fluxgate of the self-oscillation fluxgate current sensor is kept near a zero magnetic flux point. Therefore, through the zero-magnetic-flux closed-loop circuit, the electrified current of the electrified wire can be detected in a zero-magnetic-flux environment, the influence of noise can be effectively reduced, the distortion degree of signals is reduced, and the precision of current detection is improved.

title: Fault data processing method and system for eddy current self-driven voltage sag treatment device
abstract: The invention provides a fault data processing method and system for an eddy current self-driven voltage sag treatment device, and relates to the technical field of voltage sag treatment, and the method comprises the steps: receiving sag fault data of a plurality of segmented branches; receiving historical working data of the plurality of eddy current self-driven voltage sag treatment devices; marking a plurality of abnormal subsection branches according to the sag fault data and the historical working data; counting each abnormal subsection branch, the corresponding abnormal voltage sag frequency and a plurality of abnormal voltage sag currents; and if the abnormal voltage sag frequency corresponding to the target abnormal subsection branch is greater than a preset abnormal frequency threshold, matching corresponding to-be-replaced device model information in a preset device model database based on a plurality of target abnormal voltage sag currents corresponding to the target abnormal subsection branch. According to the invention, the power utilization condition of the segmented branch is enhanced, and the adaptability between the power utilization condition and the model of the eddy current self-driven voltage sag treatment device is improved.

title: PROSTHESIS ASSEMBLY
abstract: The invention relates to a prosthesis assembly, comprising an outer stem (10) provided with a proximal opening (11), and at the distal end (12) thereof is provided with a connecting means (13) for fastening an additional component, and which is formed of a material that is rigid in the longitudinal extension thereof, in which at least one slit (14) extending at least partially in a longitudinal direction is inserted in order to allow deformation in a radial direction. The prosthesis assembly further comprises an inner stem (20) made of a flexible material and provided with a proximal opening (21), at least one tensioning device (30) that is affixed to the outer stem (10) and can be accessed by way of a diameter change of the outer stem (10). At least one electrode (40) is displaceably fastened to a side of the outer stem (10) that is facing the inner stem (20).

title: Implantable pressure-controllable micro-balloon spinal nerve compression device for small animals
abstract: The invention discloses an implantable pressure-controllable micro-balloon spinal nerve compression device for small animals. The implantable pressure-controllable micro-balloon spinal nerve compression device comprises a liquid containing balloon, a pressing plate, an extrusion screw, a nut sleeve and a balloon catheter which are arranged in a subcutaneous tissue. The implantable pressure-controllable micro-balloon spinal nerve compression device is characterized in that the pressing plate is arranged above the liquid containing balloon, the extrusion screw penetrates through dermal tissue from the outside of the skin to abut against the upper portion of the pressing plate, the nut sleeve is arranged in the dermal tissue and sleeves the extrusion screw, and the balloon catheter communicates with the liquid containing balloon through a liquid guide pipe to guide liquid; and a pressure gauge is further arranged at the liquid inlet portion of the balloon catheter. The device disclosed by the invention can be used for simulating spinal nerve compression injury in animal experiments, is convenient to operate and controllable in force, and can also detect pressure and improve the accuracy of the experiments.

title: Uterine contraction information extraction method based on uterine electromyographic signals
abstract: A uterine contraction information extraction method based on a uterine electromyographic signal comprises the steps that S1, the uterine electromyographic signal of a certain duration is collected through an electrode on the abdomen of a pregnant woman and converted into a digital signal; s2, preprocessing the uterus electromyographic signals; s3, segmenting the uterus electromyographic signals into a series of overlapped windows in a window sliding mode; s4, calculating a sample entropy SampEn and a zero-crossing rate ZC of each window; s5, normalizing the sample entropy sum and the zero-crossing rate value, and respectively performing weighted summation on the sample entropy and the zero-crossing rate of each window to obtain the uterine contraction intensity F of each window at the corresponding moment; and step S6, setting weight factors omega s and omega e of starting and ending of uterine contraction to detect starting and ending positions of the uterine contraction in the signal, and calculating occurrence frequency fc and average duration dc of the uterine contraction. According to the invention, more reliable uterine contraction information can be obtained by means of the uterus electromyographic signals collected noninvasively.

title: BIONIC EAR PROSTHESIS
abstract: FIELD: medicine.SUBSTANCE: invention relates to medicine, namely to bionic ear prostheses. The prosthesis is made in the form of a silicone ear, corresponding to the shape of the patient’s auricle. The prosthesis contains a microphone, connecting tape wires for transmitting electrical signals and converted acoustic signals, a power source, a magnetic-vibration bone conduction transducer and a flexible microchip with an analog-to-digital converter, a digital-to-analog converter, a digital signal processor, a radio communication module and a programmable memory device. The power source is located in the silicone earlobe and is connected by connecting wires on one side with a microphone, and on the other side with a hybrid microchip. The microphone is located in the tragus of the silicone ear. The microchip is located in the antitragus of the silicone ear. The microchip is connected to a capacitor, which is located in the helix, by means of a ribbon conductor. The capacitor is connected to a resistor, which is located in Darwin’s hillock. The resistor is connected to a magnetic-vibration bone conduction transducer, which is located in the helical root and is fixed on a sound-conducting implant installed in the patient’s temporal bone.EFFECT: is achieved the possibility of correction hearing loss with an acoustic aid that works on the principle of bone conduction and is located in the prosthesis of the auricle without forming the auditory passage.1 cl, 1 dwg

title: CANNULA AND METHOD FOR CONTROLLING DEPTH DURING SURGICAL PROCEDURES
abstract: A disc surgical system is provided having an elongated tubular member housing and an electrosurgical electrode for excising of or shrinking tissue. The instrument includes at least one cannula having an operative end for entering an operative field of a patient, at least one guide wire having a pointed end for piercing tissue, a tapered dilator configured to slide over a guide wire; and a trephine configured to slide over a guide wire. The operative end has threads on an exterior surface of the cannula for engagement with the tissue of the patient.

title: Tumor treatment device based on multi-frequency electric field technology
abstract: The invention provides a tumor treatment device based on a multi-frequency electric field technology. The tumor treatment device comprises a detection device used for detecting a tumor through a signal oscillation detection technology and obtaining a tumor waveform signal; frequency conversion equipment is used for performing electric field frequency analysis on the tumor waveform signal to obtain an analysis result, and performing frequency regulation and control on the tumor according to the analysis result to generate resonant frequency; feedback equipment is used for judging the tumor pre-foaming probabilities of different tissues according to the resonance frequency; according to the method, tumor cells are comprehensively detected, the comprehensiveness of data is maximally guaranteed, the accuracy of tumor cell treatment is enhanced through the electric field frequency analysis, meanwhile, the treatment efficiency is improved, the tumor cells are predicted and treated, and the safety of cells is greatly improved.

title: Electrical Cell-substrate Impedance Sensor (ECIS)
abstract: An electrical cell-substrate impedance sensor (ECIS) includes a substrate; a catalyst layer formed on the substrate; and a plurality of nanowire electrodes array grown on the catalyst layer. The plurality of nanowire electrodes are configured to measure an electrical response of a biological cell.

title: Ellipsoidal fitting online magnetism correction method and device based on function type link neural network
abstract: The invention provides an ellipsoid fitting online magnetism correction method based on a function type link neural network. The ellipsoid fitting online magnetism correction method comprises the following steps: S1, establishing a magnetism correction model; s2, calculating a magnetism correction matrix of the magnetism correction model by adopting an ellipsoid fitting method; s3, constructing a function type link neural network; s4, obtaining an ellipsoid fitting equation by using an ellipsoid fitting method based on the function type link neural network, and calculating through the ellipsoid fitting equation to obtain a corrected magnetism correction matrix; according to the method, an ellipsoid fitting method is adopted to calculate a magnetism correction matrix, a function type link neural network is used to realize online updating of the magnetism correction matrix, assistance of other sensors is not needed, independent magnetism correction can be carried out, and thus the problem that measurement noise is introduced by other sensors is avoided; an online magnetism correction scheme based on a function type link neural network is adopted, and a magnetism correction matrix is obtained through continuous iteration and optimization, so that the complicated process of manual magnetism correction in the using process is avoided, meanwhile, the operand can be greatly reduced, and the operation burden of a processing chip is reduced.

title: Electrocardiogram lead wire and electrocardiogram signal detection device
abstract: The invention relates to an electrocardiogram lead wire and an electrocardiogram signal acquisition device. The electrocardiogram lead wire includes an electrode clamp and a cable; and the cable is electrically connected to the electrode clamp and wound to form at least two coils, and the winding direction of at least one coil is opposite with the winding directions of the other coils. As the winding direction of at least one coil is opposite with the winding directions of the other coils, the directions of the distribution of induced magnetic fields generated by induced current are opposite,and the mutual inductance magnetic fields between the coils in different winding directions can counteract partial induced magnetic fields generated by the electrocardiogram lead wire so as to make the induced magnetic fields smaller, so that the induced current can be inhibited, and noise signals caused by gradient magnetic fields can be eliminated.

title: Pixel architecture and driving scheme for biometric sensing
abstract: Embodiments herein describe an input device that includes a rectangular array of sensor electrodes connected to sensor modules that measure capacitive sensing signals corresponding to the electrodes. During a charge stage, the input device applies a charging voltage to neighboring sensor electrodes in the array. The input device then drives the neighboring sensor electrodes to a reference voltage and measures the amount of charge accumulated on at least one of the sensor electrodes. Because of the parasitic capacitance between the neighboring electrodes, driving these electrodes (even the ones not being measured) to the same charging and reference voltages reduces the effect of the parasitic capacitance on the capacitive sensing measurement. Thus, during the read stage, the measured charge is affected primarily by the capacitance between the sensor electrodes and an input object (e.g., a finger).

title: Dual-threaded tensioning mechanism for bipolar pencil
abstract: An electrode assembly for an electrosurgical pencil includes an insulative core configured to support an active wire around a peripheral surface thereof and a ground electrode coupled about the insulative core and adapted for insertion within an electrosurgical pencil. A hypotube is disposed between the ground electrode and the active pin and encapsulates the active pin to insulate the active pin from the ground electrode. An active pin is included that is adapted for insertion within the pencil and has a tensioning assembly including: a set screw with threads that engage grooves of the active pin such that, upon rotation, the set screw advances to secure the active wire within the active pin; and a nut is fixed within the hypotube that includes grooves that engage threads of the active pin such that, upon rotation, the active pin translates proximally to tension the active wire about the insulative core.

title: Simple and easy locking front electrode fixing device that leads that takes off
abstract: The utility model relates to a simple and easy locking front electrode fixing device that leads that takes off, including fixed bolster, elastic cord and electrode slice the fixed bolster on the installation have several elastic cords, forming the interval between two adjacent elastic cords, and following the mutual parallel arrangement of length direction of fixed bolster, the one end of each elastic cord is fixed on the fixed bolster, and the other end is the free end, detains through the primary and secondary and installs on the fixed bolster, the electrode slice on be provided with two slot holes, the free end of each elastic cord passes two slot holes in proper order, installs the electrode slice on the elastic cord, this electrode slice is described for the protuberantia with the contact surface of skin, the electrode slice on still be provided with the adapter. The utility model has the advantages that: each electrode atress is even, not influenced by external force, has prevented various interference, and it is clear to trace heart electrograph wave form, it is easy and simple to handle not loaded down with trivial details, practice thrift inspection time, the elastic cord can use repeatedly, does not additionally add patient's laboratory fee and uses.

title: Method and Apparatus for Automated Detection of Suppression of TEOAE by Contralateral Acoustic Stimulation
abstract: A method of generating and measuring transiently evoked otoacoustic emissions (TEOAE) acoustic signals generated in the cochlea using automated detection to determine contralateral suppression of TEOAE via statistical analysis of suppressed and unsuppressed responses.

title: COMPOSITIONS AND METHODS FOR TREATING SEIZURE DISORDERS
abstract: Functional analogs of fenfluramine are provided. The subject fenfluramine functional analogs find use in the treatment of a variety of diseases. For example, methods of treating epilepsy by administering a fenfluramine analog to a subject in need thereof are provided. Also provided are methods of treating a neurodegenerative disease in a subject in need thereof. Pharmaceutical compositions for use in practicing the subject methods are also provided.

title: SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR CONDUCTING NEURAL PROCESS-BASED TRANSACTIONS
abstract: Systems and methods for conducting neural process-based transactions are disclosed. According to one embodiment, a system for conducting a neural-based transaction may include a brainwave sensing device that detects brainwave activity for a user; a point of transaction comprising a point of transaction computer processor in communication with the brainwave sensing device; and a back end comprising a back end computer processor that is in communication with the point of transaction. The brainwave sensing device may sense brainwave activity for the user. The back end may receive the brainwave activity sensed by the brainwave sensing device, and may identify an action associated with the brainwave activity. The back end may then communicate the activity to the point of transaction, which may execute the action.

title: Transcuataneous electrical nerve stimulation device
abstract: A transcuataneous electrical nerve stimulation device is disclosed, a paste and contact device can be connected with the transcuataneous electrical nerve stimulation device in a plugged manner, the transcuataneous electrical nerve stimulation device supplied an electric current to the paste and contact device, and the paste and contact device comprises a plurality of electrode paste sheets and two electrode probe rods. The transcuataneous electrical nerve stimulation device comprises a vacuum shell body unit, a power source unit arranged in the shell body unit, a plurality of output units that are arranged in the shell body unit at intervals and a control unit electrically connected with the output units, wherein the power source unit is used for providing a power source, the plurality of output units are electrically connected with the power source unit, and the control unit is arranged to penetrate the shell body unit. The control unit comprises a plurality of strength adjusting press buttons that are respectively electrically connected with the output units, each strength adjusting press button can control the current strength of each output unit, adjustment can be made by a user according to requirements of different affected parts, and convenience of operation can be improved.

title: BRIAN COOLING SYSTEM
abstract: A clinical grid electrode system for seizure control through local cooling, mapping brain function and me provision of reversible functional ablation. The system includes a modular, scalable, cooling and sensing array composed of a plurality of cooling sensing elements. The system also includes a control system to which die cooling and sensing array is coupled for providing for control and monitoring of die cooling sensing elements making up the cooling and sensing array.

title: EEG data correction method and system based on RSVP in simulation environment
abstract: The invention relates to an electroencephalogram data correction method and system based on RSVP in a simulation environment. The method comprises the following steps: extracting key video data acquired by a video acquisition device within a preset time period when a tag trigger signal is sent, determining a real moment when a human eye watches a target image according to eye movement data and the key video data, updating a moment when the tag trigger signal is sent to the real moment, and further correcting an electroencephalogram trigger tag. And the problem of inaccurate electroencephalogram data marking is avoided.

title: Intraoperative nerve electrophysiology monitoring, identifying and examining system
abstract: The utility model discloses an intraoperative nerve electrophysiology monitoring, recognizing and examining system which comprises a head probe electrode, a limb probe electrode and a monitoring and early warning instrument. The monitoring and early warning instrument comprises an electrode jack, a neuroelectric signal collector, a high-pass filter, a signal converter, a signal processor, a voiceprompter, a display screen, a data memory, an operation keyboard, a recognition and assessment key, a power supply assembly and a power plug. According to the utility model, the problems that the judgment process of a professional technician is difficult to coordinate with the operation process of a surgeon and an accurate signal and an interference signal in the monitoring process are difficult to distinguish timely and accurately are solved, and meanwhile, a practice technician can quickly accumulate experience and improve the accuracy of monitoring, identifying and judging under the condition of not participating in an operation.

title: EPILEPTIC SEIZURE DETECTION WITH EEG PREPROCESSING
abstract: Methods and systems for detecting seizures include generating two-dimensional frames that each include a first set of elements that store measurements from sensors and a second set of elements that store values calculated from said measurements. The two-dimensional frames are classified using a machine learning model. It is determined that a subject experienced a seizure during a measurement interval based on an output of the machine learning model. A corrective action is performed responsive to the determination that the subject experienced a seizure.

title: NEURAL ELECTRODE BASED ON THREE-DIMENSIONAL POROUS GRAPHENE MATERIAL AND APPLICATIONS OF THREE-DIMENSIONAL POROUS GRAPHENE MATERIAL IN PREPARATION OF BONE DEFECT FILLER
abstract: A neural electrode comprises a current generation device (1), a first electrode (3), and a second electrode (4). The current generation device (1) is separately connected to the first electrode (3) and the second electrode (4) by means of conductive metal wires (2), and at least one of the first electrode (3) and the second electrode (4) is a graphene electrode. The graphene electrode is soft, has good stability, and can be repeatedly pressed and folded, and has a very high charge injection efficiency, is used for carrying out electrical stimulation on a heart, a nerve and other tissues and organs, can promote electrical stimulation recovery of nerve cells and thus promote the recovery of nerve functions, and has a good stability in the body. Applications of a mineralized three-dimensional porous graphene material in the preparation of a bone defect filler, and the bone defect filler. The bone defect filler has good biocompatibility, promotes cell proliferation, and increases and induces osteogenic differentiation. The mineralized three-dimensional porous graphene material is put into a solution and is cooled and then is cut into mineralized three-dimensional porous graphene sheets, and a bone defect filler can be obtained after the mineralized three-dimensional porous graphene sheets are dried and sterilized.

title: METHOD AND APPARATUS FOR STIMULATION OF BODY TISSUE
abstract: A system and method for the controlled stimulation of body tissue. The system includes a transmitter, arranged externally to the body, and a receiver implanted within the body and electrically coupled to the tissue to be stimulated. The transmitter is operative to generate a series of radio-frequency energy pulses, each of a prescribed duration. The receiver functions to detect these energy pulses and, in response to the receipt of each energy pulse, to apply at least one electrical pulse of prescribed amplitude and fixed duration to the body tissue. The duration of the radio-frequency energy pulses determines the amplitude of the electrical pulses applied to the tissue. These electrical pulses are preferably produced as pulses of constant current so that the current flow in the body tissue will be independent of the tissue resistance.
