In addition, these electrical pulses are preferably produced with alternating polarity so as to minimize the possibility of tissue damage.

title: Concentration and blinking action extracting device and method
abstract: The invention discloses a concentration and blinking action extracting device and a concentration and blinking action extracting method. The method includes steps of acquiring data packets of electroencephalogram information collected by a dry electrode and a reference electrode; there are multiple data packets; extracting the blinking action according to the electroencephalogram information; confirming a reference verification sum of a first data packet, and calculating to obtain the calculation verification sum according to the first data packet; judging if the calculation vibration sum is equal to the reference verification sum to obtain a first judging result; if the first judging result is that the calculation verification sum is equal to the reference verification sum, calculating to obtain original data according to a character string of the first data packet; extracting the concentration according to the original data; if the first judging result is expressed as that the calculation verification sum is not equal to the reference verification, extracting the reference verification sum of the next data packet. By adopting the extracting device or method disclosed in the invention, the concentration and blinking action can be rapidly extracted, and the cost for the extracting device is reduced.

title: Psychotherapy appts. for treatment of patient's brain
abstract: The display screen enables viewing of sync. of activity within left and right sides of brain. The psychotherapy equipment includes a set of stereo headphones (4,5) for applying stereo sound signals through left and right hand channels (6,7) to the patient. The signals have different and specific frequencies. Sensors (10,11,12,13) are attached to the patient's head to receive continuously activity signals representing the activity within respective hemispheres of the brain. Information derived from these sensors is used to control a display (16,17). A microphone and input circuit (9,8) is provided to enable application of additional sound signals to the patient's headphones, for superposition on the initial sound signals, according to the images displayed on the screen.

title: Cerebrovascular observation abnormity alarm device
abstract: The utility model relates to a cerebrovascular observation abnormity alarm device. The utility model belongs to the technical field of medical auxiliary detection equipment. Cap comprising a cap body,the cap body is in a hemispherical shell shape. A circular hole is formed in the top; the cap body is fixedly connected with a detection device. A control device is fixedly connected to the side wallof the cap body; a power supply device for supplying power to the control device is fixedly connected to the side wall, away from the control device, of the helmet body, the detection device is electrically connected with the control device, the control device comprises an information storage unit, an information processing unit and an alarm unit, and two ear hanging rings are arranged on the side wall, perpendicular to the connecting line of the control device and the power supply device, of the helmet body; the alarm device is worn on the head of a patient, the detection device feeds back detected brain wave signals to the control device, the control device processes the signals and compares the signals with stored standard information, and when it is detected that the brain wave information exceeds the range of the standard information, the alarm unit responds to alarm.

title: Health-caring and therapeutic device controlled by brain wave signal
abstract: The invention relates to a computer control apparatus, especially relates to a computer control apparatus which bases on real time acquisition brain electrical signal, for more specific, this is an apparatus uses attribute data of the brain electrical signal which is extracted from processed, analyzed, calculated real time acquisition brain electrical signal as judgments criterion, and comparing with a plurality of attribute data of the brain electrical signal which is preset in the storage of the computer, and selecting the corresponding or resemblance data, and then triggering control instruction specified by the data, and driving and controlling corresponding apparatus to work in different mode of operation 0 Apparatus suited to the control mode are rapid learning apparatus, health rehabilitation apparatus, physics treat apparatus and so on.

title: Electro-convulsive treatment apparatus
abstract: An apparatus for electro-convulsive treatment has means for supplying pulses of current to output terminals P1, P2. An indicator M3 (Fig. 4) indicates the peak current passed during the treatment, the current being sensed at a resistor R1 also used to sense the peak voltage and charge supplied to the patient, voltage and charge being shown on further indicators M2, M4 (Fig. 4). A digital meter may indicate current and voltage and can be used ratiometrically to indicate patient resistance. A capacitor C2 is first charged and then discharged through the patient via a transistor T3 controlled by a circuit CC (Fig. 2) which gives a predetermined number of high current pulses followed by pulses of lower current. Pulse width rate and current amplitude are independently adjustable for both the high and low current pulses. Commutating transistors T4 to T7 controlled by circuit CM allow choice of various unipolar or biphasic pulse outputs, Figs. 3C to 3F. The charge supplied to the patient may be monitored during only the high current pulses (Fig. 5). Meter M1 across capacitor C2 may be calibrated in terms of charge, so that the charge in its reading indicates charge supplied. By monitoring the voltage on capacitor C2 or the signal of charge meter M4, supply of pulses may be stopped automatically when the patient has received a predetermined charge (Fig. 6). The output circuit may be modified to act as a constant current source for certain levels of patient resistance. Transistor T3 to T7 are controlled via opto- isolators I3 to I7. <IMAGE>

title: COCHLEAR STIMULATION DEVICE
abstract: A cochlear implant system is provided that does not require a headpiece. Rather, the external coil used to transfer power and data and control signal to the implant device is integrated into the housing of the external processor. In one embodiment, where the external processor is carried within a behind-the-ear (BTE) module that is worn by a user of the cochlear implant system, the external coil is carried within the BTE module or housing, or formed as part of the ear hook used to hold the BTE module in place. Because the external transfer coil forms an integral part of the external portion of the system, the present invention does not require the use of an implanted magnet. Hence, the cochlear implant system can be described as headpieceless and magnetless (e.g., including a single external device).

title: Coordinating System Responses Based on an Operator's Cognitive Response to a Relevant Stimulus and to the Position of the Stimulus in the Operator's Field of View
abstract: Neurophysiological responses such as EEG signals of brainwave activity, dilation signals of pupillary response, dwell time signals of eye movement and imaging signals of vascular response are monitored as a correlate of the operator's cognitive response. These responses are processed to determine if there is a significant cognitive response to a stimulus (visual or non-visual) to generate a positive cue. The operator's eye movement is monitored to determine when the operator fixates on the stimulus and the position of the stimulus in the operator's field-of view (FOV). The positive cue and position of the stimulus, and typically the time-stamp of the cue are output triggering a system response. The temporal sequence of cues and stimulus position may be processed to reinforce or reject the cue or refine the stimulus position.

title: Emotion classifying method based on facial expression and EEG
abstract: The invention relates to an emotion classifying method based on facial expression and EEG, and belongs to the technical field of pattern identification. The emotion classifying method comprises the steps of firstly synchronously collecting facial expression and electroencephalogram (EEG) data, then cutting off EEG data implying emotion information through the change information of the facial expression, and finally performing emotion classification through EEG information after treatment with an emotion classifying algorithm. Compared with an emotion calculating method which is frequently usedat present, the emotion classifying method based on facial expression and EEG provided by the invention has the advantages that facial expression identification is additionally performed in the emotion classifying process to pretreat the EEG data, and emotion components in the EEG data are improved, so that the emotion classifying accuracy rate is increased.

title: Heart stimulator
abstract: A heart stimulator provides a reliable automatic capture threshold search feature. A stimulation pulse generator is connected to at least a ventricular stimulation electrode for delivering electric stimulation pulses to at least the ventricle of the heart. The stimulation pulses generated have a strength depending on a control signal. A sensing stage is connected to an electrode for picking up electric potentials inside at least said ventricle of a heart and a control unit connected to the sensing stage and to the stimulation pulse generator determines points of time for scheduling stimulation pulses, to trigger the stimulation pulse generator so as to deliver a stimulation pulse when scheduled and to put out control signals for controlling the strength of the stimulation pulse. The control unit is further adapted to perform a capture analysis which may take into account extraordinary events.

title: Gel electrode
abstract: The utility model discloses a gel electrode, which comprises a gel main body and a porous support structure used for carrying the gel main body, the gel electrode has the advantages that the porous support structure is additionally arranged in the gel main body, so that the gel electrode has the properties of stronger mechanical property, high elasticity, softness, flexibility and stable performance; meanwhile, the advantages of low impedance and high signal-to-noise ratio are achieved; and the gel electrode is environment-friendly and sanitary, is comfortable to wear, and can be used for quickly collecting electroencephalogram without residues.

title: Sensorimotor discs for infants and babies
abstract: In one example, we describe a method and system for infant's development, which is a disc system, with various combinations and extensions. The brain is the only organ that constantly reorganizes itself based on experiences or lack thereof. Babies are born with millions of neurons. Through a process called “pruning”, certain ‘circuits’ are fine-tuned through repeated practice and stimulation. This occurs from birth, throughout early childhood. The purpose of the SensiMo Disc is to provide an infant, e.g., typically, up to the 25 lbs. and/or 29 inches long, sensorimotor stimulation, while lying in a prone or supine position, with minimal active movement of the head or extremities. As the child lays supine or proneon, on the SensiMo disc, the child's tactile, vestibular, and proprioceptive systems are stimulated. This helps develop the child's sensorimotor system. Many other variations and combinations, plus advantages, are discussed.

title: Multi-lead electrocardiosignal classification method based on convolutional neural network
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-lead electrocardiosignal classification method based on a convolutional neural network. The multi-lead electrocardiosignal classification method comprises the following steps: (1) acquiring a Chinese cardiovascular disease database CCDD and carrying out data preprocessing; (2) constructing a convolutional neural network that comprises two important components including global feature extraction and local feature extraction, wherein the global feature extraction part fuses the multi-lead electrocardiosignals by using different convolution kernels in different modes, and in the local feature extraction part, different importance of different lead electrocardiosignals on classification tasks is learned by using an attention network; (3) training the model and optimizing hyper-parameters; and (4) evaluating the performance of the model by using the test data set, and judging the classification accuracy. According to the multi-lead electrocardiosignal classification method based on the convolutional neural network, different importance of different leads is learned, electrocardiosignals of different leads are effectively fused, the classification accuracy is improved, and diagnosis of doctors is effectively assisted.

title: Communication protocol for implantable mircro-electrical stimulations system
abstract: The invention relates to a communication protocol for implantable micro-stimulation system. The communication protocol of the invention comprises at least one synchronization package, a start-up packet and at least one data frame. The synchronization package is used to enable a synchronization state of the implantable micro-stimulation system. The start-up package connects behind the synchronization package, and is used to enable a read state of the implantable micro-stimulation system. The data frame connects behind the start-up package, and comprises a plurality of items. Each item has at least one bit, and is used to control the implantable micro-stimulation system. The communication protocol of the invention follows the RS232 format to implement control functions. By the communication protocol, the implantable micro-stimulation system can transmit instructions outside the bio-tissue by the radio frequency signals, and generate corresponding electrical stimulation instruction inside the bio-tissue.

title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR MEASURING PERCEPTUAL EXPERIENCES
abstract: There is provided a method for determining perceptual experiences. The method comprises obtaining a plurality of signals acquired by a measurement device comprising a plurality of sensors positioned to measure brain activity of users being measured by the measurement device; providing the plurality of signals, without pre-processing, to a processing system comprising at least one deep learning module, the at least one deep learning module being configured to process the signals to generate at least one capability, wherein combinations of one or more of the at least one capability form the perceptual experiences; and providing an output corresponding to a combination of one or more of the at least one capability to an application utilizing the corresponding perceptual experience.

title: SLEEPY ELECTROENCEPHALOGRAM MONITOR
abstract: The utility model provides a drowse electroencephalogram monitor, which can detect whether a user enters drowse state by testing a human body's brain waves, and comprises, a drowse signal pickup device and an alarm device. The utility model is characterized in that the drowse signal pickup device comprises a detector, a pre-amplifier, a low pass filter, an amplifier, a pedestal generator, a comparator, and a delayer. Various additional devices which are controlled by the drowse monitor and are selected according to requirements can be arranged on the output end of the delayer, such as a refrigerating device which can lead the human body to be awaked from drowse state, an automobile brake device which is connected with the automobile brake pedal, a power cutoff device which leads a machine to stop, etc.

title: METHOD FOR ELECTRIC PULSE TREATMENT OF BIOLOGICAL STRUCTURES
abstract: The method for electric pulse treatment of the biological structures comprises the use of pulse current, the use of computer simulated multilevel amplitude and frequency-time modulation , the combination of the heterogeneous and homogenous pulses of low and medium frequency currents with the output signals of the precision digital-analogue stepless generation of the specified shape, namely mono- and bipolar rectangular, delta-shaped, exponential, sinusoid, H- and M-type, trapezoid, triangular pulses as well as the pulses of the natural biopotentials of biological systems. Furthermore, the method comprises plotting the hierarchy of the linearity segments, the reiteration cycles and the hierarchy of the encircling lines, the simulation of current amplitude and the stochastic level of the heterogeneous currents, the use of 1-4 galvanically separated channels of the independent generation of output signal, the use of the interchannel correlation according to the preset algorithm, biocontrol, and biosynchronization.

title: INTERFACE MODULE ALLOWING DELIVERY OF TISSUE STIMULATION AND ELECTROSURGERY THROUGH A COMMON SURGICAL INSTRUMENT
abstract: Concepts presented herein relate to an interface module that can be electrically coupled to an electrical stimulation generator, a radio frequency generator and an instrument. A selection module is coupled to the interface module and operates in a first mode to deliver electrical stimulation signals from the electrical stimulation generator to the instrument and in a second mode to deliver radio frequency signals from the radio frequency generator to the instrument.

title: Method for realizing hand fine motion motor imagery through electroencephalogram and picture joint coding
abstract: The invention provides a method for realizing hand fine motion motor imagery through electroencephalogram and picture joint coding, which comprises the following steps of: presetting an electroencephalogram pre-training model, training and analyzing the attention of a user in a video watching period, obtaining a target image corresponding to a target object expected to be captured by the user, and extracting an embedded vector of the target image; collecting an electroencephalogram signal when a user imaginates to grab a target object by adopting multiple preset hand fine actions during watching a video, and encoding the electroencephalogram signal through a trained electroencephalogram encoder in the electroencephalogram pre-training model to obtain an embedded vector of the electroencephalogram signal; and splicing the embedded vectors corresponding to the target image and the electroencephalogram signals, decoding the electroencephalogram signals facing a plurality of preset hand fine actions, and directly mapping the hand fine action motor imagery to the five-finger dexterous hand. The five-finger dexterous hand is used for decoding hand fine motion motor imagery based on a non-invasive brain-computer interface technology to help a user with a damaged function to freely control the five-finger dexterous hand to grab an object.

title: Transcranial ultrasonic integrated device
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of medical instruments, and discloses a transcranial ultrasonic integrated device which comprises a head device and a main control device. The head device comprises an ultrasonic multi-array element array combination; the ultrasonic multi-array-element array combination comprises a plurality of integrated units, each integrated unit comprises a single-array-element transducer and a magnetic resonance coil, and the magnetic resonance coil is arranged on the outer side of the single-array-element transducer in a surrounding mode; the main control device comprises an ultrasonic system, an MRI system and a data operation system; the data operation system is in communication connection with the ultrasonic system and the MRI system; the ultrasonic multi-array-element array combination is in communication connection with the ultrasonic system and the magnetic resonance graphic processing system. By combining magnetic resonance imaging and transcranial ultrasound, the focus can be accurately imaged, and the ultrasound can accurately select a combination mode of a single array element array according to magnetic resonance image guidance, so that a focal region is accurately positioned to the focus of brain tissue.

title: FULLY IMPLANTABLE SPEECH NEUROPROSTHESIS DEVICE, SYSTEM AND METHODS FOR USING SAME
abstract: Fully implantable speech neuroprosthesis devices and systems are provided. Aspects of the present invention include an in vivo positionable device, comprising: a housing, a first component extending from the housing in a first plane and a second component extending from the housing in a second plane parallel to the first plane, wherein the first plane and the second plane are non-overlapping. Further aspects of the present invention include a detection system, comprising: an in vivo positionable sensor comprising a device according to the present disclosure and an ex vivo power supply unit connectable to the sensor. Still further aspects of the present invention include an in vivo positionable sensor comprising a device according to the present disclosure and an ex vivo receiver unit operably connected to the sensor. Also provided are methods for using devices and systems of the present invention, such as in connection with speech decoding and/or synthesis.

title: Electromedical implant
abstract: The device (20`) has an external transceiver device (10) transmitting and receiving wirelessly transmitted data e.g. technical data. A waking unit switches the transceiver device from a turned-off state into a fully operational state by a waking signal. A waking control unit outputs the waking signal to the transceiver device, if a low-power receiver outputs a sequence of output signals, which identifies that the low-power receiver has detected a series of transmissions of sufficient signal strength in various frequency ranges.

title: Electrode cap
abstract: The utility model discloses an electrode cap belongs to the electrode field of specially adapted for EEG art, the cap body including the elasticity material, a plurality of electrode locating holes is provided on the cap body, electrode locating installs the conducting rod in the hole, said conducting rod passes said electrode locating hole, the one end of conducting rod be equipped with the electrode. The utility model discloses aim at provides an electrode cap to effective consumption and effective reduction that reduces electrically conductive gel detects consuming timely.

title: METHOD AND DEVICE FOR BIOELECTRIC PHYSIOLOGICAL SIGNAL ACQUISITION AND PROCESSING
abstract: A method for bioelectric physiological signal acquisition and processing comprising: - a first signal processing operation comprising: /a/ acquiring a first analog signal, /b/ converting the first analog signal in a first digital signal with a first bit depth, /c/ transferring the first digital signal with the first bit depth to a microprocessor; - upon reception of a signal to switch from a first operating mode to a second operating mode, a second signal processing operation comprising: /e/ acquiring a second analog signal, /f/ converting the second analog signal in a second digital signal with a first bit depth, /g/ converting the second digital signal with the first bit depth to a converted second digital signal with a second bit depth, /h/ transferring the converted second digital signal to the microprocessor, and /i/ processing the transferred signal on the microprocessor.

title: Method for fMRI data embedding and pattern recognition based on attention mechanism
abstract: The invention discloses an attention mechanism-based fMRI data embedding and pattern recognition method. The method comprises the following steps of: acquiring fMRI data, MRI data and field domain information of predetermined different types of crowds; calibrating the fMRI data through the field domain information; registering the calibrated fMRI data to the MRI data; performing brain partitioning on the registered data to obtain 360 brain sub-regions; performing data recombination on the partitioned data; and inputting the recombined data into the attention network for pattern recognition. According to the fMRI data embedding and pattern recognition method based on the attention mechanism, fMRI time sequences are recombined and put into a network with the attention mechanism, and multi-classification of brain patterns is achieved.

title: System, apparatus and method for spiking neural network
abstract: Systems and associated methods for constructing neural networks (NN) without the benefit of predefined output spike times or predefined network architecture. Functions are constructed from other functions determined from an input construction training set of output variable type. Method aspects of the neural network modeler may comprise partitioning the construction training set, representing the partitions, restricting the representations, constructing subfunctions from the restrictions, and combining the subfunctions to model the target function. Specifically, subfunctions represented from partition-specific neural networks of output value type are created using two fundamental composition operations: same-constant composition and different-constants composition. Different choices of weights and delays lead to different NNs with different output spikes that implement the same function.

title: Method for generating diaphragm rehabilitation stimulation signal and diaphragm functional rehabilitative apparatus
abstract: The invention discloses a method for generating a diaphragm rehabilitation stimulation signal, and the stimulation signal is generated by modulating a signal source which is generated by a computer-based controller through a stimulation signal modulation circuit, and the method comprises the following steps of a, generating two circuits of pulse sequences with adjustable width and period through the computer-based controller, and outputting one circuit of control pulse to an analog/digital conversion circuit module in the stimulation signal modulation circuit; b, modulating the two circuits of pulse sequences with the adjustable width and period into one circuit of digital pulse after the AND operation, and controlling the digital/analog conversion circuit module to output one circuit of analog signal with variable amplitude through the control pulse; c, modulating the analog signal to one circuit of envelop signal for simulating a respiration process by adopting the digital pulse through the control circuit; and d, amplifying the envelop signal for simulating the respiration process to generate a diaphragm rehabilitation stimulation signal. The invention also discloses a diaphragm functional rehabilitative apparatus based on the method. The method and the apparatus have the characteristics that the stimulation signal for simulating the natural discharge of the diaphragm nerves is generated by setting the pulse parameters, so that the damage of the stimulation signal on the diaphragm can be avoided, safety and convenience in use can be realized, and the circuit structure is simple.

title: Transcutaneous nerve stimulator device and method
abstract: A transcutaneous nerve stimulator as disclosed that is useful for suppression of organic pain. The stimulator device is relatively small in overall dimensions and is therefore portable yet provides a rectangular waveform with the output signal produced being sufficient to drive a capacitive resistance load of at least 2.2K ohms in parallel with 0.1Mfd with a maximum rise and fall time of 12 microseconds. The device is powered by a pair of NI-CD batteries providing a 2.5 volt input and produces a maximum 80 volt peak pulse output having a maximum duration of .10 milliseconds at a pulse rate between 20pps and 180pps. Potentiometers are provided to vary the pulse rate, the duty cycle, and output pulse amplitude as is necessary or desirable for a particular patient. The device includes an oscillator that controls the pulse rate of the output from a variable one-shot multivibrator with the output pulses from the multivibrator being coupled through a power amplifier to the primary winding of a step-up transformer, the secondary winding of which transformer is connected through a voltage clamp and variable I.E. mode circuit to the output leads from the device. The disclosed method includes generating a rectangular waveform and producing an output that is sufficient to drive a capacitive resistance load of at least 2.2K ohms in parallel with 0.1Mfd with a maximum rise and fall time of 12 microseconds.

title: HIGH FREQUENCY ELECTRIC TREATMENT APPARATUS FOR MEDICAL USE
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To ease the concentration of current density on a second electrode by a method where a second electrode is provided at a far end of a catheter tube while a snare-shaped first electrode is mounted free to advance or retract at the position and an auxiliary electrode allowed to contact the outside of the body of a patient is connected to electric wiring for electrically energizing the second electrode. SOLUTION: A bipolar snare as a high frequency electric treatment apparatus 10 for medial use has a catheter tube 16 and a tip chip 18 bonded at the distal end of the tube 16. In the tip chip 18, a pair of lumens 20 and 22 is formed parallel at a specified interval and a loop shaped electroconductive filament 26 as snare-shaped first electrode 24 is inserted through the lumens 20 and 22. Also in the tip chip 18, a second electrode is formed at the distal end face thereof and connected to the distal end part of a coil-shaped wire 41. The coil- shaped wire 41 is connected to a high frequency power source 47 through electric wiring 4 while being connected to a ring-shaped auxiliary electrode 52 put through a finger of a patient through an auxiliary code 50.

title: ELECTRODE FOR STIMULATING INTERIOR OF ORGANISM
abstract: PURPOSE:To eliminate a need to execute binding by means of an absorptive thread during operation and to shorten an operation time by a method wherein an electrode for stimulating the interior of an organism is formed with a needle and an insulation- covered conductor, the conductor in the vicinity of the needle has a structure where it is not insulation-covered, and the adsorptive thread is fixed in a position in the vicinity of the base part of the needle. CONSTITUTION:An electrode for stimulating the interior of an organism is formed with a needle 1 and a conductor 2 insulationcovered at 3 and has structure in which the conductor 2 in the vicinity of the needle 1 is not insulation-covered in order to make contact with an organism. The electrode has the needle 1 to the vicinity of which an absorptive thread 5 is secured. Approximately the 2-10 absorptive threads are preferably fixed in a skirtform shape in a manner to be against the pull-off direction thereof. Since the conductor is usually manufactured by twisting a plurality of metallic fine wires, only by locking the absorptive threads in a dogleg shape in a manner to extend the thread through the twisted wires, the adsorptive threads can be sufficiently fixed to the conductor. The length of the adsorptive thread and the length of the skirt of the skirtform part may have size enough for prevention of slip off of the electrode from an organism, and usually length of 10-30mm is enough.

title: Portable motor nerve stimulator
abstract: The utility model provides a portable motor nerve stimulator comprising a power supply, a first voltage generation circuit and a second voltage generation circuit; input ends of the first and second voltage generation circuits are connected with the power supply; output ends of the first and second voltage generation circuits are respectively connected with first and second emitter electrodes. The portable motor nerve stimulator can effectively stimulate affected part nerves through voltage, is simple and convenient in operation step, thus providing convenience for patients unable to move freely.

title: APPARATUS AND METHOD FOR CONTROLLING LED EMOTIONAL LIGHTING BASED ON FUNCTIONAL MAGNETIC RESONANCE IMAGING ANALYSIS
abstract: PURPOSE: An apparatus and a method for controlling an LED emotional lighting based on functional magnetic resonance imaging analysis are provided to optimize illumination for sensibility. CONSTITUTION: Brain function activation database(110) is constructed by functional magnetic resonance imaging analysis. A control unit(120) outputs a control signal for the color temperature and the brightness of a lamp. An LED lighting unit(130) controls sensibility illumination. An LED lamp evaluation unit(140) performs questionnaire evaluation. A fuzzy unit(111) has a learning function. [Reference numerals] (110) Brain function activation database; (111) Fuzzy unit; (112) Adjustment unit; (120) LED lighting control unit; (130) LED lighting unit; (140) LED lamp evaluation unit(survey); (AA) Profile; (B1) Brain activation according to the lamp; (B2) Emotion modeling; (CC) Database update; (DD) Profile/schedule information input means; (EE) LED emotion lamp control system block diagram; (FF) Survey

title: Electrocardiosignal individual sign recognition method based on characteristic distance distribution difference loss
abstract: The invention provides an electrocardiosignal individual sign recognition method based on characteristic distance distribution difference loss. The method comprises the following steps: normalizing numerical values of electrocardiosignal fragments to be trained; correlating the electrocardiosignal fragments with the user numbers to which the electrocardiosignal fragments belong; randomly selecting a group of electrocardiosignals from the processed electrocardiosignal segments and recording numbers, wherein a second group of electrocardiosignals needs to select signals which are the same as and are not the same as the users to which the corresponding positions of the first group belong; performing feature extraction on the two groups of signals by using the same backbone network; the distribution difference loss based on the feature distance between the two sets of features is calculated, and backbone network parameters are continuously optimized through the loss; during application, the trained backbone network is utilized to extract features in a to-be-detected electrocardio sample and a user template sample library; calculating the feature distance representation between the to-be-measured electrocardio sample feature and each user template sample feature; and predicting a user to which the electrocardio sample to be detected belongs according to the calculated feature distance.

title: APPARATUS FOR PREVENTING CEREBRAL NERVOUS DISEASE
abstract:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an apparatus for preventing a cerebral nervous disease which can effectively massage the brain.

SOLUTION: By using ultrasonic oscillation generated by a pair of ultrasonic oscillators 4a, 4b alternately driving in a cycle non-synchronous with heart beat and a stereo-oscillation wave of music generated by a pair of musical oscillators 5a, 5b together, the brain is gently and effectively massaged without performing excessive head massaging. By the apparatus, the blood flow in a deep part of the head is promoted, and the rise and decay of the oscillation energy generated by the ultrasonic oscillators 4a, 4b are relieved by modulators, thus the oscillation impact on the head can be softened.

title: Multi channel approach to capture verification
abstract: Methods and systems involve classifying the cardiac response to pacing using a multi-channel approach. Multiple cardiac response signals are sensed via multiple sense channels. Each sense channel comprises a distinct combination of electrodes and sensing circuitry. The cardiac response to the pacing pulse is classified based on the morphology of the cardiac response signals. Classifying the cardiac response involves discriminating between capture, fusion, non-capture, and non-capture with intrinsic activity.

title: Percutaneou transcutaneous electrical nerve stimulation pain therapeutic equipment modulated by music
abstract: The invention provides percutaneou transcutaneous electrical nerve stimulation pain therapeutic equipment modulated by music, consisting of a machine box, a key circuit, a singlechip circuit, a boosted circuit, an output circuit, a voice frequency processing circuit and a power supply circuit. The therapeutic equipment generates an electrical pulse wave under the control of the singlechip circuit and uses favorite music of a patient output by MP3 to modulate, so that electrophotoluminescence pulse amplitude acting on a human body changes along with strength and weakness of the music, and left and right channels of the music respectively correspond to two path for outputting, so that two path output pulses are different. The synchronously act of a special percutaneou transcutaneous electrical nerve stimulation (TENS) electrical signal and the music selected by the patient improves curative efficacy. The variable stimulation solves adaptability and tolerance of an organism on TENS to the greatest extent, and also realizes the individual demand of analgesia.

title: Tinnitus treatment system using knife needle
abstract: The present invention relates to a tinnitus treatment system using knife-based acupuncture to: enable an operator to perform surgery while looking inside ears of a patient; and add heat and electrical stimulation only to periosteum. More specifically, the present invention: treats tinnitus by using knife-based acupuncture having a predetermined width installed in a tinnitus therapy device including a hand piece connected to a high frequency generator, an image processing device, and a controller controlling the same; inserts the knife-based acupuncture, coated with an insulation material, into the inside of an ear by coating a blade and a body of the knife-based acupuncture with the insulation material; minimizes pain of a patient by preventing electrical stimulation from being added to ear muscles by cutting fat inside the ear with the knife blade part and directly adding high frequency electrical stimulation to periosteum through muscle; and maximizes the effect of tinnitus treatment as well as treats tinnitus safely by cutting a desired part using the tinnitus therapy device and adding heat and electrical stimulation only to periosteum while an operator watches the image of a monitor.

title: Extradural leads, neurostimulator assemblies, and processes of using them for somatosensory and brain stimulation
abstract: This is directed to a neurostimulator assembly that is preferably implantable and is suitable for treating epilepsy and other neurological disorders. The assembly includes inventive leads that are suitable both for providing electrical somatosensory stimulation, extradurally applied, as well as electrical stimulation that is applied to the central nervous system. The leads are preferably also suitable for sensing electrical signals in the brain. The invention includes processes of using the neurostimulator and its leads. The neurostimulator may independently provide a variety of different electrical stimulation, e.g., non-responsive electrical stimulation signals applied to the central nervous system to reduce the likelihood of a seizure or other undesirable neurological even from occurring, electrical stimulation signals applied to the central nervous system when the neurostimulator determines that epileptiform waveforms are impending or extant, and extradural electrical somatosensory stimulation signals. The responsive electrical stimulation signal or signals are intended to terminate epileptiform activity, e.g., to desynchronize abnormally synchronous brain electrical activity.

title: Skull-mounted electrical stimulation system
abstract: Systems and methods for applying electrical stimulation to the brain to treat headaches and neuralgia use at least one implantable system control unit (SCU), specifically an implantable signal/pulse generator (IPG) with one or more electrodes. The IPG is implanted in the skull and communicates with at least one external appliance, such as a Behind-the-Ear (BTE) unit. In a preferred embodiment, the system is capable of open- and closed-loop operation. In closed-loop operation, at least one SCU includes a sensor, and the sensed condition is used to adjust stimulation parameters.

title: USING EVOKED POTENTIALS FOR BRAIN STIMULATION THERAPIES
abstract: Methods and systems for providing stimulation to a patient's brain using one or more electrode leads implanted in the patient's brain are described. The methods and systems help a clinician determine locations upon the lead where stimulation is expected to provide the best therapeutic benefit and the least side effects. Different locations upon the lead are used to provide stimulation and for each stimulation location evoked potentials are recorded. The evoked potentials are associated with likely beneficial therapeutic stimulation. Signals indicative of unwanted motor activity in the patient are also recorded for each of the stimulation locations. The recorded evoked potential signals and motor signals are used to determine stimulation locations that provide therapeutic benefit with minimal side effects. They can also be used to determine therapeutic windows for the potential stimulation locations.

title: METHOD FOR ELECTROMAGNETIC STIMULATION OF CENTRAL AND PERIPHERAL NERVE SYSTEM
abstract: FIELD: medicine.SUBSTANCE: invention refers to medicine, namely to neurosurgery and rehabilitation medicine. A principal stage of the surgical intervention is followed by placing at least one electrode for neuromodulation in an abnormal focus. In the postoperative period, the Kronlein - Brusova scheme is used to localise a projection of anterior central gyri on the head skin, and the transcranial Doppler sonography follows. The presence and location of the temporal and suboccipical window are stated. It is the temporal window the closest to a projection of the anterior central gyri that is selected. Local magnetic emitters are placed in projections of the selected temporal and suboccipital windows. That is combined with the local exposure to the magnetic field by means of the placed emitters and electric current through the electrodes for neurostimulation. The 10-15-minute stimulation is performed three times a day for 15-20 days.EFFECT: method provides higher clinical effectiveness and reduced risk of complications ensured by the combined electromagnetic stimulation of the adequately selected exposed areas.2 ex

title: Transcutaneous neuromodulation system and methods of using same
abstract: Neuromodulation systems are described comprising a signal generator and at least one electrode. The at least one electrode can be configured to deliver a stimulation to a mammal, wherein the stimulation includes a biphasic signal and an overlapping high frequency pulse thereby inducing voluntary movement in the individual. Methods of administering the stimulation are also described.

title: PERSONAL TRANSCRANIA DIRECT CURRENT STIMULATION MINIMIZING ABUSE
abstract: The present invention relates to a transcranial direct current stimulation apparatus, which is a medical device using a non-invasive nerve stimulation method, and more specifically, to a transcranial direct current stimulation method of which a purpose is to conveniently and effectively use a personal transcranial direct current stimulation apparatus and to exclude side effects, and implementation of an electrode system of the personal transcranial direct current stimulation device. To this end, the personal transcranial direct current stimulation apparatus of the present invention comprises: a stimulation contact unit consisting of a plurality of electrodes which are in contact with a region of a head of a user; an electrode fixing unit consisting of two joints in order to attach each electrode of the stimulation contact unit to the head of a user; a control unit for determining polarity of the electrodes of the stimulation contact unit, and adjusting a direct current corresponding to each of the electrodes; and a stimulation generation unit for generating stable direct current corresponding to the polarity of each electrode determined in the control unit. Particularly, the personal transcranial direct current stimulation apparatus changes a current stimulation of the stimulation generation unit to a false stimulation when a stimulation use time of the user is examined through the control unit and excessive use is sensed. Accordingly, the personal transcranial direct current stimulation apparatus uses the stimulation contact unit having a plurality of electrodes of which polarity can be converted and the electrode fixing unit using two joints, thereby providing a method that a user can easily fix stimulation electrodes to a head thereof. Also, the personal transcranial direct current stimulation apparatus controls the stimulation generation unit by using the control unit, wherein, when excessive use is sensed, a false stimulation is supplied to protect the user from side effects induced by an excessive stimulation.

title: METHODS AND SYSTEMS FOR ESTIMATING NEURAL ACTIVATION BY STIMULATION USING A STIMULATION SYSTEM
abstract: A method for estimating neural activation arising from stimulation by a stimulation system includes identifying different neural elements stimulated by the stimulation; obtaining a neural response signal resulting from the stimulation by the stimulation system; and decomposing the neural response signal to estimate neural activation of each of the different neural elements.

title: Novel elastic electroencephalogram dry electrode with high comfort, electroencephalogram equipment and application system
abstract: The invention discloses a novel elastic electroencephalogram dry electrode with high comfort, which comprises an electrode base and a plurality of dry electrode units fixedly arranged on the electrode base, wherein each dry electrode unit comprises an elastic supporting element and at least one electrode probe element, one end of each elastic supporting element is fixed on the electrode base, the other end of the elastic supporting element is connected with the electrode probe element, and the electrode probe element is used for being in contact with scalp to collect electroencephalogram signals; the elastic supporting element is used for transmitting the electroencephalogram signals; and the electrode base comprises an electrode substrate element, an electrode unit fixing element and an electrode displacement limiting element and is used for obliquely fixing the dry electrode unit and transmitting the acquired electroencephalogram signals to a data processing module. The electroencephalogram dry electrode does not need to be coated with a conducting medium, high-quality acquisition of signals can be guaranteed during long-time monitoring, and the electroencephalogram dry electrode is convenient to use; and the contact surface of the electrode probe element and the scalp is a curved surface, so that the discomfort in use is reduced, and the comfort of user experience is improved.

title: Envelope specific stimulus timing
abstract: An implantable stimulation arrangement is described for generating electrode stimulation signals for an implanted electrode array having stimulation electrodes. A filter bank pre-processor processes an input acoustic audio signal to generate band pass signals each corresponding to an associated band of audio frequencies. A signal envelope module computes a corresponding signal envelope for each band pass signal. A stimulation pulse generator extracts stimulation signal information from the rate of change of the signal envelopes such as a time-based derivative to generate stimulation event signals defining electrode stimulation timings and amplitudes for some or all of the stimulation electrodes.

title: NEUROCYBERNETIC PROSTHESIS
abstract: NEUROCYBERNETIC PROSTHESIS A neurocybernetic prosthesis for controlling or preventing epileptic seizures and other motor disorders includes a pulse generator (10) which generates electrical pulses having a frequency of between 30 and cycles per second, a pulse duration of between .3 and 1 millisecond and a constant current of between 1 and 10 milliamperes. The generator (10) is enclosed in an epoxy-titanium shell and is implanted in the body, preferably in the axilla (66). Electrode leads (18, 20) pass from the generator (10) through a sub cutaneous tunnel and terminate in an electrode patch (62) on the vagus nerve (26). Provisions are made for varying the electrical signal. from the generator (10) after it has been implanted to 'tune' the same to the patient. The prosthesis may be designed to be turned on manually when the patient senses the imminence of a convulsion. Alternatively, sensors (48, 50) may be provided for determining changes in the values of state parameters such as electroencephalographic waves which precede a convulsion. The pulse generator (10) can then be turned on automatically in response to the sensors (48, 50).

title: Epilepsy diagnosis device based on single-channel electroencephalogram signals and convolutional neural network
abstract: The invention relates to an epilepsy diagnosis device based on single-channel electroencephalogram signals and the convolutional neural network. The epilepsy diagnosis device comprises a preprocessingmodule, a model constructing and training module and a model structure and hyper-parameter adjustment module, wherein the model constructing and training module comprises a binary model constructed based on the convolutional neural network, a nonlinear activation layer, a pooling layer adopting a mode of maximal pooling and fully connected layers; the 3 convolutional layers, 1 pooling layer and 3continuous fully connected layers are used, and activation function is used in the convolutional layers and the fully connected layers; and before data is delivered into the fully connected layers, multi-dimensional data is compressed to be one-dimensional by using a Flatten layer, the activation function after the first two fully connected layers is ReLU, while the activation function after thethird fully connected layer is Softmax, and the last 2 output units show classification of normal electroencephalogram and epileptic electroencephalogram signals; and the model constructing and training model is trained by using a 10-fold cross validation mode.

title: Systems, devices and methods using phase-amplitude coupling measures in implantable medical devices
abstract: A sensor of an implantable medical device senses electrical activity of the brain. A data analyzer of the device monitors an electrographic signal corresponding to the electrical activity of the sensed brain signal, and processes the brain signal to obtain a measure of phase-amplitude coupling. For a selected portion of the electrographic signal, the data analyzer detects first features and second features of the electrographic signal. The first features represent oscillations in a low frequency range, while the second features represent oscillations in a frequency range higher than the low frequency range. For example, the low frequency range may correspond to theta frequency and the higher frequency range may correspond to gamma frequency. The data analyzer determines a measure of phase-amplitude coupling between oscillations in the low frequency range and oscillations in the higher frequency range based on occurrences of second features which coincide with first features.

title: And nerve stimulation electrode and nerve stimulation system
abstract: The utility model provides a nerve stimulation electrode and a nerve stimulation system. The nerve stimulation electrode comprises a far-end electrode assembly, a middle-section wire and a near-end connector which are connected in sequence. The far-end electrode assembly comprises a plurality of first electrodes arranged at intervals and first wires electrically connected with the first electrodes. The near-end connector comprises a plurality of second electrodes arranged at intervals and second wires electrically connected with the second electrodes. The middle-section wire comprises a thirdwire, the far end of the third wire is connected with the near end of the first wire, and the exterior of the first connecting part between the third wire and the first wire is sleeved with a first fixing ring; the near end of the third wire is connected with the far end of the second wire; and a second fixing ring is sleeved outside the second connecting part between the third wire and the secondwire. According to the utility model, the electrode structure is flexibly combined according to requirements, electrodes with different structures in different sections can be manufactured conveniently, the electrode connecting point is protected, and the mechanical property and reliability of the electrode connecting part are improved.

title: Closed-loop transcutaneous electrical stimulation device based on electroencephalogram feedback
abstract: The invention relates to a transcutaneous electrical stimulation control device and method based on electroencephalogram. The device comprises a transcutaneous electrical stimulation module 1, a moxibustion control module 2, an electroencephalogram measurement module 3, an infrared imaging camera 4, a servo feedback control computer 5, a camera support 6 and a moxibustion clamping manipulator 7; a rehabilitation system of a treated person can be better stimulated by combining transcutaneous electrical stimulation with moxibustion of specific acupuncture points; an infrared temperature measuring camera is adopted to shoot facial meridian temperature characteristic changes of a stimulated person, electroencephalogram characteristic changes of the stimulated person are collected in real time, electrical stimulation parameters and moxibustion intensity and routes are adjusted in a closed-loop and real-time mode, and the treatment period of a patient can be greatly shortened; and real-time electroencephalogram and face infrared image features and current stimulation parameters are sent into a deep neural network to train an organism response mathematical model of the stimulated person, then the stimulation parameters are accurately adjusted according to the mathematical model, the rehabilitation process of a patient is accelerated, the better treatment effect is achieved, and the treatment time is shortened.

title: NERVE STIMULATION DEVICE
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a nerve stimulation device which performs accurate nerve stimulation by preventing erroneous detection of nerve stimulation pulse transmitted through a living body as heart rate.SOLUTION: The nerve stimulation device includes a nerve stimulation output section 17 generating stimulation pulses for stimulating the vagus nerve, a heart rate detection section 11 detecting electric signals from the heart and generating an electrocardiographic waveform, a correction pulse storing section 15 storing a noise waveform included in the electrocardiographic waveform generated by the heart rate detection section 11, and a signal coupling section 12 correcting the electrocardiographic waveform generated by the heart rate detection section 11 using the noise waveform stored in the correction pulse storing section 15 and generating a corrected electrocardiographic waveform. The nerve stimulation output section 17 generates stimulation pulses on the basis of the corrected electrocardiographic waveform generated by the signal coupling section 12.

title: Nerve stimulation method and device and electronic equipment
abstract: The invention provides a nerve stimulation method and device and electronic equipment, and is applied to a nerve stimulator, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining an acceleration signal of a patient through an acceleration sensor, obtaining a gyroscope signal of the patient through a gyroscope sensor, carrying out the fusion processing of the acceleration signal and the gyroscope signal, and obtaining a fusion signal of the patient; a heart rate and blood oxygen signal of the patient is obtained through a heart rate and blood oxygen sensor; determining a stimulation pattern of the patient based on the fused signal and the heart rate blood oxygen signal; the patient is neurostimulated based on the stimulation pattern. An acceleration signal and a gyroscope signal of a patient are fused to obtain a fused signal for respiration detection, and the signal quality can be improved; the heart rate and blood oxygen signals of the patient are obtained according to the heart rate and blood oxygen sensor, the intensity of nerve stimulation can be optimized, and therefore closed-loop stimulation of multi-sensor fusion is achieved.

title: Wearable electroencephalogram acquisition device
abstract: The invention discloses a wearable electroencephalogram acquisition device. After the device is worn on the head of a user, an electroencephalogram signal of the user is extracted by a surface electrode on the device, then the extracted electroencephalogram signal is input to a dual channel analog front end and is subjected to filtering, amplification and analog-digital conversion in sequence; a digitalized electroencephalogram signal is obtained and is input to a wireless transceiver, and the wireless transceiver packages the digitalized electroencephalogram signal and sends the signal to terminal equipment by a built-in radio frequency antenna. In a specific processing process, the kernel of the wireless transceiver processes a quantized signal and feeds back to an analog front end in real time for adjusting the work state of equipment, and the high-efficiency and low-power-consumption acquisition and transmission of the electroencephalogram signal is ensured.

title: SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR DETERMINING NEUROMODULATION PARAMETERS
abstract: This document discusses, among other things, systems and methods for providing pain relief to a patient. Recording circuitry may receive electrical signals corresponding to evoked compound action potentials in the patient that may be produced in response to external stimulation of a location where the patient is experiencing pain. The received electrical signals may be stored in a memory. Internal stimulation may then be applied to the patient and control circuitry may receive electrical signals corresponding to evoked compound action potentials in the patient that may be produced in response to the internal stimulation. The control circuitry may then adjust electrical parameters of the internal stimulation, such as to reduce a difference between the electrical signals corresponding to evoked compound action potentials produced in response to the internal stimulation and electrical signals corresponding to evoked compound action potentials produced in response to the external stimulation.

title: Non-attention event related potential brain-computer interface method for color sense automatic identification
abstract: The invention relates to a non-attention event related potential brain-computer interface method for color sense automatic identification. The method includes the following steps: connecting an event related potential processing device and an amplifier for detecting an electroencephalogram signal and a multi-lead electrode cap; setting a color sense stimulation parameter of a color stimulation picture for a user in the event related potential processing device; performing acoustic stimulation on the user while performing color sense stimulation on the user; acquiring an original electroencephalogram signal of a non-attention event related potential of the user in the process; and using the event related potential processing device to process and analyze the original electroencephalogram signal to acquire a time sequence specific components generated by different color sense sequence stimulations, and establishing the non-attention event related potential brain-computer interface for color sense automatic identification according to these specific components. The established color sense ERP non-attention processing brain-computer interface can provide a new technical mean for brain-computer interaction of color sense automatic identification and a color sense objective detection function, and can overcome the defects of user subjective cooperation.

title: Device is blocked to neural signal of implanted
abstract: The utility model provides a device is blocked to neural signal of implanted, including the flexible substrate that curls to and first kraft electrode, second kraft electrode, the signal processing module of setting at the curling surface of the substrate of flexibility.
