title: THE METHOD OF STIMULATION OF FACIAL MUSCLES OF THE FACE IN THE DEFEAT OF THE FACIAL NERVE IN THE EXPERIMENT
abstract: The method of stimulation of facial muscles of the face in the defeat of the facial nerve in the experiment by rehabilitation techniques, and with unilateral facial nerve lesion direct stimulation of facial muscles (such as the circular eye muscle type of feedback) using bioelectric device is fully implanted under the skin, with electrodes sewed into the corresponding facial muscles on the side paralysis and to stimulate a healthy direction for removal of Paterna trigger a flashing stimulation, and stimulation parameters are selected individually at different times after the implantation.

title: Minimally invasive nerve monitoring device and method
abstract: A neural monitoring device includes a stimulator configured to provide a stimulus, a mechanical sensor configured to generate an output signal corresponding to a sensed event, and a receiver configured to receive an output signal from the mechanical sensor and determine if the output signal corresponds to the stimulus provided by the stimulator.

title: Functional neuromuscular stimulation system
abstract: An input command controller (A) provides logic function selection signals and proportional signals. The signals are generated by movement of a ball member (12) and socket member (14) relative to two orthogonal axes. When the joystick is implanted, a transmitter (50) transmits the signals to a patient carried unit (B). The patient carried unit includes an amplitude modulation algorithm such as a look-up table (124), a pulse width modulation algorithm (132), and an interpulse interval modulation algorithm (128). The algorithms derive corresponding stimulus pulse train parameters from the proportional signal which parameters are transmitted to an implanted unit (D). The implanted unit has a power supply (302) that is powered by the carrier frequency of the transmitted signal and stimulation pulse train parameter decoders (314, 316, 318). An output unit (320) assembles pulse trains with the decoded parameters for application to implanted electrodes (E). A laboratory system (C) is periodically connected with the patient carried unit to measure for changes in patient performance and response and reprogram the algorithm accordingly. The laboratory system also performs initial examination, set up, and other functions.

title: Electroencephalogram signal identity recognition method, medium and equipment
abstract: The invention discloses an electroencephalogram signal identity recognition method, a medium and equipment, and relates to the technical field of electroencephalogram signal recognizing.The method comprises the steps that an electroencephalogram signal classification model is constructed, and the electroencephalogram signal classification model comprises a dynamic time-frequency deep convolution layer, a sliding window, a multi-head self-attention mechanism and deep separable causal convolution; based on federal learning, training the electroencephalogram signal classification model at a plurality of clients, and performing parameter updating on the models of the plurality of clients trained in each round by the server until the models converge; and using the trained model to classify the electroencephalogram signals. According to the method, accurate identification of the EEG signal of the user is realized, and the data security and privacy protection are enhanced.

title: Implantable neural microelectrode and manufacturing method thereof
abstract: The invention provides an implantable neural microelectrode and a manufacturing method thereof, and the manufacturing method comprises the steps: preparing a hard substrate (1), the upper surface of the hard substrate (1) is provided with a plurality of first interfaces, and the first interfaces are arranged in an array mode; all the first interfaces of the hard substrate (1) are aligned with a plurality of through holes in a first preset area of the adapter plate (2), all the first interfaces are tightly embedded in all the through holes through the gold wire pressure welding technology, and the first preset area is located at the first end (21) of the adapter plate (2); a metal wire array (3) is manufactured through the gold wire pressure welding technology, the metal wire array (3) is composed of a plurality of metal wires, the metal wires are perpendicular to the plane where the adapter plate (2) is located, one end of each metal wire is welded to the corresponding first interface through the through hole of the adapter plate (2) by means of the gold wire pressure welding technology, and the other end, not welded, of each metal wire is used for receiving neural signals.

title: DEVICE FOR STIMULATION OF EYE ACTIVITY
abstract: A device for stimulating one or more eye functions of individual's eye is presented. The device comprises a stimulator configured to be incorporated in or mountable on an appliance attachable to individual's face and comprising a respective at least one stimulator arrangement. The stimulator arrangement defines an interface region for covering a region of interest on the individual's face in a vicinity of the respective individual's eye, and comprises a local controller for operating the stimulator arrangement(s) to apply a stimulating effect on one or more nerves in the region of interest to affect at least one predetermined eye function. The stimulator arrangement comprises an array of individually operable stimulating elements to generate a stimulating signal at a respective location of the stimulating element within the interface region. The local controller activates a predetermined individual-specific sub-array of the stimulating elements during a stimulation session, where locations of the stimulating elements of the sub-array provide a desired spatial pattern of the stimulating effect to be applied while avoiding applications of the stimulating effect outside said locations within the interface region.

title: Method and device for neuromagnetic stimulation
abstract: In a method and a device for neuromagnetic stimulation of nerve strands, a magnetic field with a magnetic inductance B and at least one focussed ultrasound beam are applied simultaneously. The magnetic field is arranged orthogonally to the direction of ultrasonic oscillation. A focus having a diameter of about 1 cm is produced. The relatively strong fields required for effective and selective stimulation can thus be directed on to a single nerve bundle or a single central nerve region. Unintentional stimulation of adjacent nerve regions is prevented. <IMAGE>

title: BRAIN EXCITABILITY MONITORING AND MODULATION DEVICE AND METHOD
abstract: The present disclosure provides a real-time neuro-modulation wearable device configured to monitor and modulate a brain excitability level or maintain a favorable brain state of the user wearing the device. The device may include a pair of earpieces including a photoelectric module with a plurality of sensors configured to measure vital signs of the user, wherein the vital signs may be a blood oxygen saturation level, a heart rate, and a temperature of the user; a pair of surface electrodes placed behind ears of the user and configured to record an electroencephalogram with a reference electrode placed on a nasal bone of the user and configured to act as an electroencephalogram potential ground; an eyes cover; and a plurality of neural pathways stimulation means including visual and auditory stimulation means. There is also provided a method of monitoring and modulating a brain excitability level, or maintaining a favorable brain state using the wearable device.

title: Neurotrophic electrode system
abstract: A neurotrophic electrode system includes a non-conductive cone, a multi-channel electrode assembly, a dielectric ribbon and a neurite-attracting substance disposed within the cone. The non-conductive cone consists essentially of a material that is stable in a neural environment and defines a cavity. The cavity opens to a small opening at a first end of the cone and opens to a large opening at a second end of the cone that is opposite the first end. The multi-channel electrode assembly includes at least two recording sites that are disposed within the cavity defined by the cone. Each recording site is coupled to a wire that extends out of the large end of the cone. Each wire ends in a connection pad. The dielectric ribbon encases all of the wires but exposes each recording site and exposes each connection pad.

title: BURST STIMULATION PATTERN FOR NEUROMODULATION
abstract: The application discloses methods of ensuring pelvic health and/or treating a disease or disorder characterized by a dysfunctional autonomous nervous system in a subject with neuromodulation. The methods are characterized by the application of a burst stimulation pattern comprising a plurality of groups of electric pulses of high frequencies to the subject.

title: Wearable stimulation electrode assembly with adjustable electrical stimulation area
abstract: The utility model discloses a wearable stimulation electrode assembly with an adjustable electrical stimulation area. A wearable stimulation electrode assembly with an adjustable power supply stimulation area comprises an elastic bandage, and the end of the elastic bandage is detachably connected through a hook-and-loop fastener. The device further comprises a stimulating electrode, the stimulating electrode comprises an insulating base, the insulating base is detachably connected with an elastic bandage, and an operation hole used for wiring is formed in the elastic bandage. The stimulating electrode further comprises a sheet-shaped electrode and an electric needle, the electric needle and the sheet-shaped electrode which are arranged inside and outside are mounted on the insulating base, and an insulating layer is arranged between the electric needle and the sheet-shaped electrode; the insulating base is provided with a through hole used for being in sliding connection with an electric needle. The stimulating electrode is provided with the sheet-shaped electrode and the electric needle at the same time, so that switching use of two different electrical stimulation areas, namely the sheet-shaped electrode and the electric needle, is conveniently realized.

title: Flexible nerve probe implantation structure, preparation method and implantation equipment
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of brain-computer interfaces, in particular to a flexible nerve probe implantation structure, a preparation method and implantation equipment. The structure comprises a flexible nerve probe and a hardened coating, the hardened coating comprises a coating part and at least one fixing part; the coating part is arranged on at least part of the surface of the flexible nerve probe, and the coating part is used for improving the rigidity of the flexible nerve probe; the flexible nerve probe comprises an implantation tail end, and the position of the fixing part corresponds to the position of the implantation tail end; the coating part and the fixing part are integrally formed. By arranging the hardened coating on the outer surface of the flexible nerve probe, the rigidity of the flexible nerve probe is improved, so that the flexible nerve probe can be implanted without depending on an implantation carrier, and damage to brain tissue can be reduced. Besides, the structure of the hardened coating is designed, so that the hardened coating is provided with a fixing part capable of being matched with implantation equipment, and the implantation complexity of the flexible nerve probe can be reduced.

title: Newborn electroencephalogram electrode cap
abstract: A newborn electroencephalogram electrode cap effectively solves the problems that an existing medical electroencephalogram electrode cap cannot be freely adjusted according to the size of the head ofa patient, and a conventional electrode slice fixing mode is prone to falling off. Including a plurality of arcuate strips, every two adjacent arc-shaped strips are connected through elastic cloth. The front arc-shaped strip and the rear arc-shaped strip are connected through a plurality of longitudinal elastic bands; the two ends of each longitudinal elastic belt can slide left and right at the upper end of the arc-shaped strip; the left arc-shaped strip and the right arc-shaped strip are connected through a plurality of transverse elastic bands; two ends of each transverse elastic band can slide back and forth on the outer edge surface of the transverse elastic band; the longitudinal elastic bands and the transverse elastic bands are arranged in a staggered mode and are in a net shape. Each longitudinal elastic band and each transverse elastic band are connected with a plurality of electrode fixing blocks in a sliding mode through rubber rings, the lower side of each electrode fixingblock is provided with a conical groove capable of being matched with a protrusion at the rear end of an electrode slice, and the electrode slice fixing device is simple in structure, convenient to operate, novel in concept and high in practicability.

title: METHOD AND APPARATUS FOR MEASURING BRAIN WAVES
abstract: PURPOSE:To provide method and apparatus for measuring brain waves by which a subject can easily perceive a state of the brain waves of one's self in a real time manner while measuring the brain waves. CONSTITUTION:A brain wave input section 1 receives, amplifies, and A/D converts brain waves as changes of potential and, after that, the brain data is sent to a brain wave analyzing section 2. The brain wave analyzing section 2 performs a DFT conversion to the received brain wave data and identifies kinds of the brain waves. A control section 6 forms identification signals of the brain waves form the kinds of brain waves identified by the brain wave analyzing section for sending to a sound ringing section 3, a vibration producing section 5, a video image producing section 7, and a light emitting section 4 and sends those signals to each of the emitting sections. Each of the producing sections produces the identification signal of the brain waves which was sent.

title: Electroencephalogram cap
abstract: The utility model provides an electroencephalogram cap which comprises a hemispherical electroencephalogram cap body, a dry electrode sensor fixed according to the positions of O1, O2, P3, P4, Pz, T3, T4, T5 and T6 electrodes in an international 10/20 system, three meridians for placing the dry electrode sensor, meridian fixing locks for fixing the three meridians, a non-in-ear earphone, a storage device and a data line. The two ends of each longitude line are respectively fixed at the longitude line fixing locks on the upper sides of the two ears, the non-in-ear earphone is connected with the lower ends of the longitude line fixing locks, and a playing device is arranged in the non-in-ear earphone; the dry electrode sensor is connected with a storage device arranged behind the brain; one end of the data line is connected with the storage device, and the other end of the data line is a data interface. According to the electroencephalogram cap, the positions of the electrodes are simplified, the wearing complexity is simplified, a voice stimulation screening function is provided, extra detection personnel do not need to be provided, independent electroencephalogram data storage is provided, and electroencephalogram data can be transmitted to an external computer in real time to be processed.

title: Method for Implanting Electrode on Nerve
abstract: Methods and devices for implanting an electrode near a nerve covered by a tissue layer or layers. Methods can include cutting through a tissue layer covering the nerve to form at least two exposed pleural tissue layer edges. The nerve can be freed from any tissue around the nerve and the electrode placed around the nerve. The pleura edges can be drawn toward each other to cover the nerve and the edges secured together. Some methods form two tissue flaps which are pulled away from each other to expose the nerve. Other methods form a single tissue flap which extends over the nerve and is pulled back to expose the nerve. The now covered nerve is protected against movement of tissues near the now covered nerve. Such methods find one use in placing electrodes near the splanchnic nerves in the thoracic cavity, where the lung and diaphragm may contact an exposed electrode.

title: NEURAL ACTIVITY MEASUREMENT SYSTEM
abstract: The present invention provides a neural activity measurement system for measuring the electrical response of a neuron itself to achieve an electrical measurement of the neural activity itself, by providing a stimulator for applying an electrical stimulus to the neuron, as well as a Kelvin probe including a cantilever for detecting the electrical signal propagated through the neuron.

title: SYSTEM FOR PROVIDING STIMULATION
abstract: A system (10, 110, 210) for providing neurostimulation, comprising at least one stimulation element (12, 112, 212), the stimulation element (12, 112, 212) being configured to provide stimulation to a least one tendon and/or muscle of a patient (P).The present invention further relates to the use of a system according to the present invention for providing stimulation and a method for providing neurostimulation.

title: Systems and methods for online spike recovery for high-density electrode recordings using convolutional compressed sensing
abstract: Systems and methods for performing online spike recovery from multi-channel electrophysiological recordings in accordance with various embodiments of the invention are described. One embodiment of a method of performing online spike recovery from multi-channel electrophysiological recordings includes: determining a set of waveform templates; continuously obtaining multi-channel electrophysiological recordings using a multi-channel electrode; and automatically performing online spike recovery from the multi-channel electrophysiological recordings using a processing system that performs a method for sparse signal recovery that continuously adjusts a processing buffer size based upon newly obtained multi-channel electrophysiological recordings.

title: Neural detection instrument
abstract: The utility model discloses a neural detection instrument, including surveying needle and current generator, the detection needle is used for inserting human interior nerve with the people and contacts, current generator is used for sending stimulation current, survey the needle and be connected with the current generator electricity, in surveying the stimulation current of needle receipt currentgenerator output and spreading into the nerve into, current generator includes the shell and sets up the current circuit in the shell, the current circuit includes power, vibration generating circuitand amplitude regulator circuit. The utility model discloses a neural detection instrument through the setting of amplitude regulator circuit, just can effectually adjust the last amplitude of surveying the electric current in the needle of exporting, so alright carry out the effect adjusted to the electric current of final output with effectual realization, so just can be fine be applicable to different people's organism, reduced neural detection instrument's use cost.

title: ELECTROENCEPHALOGRAM-BASED NEGATIVE EMOTION RECOGNITION METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR AGGRESSIVE BEHAVIOR PREDICTION
abstract: The present invention discloses an electroencephalogram (EEG)-based negative emotion recognition method and system for aggressive behavior prediction. The method includes: conducting processing and feature extraction on obtained sample data to obtain an initial emotion sample feature vector, where the sample data includes EEG signals generated by stimulating healthy subjects in multiple negative emotion stimulation modes and a negative emotion stimulation mode corresponding to each EEG signal; training a deep neural network based on the initial emotion sample feature vector, and determining a middle-layer feature of a trained deep neural network model as an optimized sample feature vector; training a classifier according to the optimized sample feature vector and the initial emotion sample feature vector to determine a negative emotion recognition and classification model; and processing an EEG signal of a subject, and recognizing a negative emotion of the subject according to a processed EEG signal of the subject and the negative emotion recognition and classification model. The present invention can increase an EEG-based classification and recognition rate of emotions, so as to avoid and prevent an aggressive behavior. title: SUBCUTANEOUS DEVICE
abstract: A subcutaneously implantable device includes a housing, a clip attached to a top side of the housing, and an electrode. The clip is configured to anchor the device to a muscle, a bone, and/or a first tissue. The electrode is configured to contact an organ, a nerve, the first tissue, and/or a second tissue. Circuitry in the housing is in electrical communication with the electrode and is configured to sense an electrical signal from the organ, the nerve, the first tissue, and/or the second tissue through the electrode; deliver electrical stimulation to the organ, the nerve, the first tissue, and/or the second tissue through the electrode; and/or deliver a signal to a drug pump to provide a targeted or systemic therapeutic drug to the organ, the nerve, the first tissue, and/or the second tissue.

title: ELECTRODE MEMBER FOR RETINAL STIMULATION, AND ARTIFICIAL RETINAL DEVICE USING THE ELECTRODE MEMBER
abstract: An electrode member for retinal stimulation capable of focusing an actually transmitted picture image without pressing a retina over an unnecessarily wide range, and an artificial retinal device using the electrode member; the electrode member (1), comprising electrodes (2) disposed vertically and laterally in a matrix, support parts (3) for holding the electrodes (2) at specified positions, and fixing pins (4) for fixing the support parts (3) to a strong film (A) at four corners, the fixing pins (4) further comprising positioning projected parts (5) allowing the tip portions (2A) of the electrodes (2) to come into contact with a retinal ganglionic retina (C) when the support parts (3) are fixed onto the retina and stopping the entire surface of the opposed surface (3A) to come into contact with the retina (F), wherein the electrodes (2) are installed in needle shape projectedly from the opposed surfaces (3A) of the support parts (3) to the retina (F).

title: EVOKED STAPEDIUS REFLEX THRESHOLD (ESRT) TILE ELECTRODE
abstract: An electrode arrangement is described for sensing electrical activity in target tissue. An inner electrode has an elongate electrode body formed as a cylindrical section with an inner penetrating end for insertion into the stapedius muscle target tissue. An outer electrode fits over the inner electrode and an outer penetrating end for insertion into the target tissue. The two electrodes are joined together with their electrode bodies in parallel so that the penetrating ends of the electrodes penetrate in the same direction into the target tissue to sense electrical activity in the target tissue.
